articles.title_en: Institutional investor mandates, securities lending, and short-selling constraints
articles.title_cn: 机构投资者授权、证券借贷与卖空约束
articles.abstract_en: Institutions facilitate short-selling by lending from their holdings, but what they hold is endogenous. This paper examines how institutional demand, driven by investment mandates (benchmarking), affects short-selling. In a model where benchmarked managers lend from their holdings, both lending supply and equilibrium price are higher for the benchmark asset, and so is shorting demand (due to inflated price). A quasi-experiment using Russell index reconstitution shows that stocks with more benchmarked capital have greater lending supply and demand. Ultimately, such stocks are costlier to short. In theory and data, results are driven by incomplete pass-through from benchmarked capital to lending supply.
articles.abstract_cn: 机构通过从其持有资产中借出证券来促进卖空，但其持有资产是内生的。本文考察了由投资授权（基准化）驱动的机构需求如何影响卖空。在一个基准化管理者从其持有资产中借出证券的模型中，基准资产的借贷供给和均衡价格均更高，卖空需求也因此更高（由于价格膨胀）。利用罗素指数重构的准实验表明，基准化资本更多的股票具有更大的借贷供给和需求。最终，这类股票的卖空成本更高。在理论和数据中，结果由基准化资本向借贷供给的不完全传导所驱动。

articles.title_en: Guardians’ knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding epilepsy and obesity in children with epilepsy: a cross-sectional study
articles.title_cn: 癫痫儿童监护人对癫痫和肥胖的知识、态度和实践：一项横断面研究
articles.abstract_en: Aim This study investigated the guardians’ knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) regarding epilepsy and obesity in children with epilepsy. Methods This cross-sectional survey was conducted from January 2023 to December 2023 at the author’s Hospital, a single-center study involving guardians of children with epilepsy. Results This study included 500 valid questionnaires for analysis. The mean knowledge, attitude, and practice scores were 5.93 ± 3.67 (possible range 0–11, 53.91%), 37.88 ± 4.22 (possible range 10–50, 75.76%), and 13.37 ± 6.45 (possible range 6–30, 44.57%), respectively, indicating moderate knowledge, favorable attitudes, and inactive practice. The structural equation model showed that knowledge directly influenced attitudes (β = 0.716, P < 0.001) and practices (β = 0.350, P < 0.001), and attitudes directly influenced practices (β = 0.817, P < 0.001). Conclusion The results suggest that the guardians of children with epilepsy have moderate knowledge, favorable attitudes, and inactive practices toward epilepsy and obesity.
articles.abstract_cn: 目的 本研究调查了癫痫儿童监护人对癫痫和肥胖的知识、态度和实践（KAP）。方法 本横断面调查于2023年一月至2023年十二月在作者所在医院进行，是一项涉及癫痫儿童监护人的单中心研究。结果 本研究纳入了500份有效问卷进行分析。知识、态度和实践的平均得分分别为5.93 ± 3.67（可能范围0-11，53.91%）、37.88 ± 4.22（可能范围10-50，75.76%）和13.37 ± 6.45（可能范围6-30，44.57%），表明知识水平中等、态度积极、实践不活跃。结构方程模型显示，知识直接影响态度（β = 0.716，P < 0.001）和实践（β = 0.350，P < 0.001），态度直接影响实践（β = 0.817，P < 0.001）。结论 结果表明，癫痫儿童的监护人对癫痫和肥胖的知识水平中等、态度积极、实践不活跃。

articles.title_en: Beyond seizures in Dravet and Lennox–Gastaut syndromes − An Italian Expert Consensus on Non-Seizure issues and the role of fenfluramine
articles.title_cn: 超越Dravet和Lennox–Gastaut综合征的癫痫发作——意大利专家共识：非发作问题及芬氟拉明的作用
articles.abstract_en: Background Dravet syndrome (DS) and Lennox–Gastaut syndrome (LGS) are rare developmental and epileptic encephalopathies (DEEs) in which disability and family burden are driven by seizures and non-seizure issues (NSIs), including cognition, behavior, sleep, communication, motor function, and adaptive abilities. Objective To develop practical consensus statements on NSIs in DS and LGS, integrating NSI evaluation within a DEE framework and appraising the perceived role of fenfluramine (FFA). Methods An Italian panel of 12 epilepsy specialists spanning pediatric and adult practice developed statements using an Estimate–Talk–Estimate process. Consensus was predefined as ≥ 70% agreement (agree/strongly agree). Results Eleven final statements were clustered into three macro-areas, with the first two explored in greater depth: (1) the cross-cutting, lifespan impact of NSIs in DS and LGS; (2) the potential for FFA to provide clinically meaningful benefits across selected NSI domains in DS and, more variably, in LGS, with effects not always fully captured by seizure metrics; and (3) the role of other interventions on NSIs and the need for structured assessment tools. Conclusions Incorporating NSI priorities into shared goal-setting and longitudinal monitoring may improve the clinical relevance of care in DS and LGS. The panel supported an NSI-informed, net-benefit approach to treatment optimization and identified FFA as a relevant option, while recognizing that evidence on NSI outcomes remains heterogeneous and should be strengthened through syndrome-specific, longitudinal assessment.
articles.abstract_cn: 背景 Dravet综合征（DS）和Lennox–Gastaut综合征（LGS）是罕见的发育性和癫痫性脑病（DEEs），其残疾和家庭负担由癫痫发作和非发作问题（NSIs）驱动，包括认知、行为、睡眠、沟通、运动功能和适应能力。目的 制定关于DS和LGS中NSIs的实用共识声明，将NSI评估整合到DEE框架中，并评估芬氟拉明（FFA）的感知作用。方法 一个由12名涵盖儿科和成人实践的意大利癫痫专家组成的小组，采用“估计-讨论-估计”过程制定声明。共识预先定义为≥ 70%的同意（同意/强烈同意）。结果 最终形成十一项声明，分为三个宏观领域，前两个领域进行了更深入的探讨：（1）NSIs在DS和LGS中的跨领域、全生命周期影响；（2）FFA在DS及更可变地在LGS中，对选定NSI领域提供临床有意义益处的潜力，其效果并非总能被癫痫发作指标完全捕捉；（3）其他干预措施对NSIs的作用以及结构化评估工具的需求。结论 将NSI优先事项纳入共同目标设定和纵向监测，可能提高DS和LGS护理的临床相关性。专家组支持以NSI为依据的净效益方法进行治疗优化，并将FFA确定为相关选项，同时认识到关于NSI结局的证据仍具异质性，应通过综合征特异性的纵向评估加以加强。

articles.title_en: Risk of cutaneous adverse reactions to lamotrigine and levetiracetam by age, sex, and reproductive status
articles.title_cn: 拉莫三嗪和左乙拉西坦的皮肤不良反应风险按年龄、性别和生殖状态分层
articles.abstract_en: Purpose To assess the risk of cutaneous adverse drug reactions (CADRs) to lamotrigine (LTG) and levetiracetam (LEV) in relation to age, sex, and reproductive status. Methods We examined 3,379 patients (mean age: 38.2 ± 23.9 years; 49.3% women) who initiated LTG (n = 1,040) or LEV (n = 2,339) between 2008 and 2024. The frequency and severity of CADRs induced by each drug were evaluated. Patients were categorized by age pediatric (0–14 years), young and middle-aged adults (15–64 years), and older adults (≥65 years). We performed univariate and multivariate analyses to identify factors associated with CADR occurrence, including reproductive status. We also assessed age-related trends in CADR frequency and examined the presence of CADRs in relation to childbirth events. Results The frequency of LTG-induced CADRs was 3.2% (n = 33), including six severe cases (0.58%). Female sex was independently associated with LTG-induced CADRs (odds ratio = 2.44, p = 0.022). Among young and middle-aged adults, LTG-induced CADRs were more frequent in women than in men (5.0% vs. 1.4%,p = 0.013). The frequency exhibited an age-related increasing trend across the premenopausal period (p = 0.019) and declined sharply after menopause. Conversely, LEV-induced CADRs were rare (0.086%), mild, and not significantly associated with age or sex. Among 63 childbirth events, no CADRs occurred during the pregnancy period. Conclusions LTG-induced CADRs occurred more frequently in women of reproductive age, whereas LEV demonstrated a favorable safety profile. These findings suggest that age- and sex-related clinical factors, including pregnancy-related information, may be associated with the frequency of LTG-induced CADRs; however, the role of hormonal factors, including hormonal contraception, requires further prospective investigation.
articles.abstract_cn: 目的 评估拉莫三嗪（LTG）和左乙拉西坦（LEV）的皮肤不良反应（CADRs）风险与年龄、性别和生殖状态的关系。方法 我们检查了3,379名患者（平均年龄：38.2 ± 23.9岁；49.3%为女性），这些患者在2008年至2024年间开始使用LTG（n = 1,040）或LEV（n = 2,339）。评估了每种药物引起的CADRs的频率和严重程度。患者按年龄分为儿童（0-14岁）、青壮年（15-64岁）和老年人（≥65岁）。我们进行了单变量和多变量分析，以确定与CADR发生相关的因素，包括生殖状态。我们还评估了CADR频率的年龄相关趋势，并检查了与分娩事件相关的CADRs的存在。结果 LTG诱导的CADRs频率为3.2%（n = 33），包括六例严重病例（0.58%）。女性性别与LTG诱导的CADRs独立相关（比值比 = 2.44，p = 0.022）。在青壮年中，LTG诱导的CADRs在女性中比男性更常见（5.0% vs. 1.4%，p = 0.013）。该频率在绝经前期表现出随年龄增长的趋势（p = 0.019），并在绝经后急剧下降。相反，LEV诱导的CADRs罕见（0.086%），轻微，且与年龄或性别无显著关联。在63次分娩事件中，妊娠期间未发生CADRs。结论 LTG诱导的CADRs在育龄女性中更常见，而LEV显示出良好的安全性。这些发现表明，与年龄和性别相关的临床因素，包括妊娠相关信息，可能与LTG诱导的CADRs的频率有关；然而，激素因素（包括激素避孕）的作用需要进一步的前瞻性研究。

articles.title_en: Position-dependent mass effects on the electronic states of a quantum torus
articles.title_cn: 位置依赖质量效应对量子环面电子态的影响
articles.abstract_en: Geometric effects affect the electronic properties of charged particles in nanostructured semiconductor systems. It is well known that regions of high curvature can induce additional electronic confinement. Motivated by these curvature-induced position-dependent mass effects, we investigate the bound states in a bilayer-graphene toroidal nanostructure with a position-dependent effective mass. Using the effective-mass approximation within a single-band approach, we solve the stationary Schrödinger-like equation in toroidal coordinates, including the geometry-induced da Costa potential and a curvature- and position-dependent effective mass. The mass profile is constructed from a scalar invariant formed by the mean and Gaussian curvatures of the surface, inspired by the local curvature density entering Willmore-type elastic energies. This allows us to reduce the problem to a one-dimensional Hermitian Schrödinger-like equation with a mass-dependent effective potential. Our results show that the curvature-mass coupling controls both the depth and topology of the effective confinement, that negative values of the coupling can split the inner-equator geometric well into two lateral wells separated by a repulsive barrier, and that finite azimuthal angular momentum can shift the dominant localization region toward the outer equator of the torus.
articles.abstract_cn: 几何效应影响纳米结构半导体系统中带电粒子的电子性质。众所周知，高曲率区域可以诱导额外的电子限制。受这些曲率诱导的位置依赖质量效应的启发，我们研究了具有位置依赖有效质量的双层石墨烯环面纳米结构中的束缚态。在单带方法中采用有效质量近似，我们在环面坐标中求解稳态薛定谔类方程，包括几何诱导的达科斯塔势和曲率及位置依赖的有效质量。质量剖面由表面的平均曲率和高斯曲率形成的标量不变量构建，灵感来源于进入Willmore型弹性能的局部曲率密度。这使我们能够将问题简化为具有质量依赖有效势的一维厄米薛定谔类方程。我们的结果表明，曲率-质量耦合控制有效限制的深度和拓扑结构，耦合的负值可以将内赤道几何阱分裂为两个由排斥势垒分隔的侧向阱，并且有限的方位角动量可以将主导局域化区域移向环面的外赤道。

articles.title_en: Depression in people with epilepsy: reliability and validity of the Czech version of Beck Depression Inventory (BDI-II) and Beck Depression Fast Screen (BDI-FS) for major depressive episode
articles.abstract_en: ObjectiveDepression affects up to 55% of people with epilepsy (PWE) yet remains systematically underdiagnosed. This study aimed to evaluate the psychometric properties of the Czech versions of the Beck Depression Inventory–II (BDI-II) and Beck Depression Inventory–Fast Screen (BDI-FS) for identifying major depressive episode (MDE) in PWE. MethodsA cross-sectional study was conducted with n = 278 adult PWE, assessed at the tertiary epilepsy center. MDE diagnosis was established using the Mini International Neuropsychiatric Interview (M.I.N.I. 6.0.0) as the diagnostic gold standard. Psychometric evaluation included internal consistency, test–retest reliability, exploratory factor analysis, diagnostic accuracy via ROC analysis and concurrent validity against the The Neurological Disorders Depression Inventory for Epilepsy (NDDI-E), The Functional Activities Questionnaire (FAQ), and QOLIE-89. Results25% of the sample (n = 70) met criteria for MDE. Both instruments demonstrated excellent reliability (BDI-II: α = 0.93; BDI-FS: α = 0.81) and strong one-month test–retest stability (ICC = 0.84 and 0.79, respectively). Factor analysis replicated a two-factor structure comprising Somatic–Affective and Cognitive dimensions, accounting for 44% of total variance. Both scales correlated strongly with the NDDI-E (ρ ≈ 0.74) and showed expected negative strong correlations with functional capacity and quality of life. ROC analysis identified optimal cutoffs of BDI-II > 14 (AUC = 0.984, sensitivity 95.7%, specificity 95.1%) and BDI-FS > 3 (AUC = 0.925, sensitivity 84.3%, specificity 85.6%). ConclusionThe Czech BDI-II version and its brief alternative BDI-FS are reliable and valid instruments for screening MDE in epilepsy. Implementation of these tools in epilepsy clinics may substantially improve depression detection and patient outcomes.

articles.title_en: What works and what needs to change: Women’s perspectives on pregnancy-related epilepsy care and service improvements in the United Kingdom
articles.title_cn: 什么有效，什么需要改变：英国女性对妊娠相关癫痫护理和服务改进的看法
articles.abstract_en: BackgroundDespite clinical guidelines emphasising coordinated, person-centred care for pregnant women with epilepsy, preventable maternal deaths and suboptimal care continue. PurposeTo explore the perspectives of women with epilepsy on pregnancy-related care and their views on how to improve it. MethodsWe conducted semi-structured interviews with eleven women aged 27–39 years who were currently pregnant or had given birth within the last two years. We recruited participants from across the UK. Data were analysed using reflexive thematic analysis. ResultsThree main themes were identified. Enabling and supportive care was characterised by supportive healthcare professionals as anchors, proactive preconception counselling, collaboration between providers, a single coordinator of care, and access to specialist expertise. Fragmented and inadequate care included absence of informed decision-making, poor coordination, women being left to correct errors in their own care, encounters lacking empathy, limited epilepsy knowledge among non-specialist staff, and over-reliance on remote contact. Priorities for service improvement included early and direct conversations about risks (including SUDEP), respectful and balanced communication, partnership-based adult-to-adult dialogue, in-person consultations, and coordinated, holistic care that includes mental health support. ConclusionDespite longstanding guidelines, women with epilepsy continue to experience significant gaps between recommended standards of pregnancy care and service realities. Women describe deficits in early, proactive discussions about medication and risks, informed decision-making, and joined-up care, leaving some to perform unsupported “safety work”, correcting errors and mediating between neurology, obstetric and midwifery teams. Improving care requires a commitment to holistic, person-centred support that embeds clear, respectful, two-way communication with women and across services as a core safety practice.
articles.abstract_cn: 背景尽管临床指南强调为患有癫痫的孕妇提供协调、以人为本的护理，但可预防的孕产妇死亡和次优护理仍然存在。目的探讨患有癫痫的女性对妊娠相关护理的看法及其对改进护理的意见。方法我们对十一名年龄在27-39岁、目前怀孕或过去两年内分娩的女性进行了半结构化访谈。我们从英国各地招募参与者。数据采用反思性主题分析进行分析。结果确定了三个主要主题。支持性护理的特点包括支持性医疗专业人员作为支柱、主动的孕前咨询、提供者之间的合作、单一护理协调员以及获得专科专业知识。碎片化和不足的护理包括缺乏知情决策、协调不良、女性被迫自行纠正护理中的错误、缺乏同理心的接触、非专科人员对癫痫知识有限，以及过度依赖远程联系。服务改进的优先事项包括早期直接讨论风险（包括SUDEP）、尊重和平衡的沟通、基于伙伴关系的成人对成人对话、面对面咨询，以及包括心理健康支持在内的协调、整体护理。结论尽管有长期存在的指南，患有癫痫的女性在推荐的妊娠护理标准与服务现实之间仍然经历显著差距。女性描述了在药物和风险的早期主动讨论、知情决策和联合护理方面的不足，导致一些人不得不进行无支持的“安全工作”，纠正错误并在神经科、产科和助产团队之间进行调解。改进护理需要致力于整体、以人为本的支持，将清晰、尊重、双向的沟通嵌入与女性及跨服务中，作为核心安全实践。

articles.title_en: MFRIA: Multi-scale feature representation and interactive attention for infrared and visible image fusion
articles.title_cn: MFRIA：面向红外与可见光图像融合的多尺度特征表示与交互注意力
articles.abstract_en: The aim of infrared and visible image fusion is to integrate the thermal semantics and high-fidelity visual details into a fused image. Current fusion approaches have difficulty distinguishing the regions dominated by different modalities, resulting in an over-reliance on a single modality, leading to semantic obscuration or scene distortion. To address this issue, this paper proposes an image fusion network based on multi-scale feature representation and interactive attention (MFRIA). We first employ an independent feature encoding stage to extract initial cross-modal features. The multi-scale feature collection and recombination module is utilized to capture enriched representations, which are then adaptively used to identify dominant regions for feature modulation through a dual-level interactive attention mechanism. Subsequently, the modulated features are combined with the multi-level cues from the encoding stage and reconstructed through a decoding process to synthesize the final fused image. Finally, we design a loss function, which is composed of mask-based pixel loss and multi-order gradient loss to improve the accuracy of region partitioning. The quantitative and qualitative results on the MSRS, M3FD, FLIR, and LLVIP datasets show that MFRIA is capable of producing higher-quality fused images, and is even superior to existing advanced fusion methods. Furthermore, experimental results on object detection and segmentation demonstrate its practical utility, effectively enhancing the performance of high-level vision tasks.
articles.abstract_cn: 红外与可见光图像融合的目标是将热语义和高保真视觉细节整合到融合图像中。当前的融合方法难以区分由不同模态主导的区域，导致过度依赖单一模态，进而引发语义模糊或场景失真。为解决这一问题，本文提出了一种基于多尺度特征表示与交互注意力的图像融合网络（MFRIA）。我们首先采用独立的特征编码阶段来提取初始跨模态特征。利用多尺度特征收集与重组模块捕获丰富的表示，随后通过双层级交互注意力机制自适应地识别主导区域以进行特征调制。接着，将调制后的特征与编码阶段的多层级线索相结合，并通过解码过程重建以合成最终的融合图像。最后，我们设计了一个损失函数，由基于掩膜的像素损失和多阶梯度损失组成，以提高区域划分的准确性。在MSRS、M3FD、FLIR和LLVIP数据集上的定量和定性结果表明，MFRIA能够生成更高质量的融合图像，甚至优于现有的先进融合方法。此外，在目标检测和分割上的实验结果证明了其实用性，有效提升了高级视觉任务的性能。

articles.title_en: Nutrient-sensing pathways in adult stem cells: Orchestrating homeostasis, aging, and disease
articles.title_cn: 成体干细胞中的营养感应通路：协调稳态、衰老与疾病
articles.abstract_en: Nutrient-sensing pathways, including mTOR, AMPK, Sirtuins, and insulin/IGF-1 signaling, are central regulators orchestrating adult stem cell (ASC) fate by dynamically modulating cellular metabolism. This review proposes a framework that integrates these pathways into a cohesive network that dictates the metabolic transitions between quiescence, activation, and differentiation in ASCs. Age-related dysregulation of this network leads to metabolic imbalance and stem cell exhaustion, underpinning tissue degeneration. Interventions such as mTOR inhibitors, AMPK activators, NAD+ precursors, and dietary strategies can rejuvenate ASC function by restoring metabolic balance, underscoring their therapeutic potential for mitigating aging and associated diseases.
articles.abstract_cn: 营养感应通路，包括mTOR、AMPK、Sirtuins和胰岛素/IGF-1信号，是通过动态调节细胞代谢来协调成体干细胞（ASC）命运的核心调控因子。本综述提出了一个框架，将这些通路整合成一个连贯的网络，该网络决定成体干细胞在静息、激活和分化之间的代谢转换。与年龄相关的这一网络失调导致代谢失衡和干细胞耗竭，从而支撑组织退化。诸如mTOR抑制剂、AMPK激活剂、NAD+前体和饮食策略等干预措施可以通过恢复代谢平衡来重建成体干细胞功能，强调其在缓解衰老及相关疾病方面的治疗潜力。

articles.title_en: Cognitive-metabolic relationship in temporal lobe epilepsy: A systematic review
articles.title_cn: 颞叶癫痫中的认知-代谢关系：一项系统综述
articles.abstract_en: ObjectiveTo summarize the current literature on neurometabolic dysfunction identified through brain imaging and its cognitive correlates in temporal lobe epilepsy (TLE). BackgroundCognitive decline contributes to chronic disability in TLE. The pathophysiology of cognitive decline in TLE is poorly understood, limiting therapeutic advances. Characterizing metabolic changes in patients with TLE and cognitive impairment may identify biomarkers and inform new treatment strategies. Design/MethodsWe conducted a systematic review of five major databases, gathering studies published through December 2024, in accordance with PRISMA guidelines. We included all observational studies describing associations between metabolic imaging findings and cognitive measures in TLE. ResultsOf 1449 reports, 38 met the inclusion criteria, encompassing 1161 patients with TLE aged 5–66 years. Twenty-two studies applied fluorodeoxyglucose (18F-FDG) positron emission tomography (PET) to assess interictal brain glucose metabolism. Two studies utilized PET with other tracers to assess more specific metabolic aspects. Fourteen studies used proton magnetic resonance spectroscopy (1H-MRS) to quantify local concentrations of brain metabolites. Impairment of verbal memory was consistently associated with left temporal lobe metabolite changes. Non-memory cognitive impairments correlated with changes in glucose metabolism, N-acetylaspartate, and gamma-aminobutyrate in both temporal and extratemporal areas. Conclusion18F-FDG PET remains the most widely used imaging modality to assess cognitive-metabolic correlates in TLE, while other PET tracers and 1H-MRS are potentially underexplored. Verbal memory impairment correlates robustly with left temporal dysmetabolism. Cognitive impairment in TLE is multifaceted and correlates with measurable changes in metabolism in both temporal and extratemporal regions. While our synthesis was restricted by some methodological limitations, these neurometabolic signatures may hold promise as potential biomarkers for identifying risk of cognitive decline and highlight avenues for future research.
articles.abstract_cn: 目的总结当前关于颞叶癫痫（TLE）中通过脑成像发现的神经代谢功能障碍及其认知相关性的文献。背景认知衰退导致TLE的慢性残疾。TLE中认知衰退的病理生理机制尚不清楚，限制了治疗进展。表征TLE患者及认知障碍患者的代谢变化可能识别生物标志物并为新治疗策略提供信息。设计/方法我们按照PRISMA指南，对五个主要数据库进行了系统综述，收集截至2024年十二月发表的研究。我们纳入了所有描述TLE中代谢成像发现与认知测量之间关联的观察性研究。结果在1449篇报告中，38篇符合纳入标准，涵盖1161名年龄在5-66岁的TLE患者。二十二项研究应用氟脱氧葡萄糖（18F-FDG）正电子发射断层扫描（PET）评估发作间期脑葡萄糖代谢。两项研究使用其他示踪剂的PET评估更具体的代谢方面。十四项研究使用质子磁共振波谱（1H-MRS）量化脑代谢物的局部浓度。言语记忆障碍与左侧颞叶代谢物变化一致相关。非记忆认知障碍与颞叶及颞叶外区域的葡萄糖代谢、N-乙酰天冬氨酸和γ-氨基丁酸的变化相关。结论18F-FDG PET仍是评估TLE中认知-代谢相关性最广泛使用的成像方式，而其他PET示踪剂和1H-MRS可能未被充分探索。言语记忆障碍与左侧颞叶代谢异常密切相关。TLE中的认知障碍是多方面的，并与颞叶及颞叶外区域可测量的代谢变化相关。尽管我们的综合受到一些方法学限制，但这些神经代谢特征可能作为识别认知衰退风险的潜在生物标志物，并为未来研究指明方向。

articles.title_en: Conformational pre-organization in privileged bidentate directing groups
articles.title_cn: 优势双齿导向基团中的构象预组织
articles.abstract_en: The 8-aminoquinoline (AQ) auxiliary occupies a privileged position among bidentate N,N-directing groups in transition metal catalysis, yet the structural basis of its catalytic performance has been rarely examined. Combining a crystallographic survey of free (non-metalated) reaction products with density functional theory (DFT) analysis of model compounds, we show that AQ is conformationally pre-organized and avoids the energetic penalty of reorganization required for binding. In every free-product structure, AQ is locked in a planar, chelation-ready geometry, whereas auxiliaries containing C(sp3)-based spacers—including 2-pyridylmethylamine (PM) and its gem-dimethyl (PIP) and gem-diethyl (PDE) congeners—mostly rest in an anti conformation and must reorganize to bind. This pre-organization is a concrete, measurable structural property that distinguishes AQ from flexible C(sp3)-linked auxiliaries and is a contributing factor that governs which one a shared Pd(II) catalyst preferentially engages under competition, highlighting a design principle for removable bidentate directing groups.
articles.abstract_cn: 8-氨基喹啉（AQ）辅助基团在过渡金属催化中的双齿N,N-导向基团中占据优势地位，然而其催化性能的结构基础鲜有研究。结合自由（非金属化）反应产物的晶体学调查与模型化合物的密度泛函理论（DFT）分析，我们表明AQ在构象上是预组织的，并避免了结合所需重组的能量代价。在每个自由产物结构中，AQ被锁定在平面、螯合就绪的几何构型中，而含有C(sp3)间隔基的辅助基团——包括2-吡啶甲基胺（PM）及其偕二甲基（PIP）和偕二乙基（PDE）同系物——大多处于反式构象，必须重组才能结合。这种预组织是一个具体、可测量的结构特性，将AQ与柔性C(sp3)连接的辅助基团区分开来，并且是决定共享的Pd(II)催化剂在竞争条件下优先选择哪一种的促成因素，突显了可移除双齿导向基团的设计原则。

articles.title_en: Opposing associations of default mode network and subcortical network efficiency with IQ in children with drug-resistant epilepsy
articles.abstract_en: Paediatric drug-resistant epilepsy (DRE) is associated with IQ deficits only partially explained by clinical seizure variables (for example, age of onset, seizure burden, seizure location). Given that intelligence depends on efficient large-scale brain networks, structural connectomics provides a complementary mechanistic framework for explaining residual IQ variance. We tested whether brain-network architecture explains additional IQ variance using global and network-averaged graph-theoretic metrics derived from streamline-count weighted diffusion MRI connectomes. Seventy-one children with DRE (50 focal epilepsy; 21 multifocal epilepsy) and 15 control participants underwent diffusion and T1-weighted MRI. For each participant, a 253 × 253 structural connectome was constructed, edge weights were defined as the number of streamlines, and graph metrics were computed using the Brain Connectivity Toolbox. Nodal metrics were averaged within Yeo’s seven functional networks plus a Subcortical network. Associations with IQ were examined using correlations and general linear models (single-network and eight-predictor models). Finally, mediation analyses tested whether network metrics explained IQ differences between controls and children with DRE. Global metrics were not associated with IQ (all p > 0.05). Regionally, higher Salience-network betweenness centrality showed a nominal negative association with IQ in the multifocal subgroup (p = 0.040*, adjusted R2 = 0.142). In the eight-network GLM, higher nodal efficiency within the Default Mode Network (DMN) was positively associated with IQ (B = 122.406, p = .013), whereas higher nodal efficiency within the Subcortical Network was negatively associated with IQ (B = −51.942, p = .012). These regional associations did not survive Bonferroni correction. Exploratory mediation analyses suggested that opposing DMN and Subcortical Network effects partially accounted for the observed group difference in IQ. These findings are hypothesis-generating, as the regional associations with IQ were nominal and did not survive family-wise correction. Nevertheless, the mediation effects survived correction, highlighting opposing regional, rather than global, network alterations as candidate correlates of IQ variability in paediatric DRE.

articles.title_en: Quantitative electroencephalogram analysis in juvenile myoclonic epilepsy and its clinical significance
articles.title_cn: 青少年肌阵挛癫痫的定量脑电图分析及其临床意义
articles.abstract_en: BackgroundJuvenile myoclonic epilepsy (JME) is among the most prevalent forms of inherited generalized epilepsy in adolescents. It is characterized by photosensitivity and seizures triggered by photic stimulation. Previous magnetoencephalography (MEG) studies have demonstrated abnormal neural dynamics in JME; however, the ability of advanced electroencephalography (EEG) analysis to characterize these abnormalities remains unclear. This exploratory study investigated EEG-derived neurophysiological alterations in patients with JME and their potential relationship to photosensitivity. MethodsWe analyzed EEG features such as temporal correlations, signal complexity, and spectral power distribution in 22 patients with JME and 22 healthy controls. ResultsThe results revealed significant occipital differences between the patient and control groups. Specifically, the patient group had stronger long-range temporal correlations, higher signal complexity, higher relative delta power, and lower relative alpha power than did the control group. These findings correspond to the characteristic photosensitivity observed in JME and provide neurophysiological evidence linking regional brain changes to clinical manifestations. ConclusionsThe spatial and spectral patterns identified through EEG are consistent with previously reported MEG findings. This indicates that advanced EEG is similar to MEG in its ability to characterize neurophysiological activity. These findings highlight EEG as an efficient and accessible tool for the clinical assessment of JME across health-care settings.
articles.abstract_cn: 背景青少年肌阵挛癫痫（JME）是青少年中最常见的遗传性全身性癫痫形式之一，其特征是光敏感性和由光刺激诱发的癫痫发作。先前的脑磁图（MEG）研究已证明JME中存在异常的神经动力学；然而，先进的脑电图（EEG）分析表征这些异常的能力仍不清楚。本探索性研究调查了JME患者中EEG衍生的神经生理学改变及其与光敏感性的潜在关系。方法我们分析了22名JME患者和22名健康对照者的EEG特征，如时间相关性、信号复杂性和频谱功率分布。结果结果显示患者组与对照组之间存在显著的枕叶差异。具体而言，患者组比对照组具有更强的长程时间相关性、更高的信号复杂性、更高的相对δ功率和更低的相对α功率。这些发现与JME中观察到的特征性光敏感性相对应，并为区域脑变化与临床表现之间的联系提供了神经生理学证据。结论通过EEG识别的空间和频谱模式与先前报道的MEG发现一致。这表明先进的EEG在表征神经生理活动方面与MEG相似。这些发现突显了EEG作为一种高效且可及的工具，适用于各种医疗环境中的JME临床评估。

articles.title_en: Beyond focal and generalized: are we classifying seizures, or helping patients? A provocative reappraisal of epilepsy classification in the era of therapeutic pathways
articles.title_cn: 超越局灶性与全面性：我们是在对癫痫发作进行分类，还是在帮助患者？治疗路径时代对癫痫分类的 provocative 重新评估
articles.abstract_en: Every revision of the seizure classification—most recently the 2025 International League Against Epilepsy (ILAE) update—refines terminology, yet it is worth asking whether patients are treated better because their seizures were renamed. The focal versus generalized dichotomy has organized epilepsy classification since the 1960 s and is grounded in a pharmacologic rationale, but head-to-head data from the SANAD trials show that efficacy differences between individual antiseizure medications frequently equal or exceed differences across the focal/generalized boundary. Meanwhile, the distinction that is genuinely transformative—whether an epilepsy is surgically remediable—produces seizure-freedom differences of an entirely different order of magnitude, and yet epilepsy surgery remains among the most underutilized evidence-based treatments in medicine. We argue that classification should elevate therapeutic trajectory over electroclinical phenomenology, and we propose an Interventional Axis built around three pathways: focal resection, neuromodulation, and palliative surgery, operating in parallel with pharmacotherapy rather than after its serial failure. Refining terminology improves communication, but the ultimate metric of a classification is outcome, not taxonomic elegance.
articles.abstract_cn: 每次癫痫发作分类的修订——最近一次是2025年国际抗癫痫联盟（ILAE）的更新——都细化了术语，但值得追问的是，患者是否因为其癫痫发作被重新命名而得到了更好的治疗。局灶性与全面性的二分法自1960年代以来一直组织着癫痫分类，并基于药理学原理，但来自SANAD试验的头对头数据显示，个别抗癫痫药物之间的疗效差异常常等于或超过跨越局灶/全面性边界的差异。与此同时，真正具有变革性的区分——即癫痫是否可通过手术治愈——所产生的无发作差异完全是另一个数量级，然而癫痫手术仍然是医学中最未被充分利用的循证治疗之一。我们认为，分类应优先考虑治疗轨迹而非电临床现象学，并提议构建一个围绕三条路径的干预轴：局灶切除、神经调控和姑息性手术，这些路径与药物治疗并行运作，而非在其连续失败之后。细化术语改善了沟通，但分类的最终衡量标准是结果，而非分类学的优雅。

articles.title_en: A network approach with motion sequencing reveals hidden patterns of repetitive behavior in a pre-clinical model of epilepsy
articles.title_cn: 一种结合运动序列的网络方法揭示了癫痫临床前模型中重复行为的隐藏模式
articles.abstract_en: Epilepsy is the 4th most prevalent neurological condition with 50 million cases worldwide. Patients with epilepsy bare a disproportionate burden of cognitive decline and psychiatric disorders which remain poorly understood and go unaddressed by current anti-epileptic treatments. Furthermore, pre-clinical work on behavioral comorbidities can be hampered by current testing frameworks which rely on well-defined, discreet tests with limited repeatability. Recent work has demonstrated a role for machine learning modalities such as Motion Sequencing (MoSeq) in assessing behavioral differences between naïve and epileptic. In this study we combined MoSeq with a novel analysis pipeline to uncover repetitive behaviors in chronically epileptic mice. These repetitive behaviors emerge alongside epilepsy specific racing behaviors which persist in epileptic mice as disease progresses. We show that epileptic mice have more fragile and dispersed behavioral networks. Finally, we test this pipeline using the FDA approved anti-seizure medication carbamazepine, showing a rescue of racing syllable and a partial rescue of behavioral network dispersion. Together, these results lay a groundwork for extracting clinically relevant phenotypes from MoSeq data throughout disease progression.
articles.abstract_cn: 癫痫是4种最常见的神经系统疾病，全球有50百万病例。癫痫患者承受着认知衰退和精神疾病的沉重负担，这些症状目前仍未被充分理解，且现有的抗癫痫治疗未能解决。此外，临床前行为合并症的研究可能受到当前测试框架的限制，这些框架依赖于定义明确、离散且可重复性有限的测试。近期工作已证明机器学习模式如运动序列（MoSeq）在评估天真和癫痫个体行为差异中的作用。在本研究中，我们将MoSeq与一种新颖的分析流程相结合，以揭示慢性癫痫小鼠中的重复行为。这些重复行为与癫痫特有的竞速行为一同出现，并在疾病进展中持续存在于癫痫小鼠中。我们显示癫痫小鼠具有更脆弱和分散的行为网络。最后，我们使用FDA批准的抗癫痫药物卡马西平测试了这一流程，显示竞速音节得到恢复，行为网络分散得到部分恢复。总之，这些结果为从MoSeq数据中提取疾病进展过程中的临床相关表型奠定了基础。

articles.title_en: Towards domain generalization for underwater object detection through diversity enhancement and multi-view consistency
articles.title_cn: 面向水下目标检测的域泛化：通过多样性增强与多视角一致性
articles.abstract_en: In underwater object detection tasks, models are typically trained on source domains with limited domain diversity and deployed in unknown real-world environments. However, the gap in distribution between source domains and target domains leads to significant domain shifts, severely degrading the generalization performance of detection models in unseen scenarios. Enhancing generalization relies on two core principles: training detectors across diverse domains to learn domain-invariant representations, and ensuring consistent prediction distributions for images with identical semantic content across domains. Based on these principles, we propose a domain generalization approach for underwater object detection based on Diversity Enhancement and Multi-view Consistency (DEMC). Unlike existing methods that perturb only at the image or feature level, DEMC operates at both levels. At the image level, we design a Statistical Priori-based Random Spectrum Transformation (SP-RST) module. By analyzing the spectral characteristics of images from various underwater scenes, SP-RST generates color-shift noise that aligns with underwater image properties, replacing domain-specific information in the source images within the frequency space, effectively enhancing the domain diversity of available source domain data. At the feature level, we introduce a Global Uncertainty estimation-guided Feature Perturbation (GUFP) method. This involves sampling global training instances and constructing a memory bank to maintain an estimate of the global distribution of feature statistics. Perturbations are then applied to instance-level feature statistics based on this global estimate, improving the model’s adaptability and generalization stability to unknown domain feature distributions. Finally, we establish a multi-path consistency learning paradigm that imposes constraints on prediction consistency across different paths, effectively guiding the model to capture semantic content instead of domain-specific information. We conducted extensive experiments on the S-UODAC dataset to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method, and it outperforms the current state-of-the-art underwater domain generalization methods in both quantitative and qualitative results.
articles.abstract_cn: 在水下目标检测任务中，模型通常在域多样性有限的源域上训练，并部署到未知的真实世界环境中。然而，源域与目标域之间的分布差距导致显著的域偏移，严重降低了检测模型在未见场景中的泛化性能。增强泛化依赖于两个核心原则：在多样域上训练检测器以学习域不变表示，以及确保跨域具有相同语义内容的图像预测分布一致。基于这些原则，我们提出了一种基于多样性增强与多视角一致性（DEMC）的水下目标检测域泛化方法。与现有仅在图像或特征层面扰动的方法不同，DEMC在两层同时操作。在图像层面，我们设计了一个基于统计先验的随机频谱变换（SP-RST）模块。通过分析不同水下场景图像的频谱特性，SP-RST生成与水下图像属性一致的色彩偏移噪声，在频率空间中替换源图像中的域特定信息，有效增强可用源域数据的域多样性。在特征层面，我们引入了一种全局不确定性估计引导的特征扰动（GUFP）方法。这涉及采样全局训练实例并构建记忆库以维持特征统计的全局分布估计。然后基于该全局估计对实例级特征统计进行扰动，提高模型对未知域特征分布的适应性和泛化稳定性。最后，我们建立了一种多路径一致性学习范式，对不同路径的预测一致性施加约束，有效引导模型捕获语义内容而非域特定信息。我们在S-UODAC数据集上进行了广泛实验以验证所提方法的有效性，在定量和定性结果上均优于当前最先进的水下域泛化方法。

articles.title_en: Sleep stage-dependent distribution of interictal epileptiform discharges in epilepsy: A systematic review
articles.title_cn: 癫痫发作间期癫痫样放电的睡眠阶段依赖性分布：系统评价
articles.abstract_en: Background Sleep and epilepsy interact through complex bidirectional mechanisms. Although NREM sleep facilitates interictal epileptiform discharges (IED), the diagnostic contribution of individual sleep stages remains uncertain. In particular, it is unclear whether deeper sleep stages such as N3 provide an advantage over N2 for spike detection or localization in clinical (electroencephalography) EEG practice. Methods This systematic review followed PRISMA 2020 guidelines. PubMed and Web of Science were searched for studies reporting quantitative IED measures across sleep stages in patients with epilepsy. Eligible studies included scalp EEG, video-EEG, polysomnography, or intracranial recordings. Mean IED rates per minute were derived when possible. Comparisons between NREM and REM sleep and between N2 and N3 stages were performed using study level non-parametric tests. Risk of bias was assessed with the ROBINS-I tool. Results Ten observational studies including 266 patients (mean age 30.1 years) were analyzed. IED rates were significantly higher during NREM than REM sleep (Wilcoxon signed-rank test, W = 0, p = 0.0019, r = 0.87). No significant difference was observed between N2 and N3 sleep, although median spike rates were slightly higher during N3 than N2 (0.99 vs 0.86 IED/min). REM showed the lowest activity. Conclusions NREM sleep consistently exhibited higher IED rates than REM sleep, reinforcing the neurophysiological association between sleep stage and epileptiform activity without establishing diagnostic superiority.
articles.abstract_cn: 背景 睡眠和癫痫通过复杂的双向机制相互作用。尽管 NREM 睡眠有利于发作间期癫痫样放电 (IED)，但各个睡眠阶段的诊断作用仍不确定。特别是，目前尚不清楚在临床（脑电图）脑电图实践中，较深的睡眠阶段（例如 N3）在尖峰检测或定位方面是否比 N2 更具优势。方法 本系统评价遵循 PRISMA 2020 指南。检索了 PubMed 和 Web of Science，查找报告癫痫患者整个睡眠阶段的定量简易爆炸装置测量值的研究。符合条件的研究包括头皮脑电图、视频脑电图、多导睡眠图或颅内记录。在可能的情况下得出每分钟的平均简易爆炸装置速率。使用研究级非参数检验对 NREM 和 REM 睡眠以及 N2 和 N3 阶段之间进行比较。使用 ROBINS-I 工具评估偏倚风险。结果 分析了十项观察性研究，包括 266 名患者（平均年龄 30.1 岁）。 NREM 睡眠期间的 IED 发生率显着高于 REM 睡眠期间（Wilcoxon 符号秩检验，W = 0，p = 0.0019，r = 0.87）。 N2 和 N3 睡眠之间没有观察到显着差异，尽管 N3 期间的中位峰值率略高于 N2（0.99 与 0.86 IED/min）。 REM 显示出最低的活性。结论 NREM 睡眠始终表现出比 REM 睡眠更高的 IED 发生率，强化了睡眠阶段与癫痫样活动之间的神经生理学关联，但没有建立诊断优势。

articles.title_en: A V-shaped bis-coumarin fluorescent probe for cadaverine detection and its application in visual monitoring of meat freshness
articles.title_cn: 一种用于尸胺检测的V型双香豆素荧光探针及其在肉类新鲜度视觉监测中的应用
articles.abstract_en: Cadaverine (Cad) is a key biogenic amine marker produced during meat spoilage, and its rapid and sensitive detection is essential for food safety. Herein, a series of V-shaped bis-coumarin-based fluorescent probes were designed and synthesized, among which SWJT-47 was selected as an effective probe for Cad detection. SWJT-47 showed a pronounced “turn-on” fluorescence response in the presence of Cad, enabling the rapid and selective detection of Cad with a detection limit as low as 22.7 nM. Furthermore, portable test strips were fabricated for the rapid on-site qualitative/semi-quantitative screening of shrimp and beef freshness.
articles.abstract_cn: 尸胺（Cad）是肉类腐败过程中产生的一种关键生物胺标志物，其快速、灵敏的检测对食品安全至关重要。本文设计并合成了一系列基于V型双香豆素的荧光探针，其中SWJT-47被选为用于Cad检测的有效探针。SWJT-47在Cad存在下表现出显著的“开启”荧光响应，能够实现Cad的快速选择性检测，检测限低至22.7 nM。此外，制备了便携式测试条，用于虾和牛肉新鲜度的现场快速定性/半定量筛查。

articles.title_en: On inverse problems, parameter estimation, and domain generalization
articles.title_cn: 关于反问题、参数估计和域泛化
articles.abstract_en: Signal restoration and inverse problems are key elements in most real-world data science applications. In the past decades, with the emergence of machine learning methods, inversion of measurements has become a popular step in almost all physical applications, normally executed prior to downstream tasks that often involve parameter estimation. In this work, we propose a general framework for theoretical analysis of parameter estimation in inverse problem settings. We distinguish between continuous and discrete parameter estimation, corresponding with regression and classification problems, respectively. We investigate this setting for invertible and non-invertible degradation processes, with parameter estimation that is executed directly from the observed measurements, comparing with parameter estimation after data-processing performing an inversion of the observations. Our theoretical findings align with the well-known information-theoretic data processing inequality, and to a certain degree question the common misconception that data-processing for inversion, based on modern generative models that may often produce outstanding perceptual quality, will necessarily improve the following parameter estimation objective. Importantly, by re-formulating the domain-shift problem in direct relation with discrete parameter estimation, we expose a significant vulnerability in current popular practical attempts to enforce domain generalization, which we dubbed the Double Meaning Theorem. These theoretical findings are experimentally illustrated for domain shift examples in image deblurring and speckle suppression in medical imaging. It is our hope that this paper will provide practitioners with deeper insights that may be leveraged in the future for the development of more efficient and informed strategic system planning, critical in safety-sensitive applications.
articles.abstract_cn: 信号恢复和反演问题是大多数现实世界数据科学应用中的关键要素。 In the past decades, with the emergence of machine learning methods, inversion of measurements has become a popular step in almost all physical applications, normally executed prior to downstream tasks that often involve parameter estimation.在这项工作中，我们提出了一个用于逆问题设置中参数估计理论分析的通用框架。我们区分连续参数估计和离散参数估计，分别对应于回归和分类问题。 We investigate this setting for invertible and non-invertible degradation processes, with parameter estimation that is executed directly from the observed measurements, comparing with parameter estimation after data-processing performing an inversion of the observations. Our theoretical findings align with the well-known information-theoretic data processing inequality, and to a certain degree question the common misconception that data-processing for inversion, based on modern generative models that may often produce outstanding perceptual quality, will necessarily improve the following parameter estimation objective. Importantly, by re-formulating the domain-shift problem in direct relation with discrete parameter estimation, we expose a significant vulnerability in current popular practical attempts to enforce domain generalization, which we dubbed the Double Meaning Theorem. These theoretical findings are experimentally illustrated for domain shift examples in image deblurring and speckle suppression in medical imaging. It is our hope that this paper will provide practitioners with deeper insights that may be leveraged in the future for the development of more efficient and informed strategic system planning, critical in safety-sensitive applications.

articles.title_en: SCUGSC: Robust model fitting via spatial consensus unit guided sampling consensus for feature matching
articles.title_cn: SCUGSC：基于空间一致性单元引导采样共识的鲁棒模型拟合用于特征匹配
articles.abstract_en: Robust model fitting serves as a critical component in artificial intelligence and computer vision, extensively employed for geometric model estimation from image feature correspondences. Sampling strategy is key to robust model fitting. However, traditional algorithms like RANSAC struggle to sample all-inlier minimal subsets under high outlier ratios or multi-structure scenarios. To address this issue, a robust sampling algorithm for model fitting, termed SCUGSC, is proposed in this paper. This algorithm constructs Spatial Consensus Units (SCUs) to capture local correlations and geometric consistency, which then guide data subset selection. Candidate points with the highest consistency are selected as initial subset elements and expanded via compatibility scores. A subset refinement strategy and an SCU-based stopping criterion further enhance estimation accuracy and convergence stability under low inlier ratios. Experiments on five challenging datasets demonstrate that SCUGSC significantly outperforms seven state-of-the-art methods. SUCGSC achieves the lowest segmentation error of 0.50%, with 98.97% F-score and 98.21% precision on CIAP. Across all datasets, SCUGSC achieves an average F-score of 93.49%, substantially outperforming RANSAC, while maintaining competitive computational efficiency with runtime ranging from 0.10s to 0.25s. These results validate the effectiveness and robustness of SCUGSC in high-outlier-ratio and multi-structure scenarios.
articles.abstract_cn: 鲁棒模型拟合是人工智能和计算机视觉中的关键组成部分，广泛用于从图像特征对应关系中估计几何模型。采样策略是鲁棒模型拟合的关键。然而，传统算法如RANSAC在高异常值比例或多结构场景下难以采样出全内点的最小子集。为解决此问题，本文提出了一种鲁棒的模型拟合采样算法，称为SCUGSC。该算法构建空间一致性单元（SCUs）以捕捉局部相关性和几何一致性，进而指导数据子集选择。具有最高一致性的候选点被选为初始子集元素，并通过兼容性分数进行扩展。子集细化策略和基于SCU的停止准则进一步提高了低内点比例下的估计精度和收敛稳定性。在五个具有挑战性的数据集上的实验表明，SCUGSC显著优于七种最先进的方法。SCUGSC在CIAP上实现了最低的分割误差0.50%，F分数为98.97%，精确率为98.21%。在所有数据集上，SCUGSC的平均F分数达到93.49%，显著优于RANSAC，同时保持了具有竞争力的计算效率，运行时间在0.10到0.25之间。这些结果验证了SCUGSC在高异常值比例和多结构场景下的有效性和鲁棒性。

articles.title_en: Fast algorithm for pseudo-polar linear canonical transform
articles.title_cn: 伪极线性正则变换的快速算法
articles.abstract_en: In two-dimensional signal processing, the polar linear canonical transform (PLCT) offers a more intuitive and effective approach for analyzing geometric invariance, such as rotation and scaling. However, this method primarily relies on two-dimensional direct computation, it suffers from high computational complexity, which limits its efficiency in practical applications. To address this limitation, we propose a Pseudo-Polar Linear Canonical Transform (PPLCT) method based on a pseudo-polar grid, along with its corresponding fast algorithm. First, the PPLCT is defined and its relevant properties are derived in detail. Second, a fast forward and inverse transform algorithms for the PPLCT are proposed based on the combination of Chirp-z transform and linear canonical transform, and the computational complexity of the algorithm is further analyzed. We apply the algorithm to the field of computed tomography (CT). Finally, simulation experiments verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.
articles.abstract_cn: 在二维信号处理中，极线性正则变换（PLCT）为分析几何不变性（例如旋转和缩放）提供了更直观、更有效的方法。然而，该方法主要依赖于二维直接计算，计算复杂度较高，限制了其在实际应用中的效率。为了解决这个限制，我们提出了一种基于伪极网格的伪极线性正则变换（PPLCT）方法及其相应的快速算法。首先定义了PPLCT并详细推导了其相关性质。其次，提出了一种基于Chirp-z变换和线性正则变换相结合的PPLCT快速正反变换算法，并进一步分析了该算法的计算复杂度。我们将该算法应用于计算机断层扫描（CT）领域。最后，仿真实验验证了所提算法的有效性。

articles.title_en: Large-scale incomplete multi-view clustering via efficient and simple anchor graph with attention minibatch bagging
articles.title_cn: 基于注意力小批量袋装的高效简单锚图大规模不完整多视图聚类
articles.abstract_en: Large-scale incomplete multi-view clustering (LsIMC) has attracted increasing attention in recent years as a key technique for unsupervised multi-view data analysis. Among them, anchor-based methods have attracted widespread attention due to their low computational overhead. However, due to the complex optimization process, its performance is mainly constrained by the high complexity of the method and the anchor selection scheme, while the iterative update mechanism poses a challenge for efficient GPU deployment. In this paper, we propose an Efficient and Simple Anchor Graph with Attention Minibatch Bagging (ESAG-AMB), which effectively tackles the challenge of large-scale incomplete multi-view clustering in a non-optimization manner, achieving highly accurate clustering results efficiently through a single commercial GPU. Specifically, the anchor graph is simply constructed with the Scaled Dot-Product Attention kernel, avoiding optimization operations while easing GPU deployment with linear complexity. Then, the Multi-view Bagging Anchor Graphs framework is introduced to bootstrap inter-view and intra-view graphs in order to obtain a more robust unified anchor graph, thereby addressing the challenging anchor selection problem. Finally, the anchor and sample minibatch scheme is designed to fully leverage GPU acceleration for LsIMC. Extensive experimental results on five public large-scale datasets demonstrate that our ESAG-AMB outperforms several state-of-the-art efficient baselines in terms of evaluation metrics and runtime performance.
articles.abstract_cn: 大规模不完整多视图聚类（LsIMC）近年来作为无监督多视图数据分析的关键技术引起了越来越多的关注。其中，基于锚点的方法因其较低的计算开销而受到广泛关注。然而，由于复杂的优化过程，其性能主要受限于方法的高复杂性和锚点选择方案，而迭代更新机制对高效的GPU部署构成了挑战。本文提出了一种高效简单的锚图与注意力小批量袋装方法（ESAG-AMB），以非优化方式有效应对大规模不完整多视图聚类的挑战，通过单个商用GPU实现高精度的聚类结果。具体而言，锚图通过缩放点积注意力核简单构建，避免了优化操作，同时以线性复杂度简化了GPU部署。然后，引入多视图袋装锚图框架，对视图间和视图内图进行自助采样，以获得更鲁棒的统一锚图，从而解决具有挑战性的锚点选择问题。最后，设计了锚点和小批量方案，以充分利用GPU加速LsIMC。在五个公开的大规模数据集上的广泛实验结果表明，我们的ESAG-AMB在评估指标和运行时间性能方面优于几种最先进的高效基线方法。

articles.title_en: Robust RIS-aided secure NOMA-ISAC system for post-disaster management
articles.title_cn: 面向灾后管理的稳健RIS辅助安全NOMA-ISAC系统
articles.abstract_en: Our paper focuses on a generalized reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) assisted secure non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) system. Specifically, we analyze the combined impact of hardware impairments for transceivers at the ISAC-enabled base station, phase errors at the RIS, and aggregated distortion noise at the NOMA users. Additionally, we integrate channel estimation errors for all links into the analysis of achievable rates and secrecy performance in the proposed scheme. Furthermore, a RIS phase optimization framework is developed to maximize the achievable secrecy rate under practical hardware impairments (HWI), where particle swarm optimization (PSO), grey wolf optimization (GWO), and manifold optimization (MO) are employed and comparatively evaluated. The sensing performance of the proposed system is further characterized by deriving the sensing SINR under HWI, and the detection probability is evaluated via Monte Carlo simulation using a Swerling I target model with a constant false alarm rate (CFAR) detector. To validate our findings, we present simulations across various parameters, examining the analytical results over Rician fading channels. Moreover, the proposed RIS-assisted NOMA-ISAC architecture is intended to support resilient connectivity, situational awareness, and physical-layer security in post-disaster management scenarios, where communication infrastructures are severely damaged or unavailable.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一个广义的可重构智能表面（RIS）辅助的安全非正交多址接入（NOMA）集成感知与通信（ISAC）系统。具体而言，我们分析了ISAC基站收发器硬件损伤、RIS处相位误差以及NOMA用户处聚合失真噪声的综合影响。此外，我们将所有链路的信道估计误差纳入所提方案的可达速率和保密性能分析中。进一步地，我们开发了一个RIS相位优化框架，以在实际硬件损伤（HWI）下最大化可达保密速率，其中采用了粒子群优化（PSO）、灰狼优化（GWO）和流形优化（MO）并进行比较评估。通过推导HWI下的感知信干噪比（SINR）来进一步表征所提系统的感知性能，并使用Swerling I目标模型和恒虚警率（CFAR）检测器通过蒙特卡洛仿真评估检测概率。为验证我们的发现，我们展示了不同参数下的仿真结果，并在莱斯衰落信道上检验了分析结果。此外，所提出的RIS辅助NOMA-ISAC架构旨在支持灾后管理场景中的弹性连接、态势感知和物理层安全，在这些场景中通信基础设施严重受损或不可用。

articles.title_en: Convolution for the anti-causal system defined on isolated time scales
articles.title_cn: 孤立时间尺度上反因果系统的卷积
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a rigorous theory of convolution for anti-causal linear time-invariant (LTI) systems on isolated nonuniform time scales. We resolve a fundamental inconsistency in the existing Bohner–Guseinov shift operator by introducing a modified boundary-value problem, and show that the shift defined via bilateral delta Laplace inversion uniquely satisfies this formulation. Explicit shift formulas for the impulse, unit step, ramp, and exponential functions are derived. Convolution is then defined for anti-causal systems, and the main result establishes that the bilateral delta Laplace transform of the convolution of two functions factors as the product of their individual transforms, under explicit uniform-convergence conditions. As an application, we characterise all LTI systems on isolated time scales via their impulse response and derive the transfer function relation. First- and second-order anti-causal systems are analysed in detail, and the effect of non-uniform graininess on the impulse response is quantified numerically for a jittered grid.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文为孤立非均匀时间尺度上的反因果线性时不变（LTI）系统建立了严格的卷积理论。我们通过引入修正的边值问题，解决了现有Bohner–Guseinov移位算子中的基本不一致性，并证明了通过双边delta拉普拉斯逆变换定义的移位唯一满足该公式。推导了脉冲、单位阶跃、斜坡和指数函数的显式移位公式。随后为反因果系统定义了卷积，主要结果确立了在显式一致收敛条件下，两个函数卷积的双边delta拉普拉斯变换可分解为其各自变换的乘积。作为应用，我们通过脉冲响应刻画了孤立时间尺度上的所有LTI系统，并推导了传递函数关系。详细分析了一阶和二阶反因果系统，并在抖动网格上数值量化了非均匀粒度对脉冲响应的影响。

articles.title_en: Underwater image enhancement via frequency–spatial interaction gating for multi-scale features
articles.title_cn: 基于频率-空间交互门控的多尺度特征水下图像增强
articles.abstract_en: Underwater image enhancement requires a delicate balance between restoring local contrast and maintaining global color consistency, as coupled degradations often lead to non-uniform color casts and scattering-induced detail loss. While frequency-domain modeling has recently gained attention, most existing approaches primarily focus on global feature representation or passive filtering, lacking a mechanism where frequency-domain cues actively modulate spatial reconstruction. In this paper, we propose FSINet, a multi-scale underwater image enhancement network built upon a frequency-spatial interaction (FSI) mechanism that interprets frequency-domain signals as adaptive control cues rather than mere features. Instead of treating frequency and spatial branches as parallel pathways, our FSI unit leverages complex-valued frequency modeling to actively modulate spatial feature updates through frequency-conditioned gating. Specifically, the Complex Frequency Interaction (CFI) module performs degradation-aware magnitude–phase interaction in the Fourier domain to generate frequency guidance signals for adaptive spatial modulation. These signals are then transformed into adaptive gating parameters in the dual-scaled context aggregation (DSCA) module, enabling structured frequency-to-spatial modulation of multi-scale context. Qualitative analysis and extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that this frequency-to-spatial interaction paradigm offers superior flexibility and robustness, achieving a favorable efficiency-quality trade-off for real-world underwater applications.
articles.abstract_cn: 水下图像增强需要在恢复局部对比度和保持全局颜色一致性之间取得精细平衡，因为耦合退化常常导致不均匀的色偏和散射引起的细节损失。尽管频域建模近年来受到关注，但大多数现有方法主要侧重于全局特征表示或被动滤波，缺乏一种机制使频域线索主动调制空间重建。在本文中，我们提出FSINet，一种基于频率-空间交互（FSI）机制的多尺度水下图像增强网络，该机制将频域信号解释为自适应控制线索而非单纯特征。我们的FSI单元不将频率和空间分支视为并行路径，而是利用复值频率建模，通过频率条件门控主动调制空间特征更新。具体而言，复频率交互（CFI）模块在傅里叶域执行退化感知的幅度-相位交互，以生成用于自适应空间调制的频率引导信号。这些信号随后在双尺度上下文聚合（DSCA）模块中被转换为自适应门控参数，实现对多尺度上下文的结构化频率到空间调制。定性分析和跨多个基准的广泛实验表明，这种频率到空间的交互范式提供了优越的灵活性和鲁棒性，为真实世界水下应用实现了良好的效率-质量权衡。

articles.title_en: Predictive uncertainty estimation for UWB radar-based indoor occupancy counting under signal degradation
articles.title_cn: 信号退化下基于UWB雷达的室内占用计数预测不确定性估计
articles.abstract_en: Reliable indoor people counting under real-world signal degradation remains an open challenge for radar-based sensing systems. This paper presents an uncertainty-aware framework for indoor people counting using ultra-wideband (UWB) radar, with a primary focus on maintaining predictive reliability when measurement conditions deviate from controlled settings. Radar echo signals are processed into spatiotemporal representations and passed to a CNN-SepAttention network—a convolutional architecture adapted from MobileNetV3 and augmented with channel and spatial attention modules—which serves as the deterministic backbone for occupancy classification. Three uncertainty estimation methods are incorporated into this backbone: Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout for approximate Bayesian inference, Deep Ensemble, and Spectral-normalized Neural Gaussian Process (SNGP). Evaluations on corrupted radar datasets demonstrate that uncertainty-aware models substantially outperform the deterministic baseline under degraded signal conditions. The MC Dropout model retains 36% counting accuracy at 0 dB signal-to-noise ratio, compared with 9% for the deterministic model, and achieves markedly improved calibration with lower negative log-likelihood under signal interference. The SNGP model produces well-calibrated predictive probabilities with principled uncertainty estimates across varying noise levels, suitable for practical deployment scenarios where model trustworthiness matters as much as accuracy. On clean experimental data, the Deep Ensemble configuration achieves up to 99.3% counting accuracy across evaluations. These findings indicate that embedding principled uncertainty estimation into UWB radar-based sensing pipelines yields meaningful and measurable gains in both robustness and predictive reliability for indoor occupancy monitoring.
articles.abstract_cn: 在真实世界信号退化条件下可靠的室内人员计数仍然是雷达传感系统面临的开放挑战。本文提出了一种基于超宽带（UWB）雷达的室内人员计数不确定性感知框架，主要关注在测量条件偏离受控设置时保持预测可靠性。雷达回波信号被处理为时空表示，并输入到CNN-SepAttention网络——一种从MobileNetV3改编并增强有通道和空间注意力模块的卷积架构——作为占用分类的确定性主干。三种不确定性估计方法被纳入该主干：用于近似贝叶斯推断的蒙特卡洛（MC）Dropout、深度集成和谱归一化神经高斯过程（SNGP）。在损坏雷达数据集上的评估表明，在退化信号条件下，不确定性感知模型显著优于确定性基线。MC Dropout模型在信噪比为0 dB时保留了36%的计数准确率，而确定性模型仅为9%，并且在信号干扰下实现了显著改善的校准和更低的负对数似然。SNGP模型在不同噪声水平下产生良好校准的预测概率和原则性的不确定性估计，适用于模型可信度与准确性同等重要的实际部署场景。在干净的实验数据上，深度集成配置在评估中实现了高达99.3%的计数准确率。这些发现表明，将原则性的不确定性估计嵌入基于UWB雷达的传感流程中，为室内占用监测的鲁棒性和预测可靠性带来了有意义且可衡量的提升。

articles.title_en: GSDL-Net: A gaussian sparse localization ship detection model for cross-domain multi-source data fusion
articles.title_cn: GSDL-Net：一种面向跨域多源数据融合的高斯稀疏定位船舶检测模型
articles.abstract_en: Ship detection plays a crucial role in the maritime domain, with Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) and Optical Remote Sensing (ORS) technologies providing essential support for ship monitoring. SAR provides all-weather imaging, whereas ORS excels in identifying target shapes and textures. However, existing cross-domain detection methods often focus on single-source data, limiting their effectiveness. To address this, we propose GSDL-Net (Gaussian Sparse Detail Localization-Net), a ship detection model based on cross-domain multi-source data fusion, inspired by the multimodal fusion mechanisms of the human visual cortex and Gaussian sparse localization theory. First, the Contextual Similarity-Enhanced Attention (CSE) module is designed to optimize shared features across different domains by focusing on similarities, thereby enhancing feature recognition and maintaining high precision in multi-source data fusion scenarios. Next, the Skewed Gaussian Attention (SGA) module is introduced to mitigate the dependency of self-attention weights on feature domain similarity. It improves detection precision in spatial and multi-scale domains and strengthens the learning of multi-source data fusion features. Finally, the lightweight Gaussian Detection Head for Sparse Localization (SGD) module reduces computational complexity by dynamically weighting features and using Gaussian shared convolutions, making it suitable for deployment on edge devices. Experimental results show that GSDL-Net achieves detection accuracies of 91.1% and 83.7% on SAR and ORS datasets, respectively, and 85.8% on fused multi-source datasets. The model’s parameter count (#Param) and floating-point operations (FLOPs) are reduced to 2.0M and 5.8G, respectively, highlighting its robust cross-domain performance and lightweight advantages, demonstrating the significant potential of multi-source detection models for practical applications.
articles.abstract_cn: 船舶检测在海洋领域发挥着至关重要的作用，合成孔径雷达（SAR）和光学遥感（ORS）技术为船舶监测提供了重要支持。SAR提供全天候成像，而ORS在识别目标形状和纹理方面表现出色。然而，现有的跨域检测方法通常侧重于单源数据，限制了其有效性。为解决这一问题，我们提出了GSDL-Net（高斯稀疏细节定位网络），一种基于跨域多源数据融合的船舶检测模型，灵感来源于人类视觉皮层的多模态融合机制和高斯稀疏定位理论。首先，设计了上下文相似性增强注意力（CSE）模块，通过关注相似性来优化不同域间的共享特征，从而增强特征识别并在多源数据融合场景中保持高精度。其次，引入了偏斜高斯注意力（SGA）模块，以减轻自注意力权重对特征域相似性的依赖。它提高了空间和多尺度域中的检测精度，并加强了对多源数据融合特征的学习。最后，轻量级高斯稀疏定位检测头（SGD）模块通过动态加权特征和使用高斯共享卷积来降低计算复杂度，使其适用于边缘设备部署。实验结果表明，GSDL-Net在SAR和ORS数据集上的检测精度分别达到91.1%和83.7%，在融合多源数据集上达到85.8%。模型的参数量（#Param）和浮点运算量（FLOPs）分别减少到2.0M和5.8G，突显了其强大的跨域性能和轻量化优势，展示了多源检测模型在实际应用中的巨大潜力。

articles.title_en: Bioinspired cercosporin mediated photocatalysed synthesis of isoxazoles derivatives
articles.title_cn: 仿生尾孢菌素介导的光催化合成异噁唑衍生物
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd. An efficient one-pot, visible light-induced cercosporin catalyzed isoxazole formation from benzaldehyde oxime along with phenyl(phenylethynyl)sulfane has been developed at room temperature under an air atmosphere via intramolecular cyclisation. This reaction provides a straightforward, environmentally friendly, and sustainable method for producing a variety of substituted isooxazoles having therapeutic significance under mild reaction conditions. This method satisfies the fundamental principles of green chemistry with substantial yields, facile purification, and the avoidance of expensive or hazardous chemicals.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd. 开发了一种高效的一锅法、可见光诱导的尾孢菌素催化反应，在室温、空气氛围下，通过分子内环化由苯甲醛肟与苯基(苯乙炔基)硫烷形成异噁唑。该反应提供了一种直接、环境友好且可持续的方法，在温和反应条件下生产多种具有治疗意义的取代异噁唑。该方法符合绿色化学的基本原则，具有显著产率、易于纯化以及避免使用昂贵或危险化学品的特点。

articles.title_en: Visible-light-promoted cascade alkylation/annulation of <ce:italic>N</ce:italic>-alkene-linked indoles with diazo compounds toward esterified pyrrolo[1,2-<ce:italic>a</ce:italic>]indoles
articles.title_cn: 可见光促进的N-烯烃连接吲哚与重氮化合物的级联烷基化/环化反应合成酯化吡咯并[1,2-a]吲哚
articles.abstract_en: Herein, a visible-light-promoted cascade alkylation/annulation of N-alkene-linked indoles with diazo compounds has been developed. A range of substituted N-alkene-linked indoles and diazo compounds participated smoothly in this transformation, delivering diverse functionalized esterified pyrrolo[1,2-a]indoles in moderate to good yields. Mechanistic studies suggest the involvement of α‑carbonyl methylene radical intermediates. This method is characterized by broad substrate scope and operational simplicity.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一种可见光促进的N-烯烃连接吲哚与重氮化合物的级联烷基化/环化反应。多种取代的N-烯烃连接吲哚和重氮化合物能顺利参与该转化，以中等至良好的产率得到多种功能化的酯化吡咯并[1,2-a]吲哚。机理研究表明涉及α-羰基亚甲基自由基中间体。该方法具有底物范围广和操作简单的特点。

articles.title_en: Development of a stereospecific strategy for the total synthesis of dendrodolide I
articles.title_cn: 开发一种立体特异性策略用于dendrodolide I的全合成
articles.abstract_en: An efficient and stereospecific protocol was developed for the rapid synthesis of dendrodolide I from (R)-glycidol, (S)-homoglycidol, and (R)-but-3-yn-2-ol as readily available chiral synthons. This was achieved by utilizing regioselective ring opening of epoxides, Steglich esterification, and ring-closing metathesis (RCM) as key steps. Moreover, dendrodolide J can also be achieved utilizing the same protocol, altering one chiral synthon, i.e., (R)-glycidol with (S)-glycidol.
articles.abstract_cn: 开发了一种高效且立体特异性的方案，用于从(R)-缩水甘油、(S)-高缩水甘油和(R)-丁3-炔2-醇作为易得的手性合成子快速合成dendrodolide I。该方案通过利用环氧化物的区域选择性开环、Steglich酯化和闭环复分解（RCM）作为关键步骤实现。此外，通过替换一种手性合成子，即用(S)-缩水甘油替代(R)-缩水甘油，采用相同方案也可获得dendrodolide J。

articles.title_en: High-quantum-efficiency near-infrared SPAD using Ge\Si\GeSn quantum dot absorption layers
articles.title_cn: 使用Ge\Si\GeSn量子点吸收层的高量子效率近红外SPAD
articles.abstract_en: Recent years have witnessed increasing demand for near-infrared photodetectors (NIRPDs), particularly for operation around 1500 nm, driven by their expanding use in optical sensing, automotive LiDAR, and biomedical imaging applications. However, conventional single-photon avalanche diodes (SPADs) operating in this spectral range often suffer from limited photon absorption efficiency and complex fabrication processes. In addition, III–V semiconductor-based SPADs, such as InGaAs devices, face challenges related to high manufacturing cost and poor compatibility with silicon-based integrated circuits.In this work, a novel silicon-compatible integrated GeSn quantum-dot and SPAD photodetector architecture is proposed to enhance near-infrared detection performance. SPAD-based photodetectors offer a key advantage of enabling single-photon sensitivity through avalanche multiplication mode, making them highly suitable for ultra-low-light sensing applications such as LiDAR and quantum communication. The proposed structure incorporates GeSn quantum-dot layers within the absorption region, where Sn incorporation provides enhanced optical absorption while the quantum-dot configuration introduces three-dimensional carrier confinement and discrete energy states. This engineered heterostructure effectively extends the photodetection bandwidth toward 2 μm while maintaining efficient device performance.Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed design achieves a substantial enhancement in quantum efficiency, reaching approximately 91% at 1550 nm for 10% Sn composition, accompanied by only a modest increase in dark count rate (DCR). The obtained results highlight the potential of the proposed GeSn quantum-dot SPAD structure as a promising low-cost and high-efficiency solution for next-generation silicon-integrated NIR sensing applications.
articles.abstract_cn: 近年来，由于近红外光电探测器 (NIRPD) 在光学传感、汽车 LiDAR 和生物医学成像应用中的广泛使用，对近红外光电探测器 (NIRPD) 的需求不断增加，特别是在 1500 nm 附近运行。然而，在此光谱范围内工作的传统单光子雪崩二极管（SPAD）通常会受到光子吸收效率有限和制造工艺复杂的困扰。此外，基于III-V半导体的SPAD，例如InGaAs器件，面临着制造成本高和与硅基集成电路兼容性差的挑战。在这项工作中，提出了一种新型硅兼容的集成GeSn量子点和SPAD光电探测器架构，以增强近红外探测性能。基于 SPAD 的光电探测器具有通过雪崩倍增模式实现单光子灵敏度的关键优势，使其非常适合激光雷达和量子通信等超低光传感应用。所提出的结构在吸收区域内结合了GeSn量子点层，其中Sn的结合提供了增强的光学吸收，而量子点配置引入了三维载流子限制和离散能态。这种工程异质结构有效地将光电探测带宽扩展到2μm，同时保持高效的器件性能。仿真结果表明，所提出的设计实现了量子效率的大幅提高，对于10% Sn 成分，在1550 nm 处达到约91%，同时暗计数率 (DCR) 仅略有增加。所获得的结果凸显了所提出的 GeSn 量子点 SPAD 结构作为下一代硅集成近红外传感应用的有前途的低成本和高效率解决方案的潜力。

articles.title_en: Improved THz detection using double-ring shaped 2D graphene on gold nanolayer with SiO<ce:inf loc=post>2</ce:inf> substrate: A simulation study
articles.title_cn: 使用金纳米层上的双环二维石墨烯和 SiO<ce:inf loc=post>2</ce:inf> 基底改进太赫兹检测：模拟研究
articles.abstract_en: The progress towards THz imaging and communication systems hinges on the availability of efficient room-temperature detectors, but existing approaches continue to struggle with issues of sensitivity, scalability, and integrability. In this paper, we propose a metamaterial absorber geometry optimized through the combination of a double-ring two-dimensional graphene layer with plasmonic properties of a nanoscale gold film on the SiO2 substrate. Our proposed geometry TOPAS/graphene-MM/Au-nanolayer/SiO2 exploits the gold film for providing electrical conductivity throughout the metamaterial unit cell and the induced natural shift of the Fermi level in graphene facilitating increased surface plasmon interactions. After comprehensive numerical modeling of four possible geometric variants (Cases I-IV) through finite-element method in COMSOL Multiphysics, we show that the parameters of the outer and inner rings play a crucial role in achieving the desired absorption profile. The optimal geometry (Case III: wo​ = 2.0 μm, wi​ = 0.5 μm, wo/wi​ = 4.0) provides the peak absorptance of 52.84% at 1.9 THz frequency – a factor of three higher than that of non-optimized geometry (17.92% at 2.5 THz). We conclude that the improved design results from an optimized impedance match, plasmonic field confinement, and a hybrid resonance at the graphene-gold interface.
articles.abstract_cn: 太赫兹成像和通信系统的进展取决于高效室温探测器的可用性，但现有方法仍然面临灵敏度、可扩展性和可集成性问题。在本文中，我们提出了一种通过将双环二维石墨烯层与SiO2基底上的纳米级金膜的等离子体特性相结合来优化的超材料吸收器几何形状。我们提出的几何结构 TOPAS/石墨烯-MM/Au-纳米层/SiO2 利用金膜在整个超材料晶胞中提供导电性，并诱导石墨烯中费米能级的自然位移，从而促进增加表面等离子体相互作用。通过 COMSOL Multiphysics 中的有限元方法对四种可能的几何变体（案例 I-IV）进行全面数值建模后，我们表明外环和内环的参数在实现所需的吸收剖面方面发挥着至关重要的作用。最佳几何结构（情况 III：wo​ = 2.0 μm，wi​ = 0.5 μm，wo/wi​ = 4.0）在 1.9 THz 频率处提供 52.84% 的峰值吸收率，比非优化几何结构（2.5 THz 处的 17.92% 高出三倍。我们得出的结论是，改进的设计源于优化的阻抗匹配、等离子体场限制和石墨烯-金界面的混合谐振。

articles.title_en: Computational evidence for dyotropic rearrangement in hypervalent iodine-mediated migratory gem-difluorination
articles.title_cn: 高价碘介导的迁移性偕二氟化反应中双元重排的计算证据
articles.abstract_en: Hypervalent iodine-mediated migratory gem-difluorination represents a core synthetic strategy for the construction of gem-difluoroalkane motifs in organofluorine chemistry. These reactions are conventionally proposed to proceed through a stepwise ionic Wagner–Meerwein rearrangement involving cationic intermediates. Herein, density functional theory (DFT) calculations were performed to investigate the possible involvement of a dyotropic rearrangement mechanism in hypervalent iodine-mediated phenyl migratory gem-difluorination. The results reveal that the dyotropic rearrangement pathway exhibits a lower activation barrier, by 2.3 kcal/mol, than the classical Wagner–Meerwein pathway in the phenyl migration system. Moreover, in a related boryl migratory gem-difluorination reaction, computational studies likewise support a kinetically favored dyotropic rearrangement over the Wagner–Meerwein pathway. These findings suggest that concerted dyotropic rearrangement can serve as a competitive alternative mechanistic pathway in hypervalent iodine-mediated migratory fluorination reactions, providing new theoretical insights for the design and development of related fluorination methodologies.
articles.abstract_cn: 高价碘介导的迁移性偕二氟化反应代表了有机氟化学中构建偕二氟烷烃结构单元的核心合成策略。这些反应通常被认为通过涉及阳离子中间体的逐步离子型Wagner–Meerwein重排进行。本文进行了密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，以研究高价碘介导的苯基迁移性偕二氟化反应中可能涉及的双元重排机制。结果表明，在苯基迁移体系中，双元重排路径的活化能垒比经典的Wagner–Meerwein路径低2.3 kcal/mol。此外，在相关的硼基迁移性偕二氟化反应中，计算研究同样支持双元重排在动力学上优于Wagner–Meerwein路径。这些发现表明，协同双元重排可作为高价碘介导的迁移性氟化反应中一种有竞争力的替代机制路径，为相关氟化方法的设计和开发提供新的理论见解。

articles.title_en: The passthrough of treasury supply to bank deposit funding
articles.title_cn: 国债供给对银行存款融资的传导
articles.abstract_en: We demonstrate the passthrough of Treasury supply to bank deposits through bank market power. We show that a larger Treasury supply crowds out deposits with disproportionate effects in more competitive deposit markets. A larger Treasury supply further curtails bank lending and affects bank funding structure. The explanatory power of Treasury supply is not driven by other shocks to deposit demand and supply. In comparison, monetary policy rate hikes have a larger impact on deposit funding in more concentrated markets, consistent with the deposits channel of monetary policy. Our empirical findings are rationalized in a model of imperfect deposit competition.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过银行市场势力展示了国债供给对银行存款的传导效应。我们发现，更大的国债供给会挤出存款，且在竞争更激烈的存款市场中影响尤为显著。更大的国债供给进一步缩减了银行贷款并影响银行的融资结构。国债供给的解释力并非由存款需求与供给的其他冲击所驱动。相比之下，货币政策利率上调在更集中的市场中对存款融资影响更大，这与货币政策的存款渠道一致。我们的实证发现在一个不完全存款竞争模型中得到合理化解释。

articles.title_en: STDRNet: Saliency-guided tokenization and detail-preserving refinement for infrared small target detection
articles.title_cn: STDRNet：显著性引导的标记化与细节保持细化用于红外小目标检测
articles.abstract_en: Infrared small target detection (IRSTD) is crucial for surveillance and environmental monitoring, yet remains highly challenging due to extremely low signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs), small target scales, and complex backgrounds. Despite recent progress, weak targets may undergo saliency dilution during early representation learning, as token embedding tends to be dominated by background statistics under extremely low SNRs. Moreover, global context modeling alone does not ensure faithful spatial reconstruction, and conventional decoders often yield fragmented responses due to the lack of explicit mechanisms for structure-consistent recovery. To overcome these limitations, we present STDRNet, a hybrid CNN–Transformer encoder-decoder method that couples saliency-guided tokenization with detail-preserving refinement. At the encoder entrance, a Saliency-Aware Tokenizer (SA-Tok) introduces a pre-attention purification process that enhances compact target-like responses and suppresses clutter-dominant activations before tokenization, allowing the Transformer to focus on more informative global relations. During decoding, the Difference-and-Dilated Attention Decoder (DAD) preserves target details through differential and dilated convolutions guided by cascaded channel-spatial attention, suppressing clutter-induced activations and maintaining structural information during reconstruction, thereby reducing false alarms. To support real-world ecological evaluation, we build BSIRST, a bird-oriented infrared dataset of 1,000 pixel-annotated images collected in wetland and lake environments, featuring diverse poses, scales, occlusion, and high-density scenes. The dataset is publicly available at: https://github.com/panpan99/STDRNet. Experiments on NUAA-SIRST, NUDT-SIRST, and BSIRST demonstrate improved detection accuracy and structural restoration, yielding a better balance among sensitivity, precision, and robustness in cluttered infrared scenes.
articles.abstract_cn: 红外小目标检测（IRSTD）对于监视和环境监测至关重要，但由于极低的信噪比（SNRs）、小目标尺寸和复杂背景，其仍然极具挑战性。尽管近期取得了进展，但在极低信噪比下，标记嵌入往往受背景统计主导，弱目标在早期表示学习过程中可能经历显著性稀释。此外，仅靠全局上下文建模并不能确保忠实的空间重建，且传统解码器由于缺乏结构一致性恢复的显式机制，常常产生碎片化的响应。为克服这些限制，我们提出了STDRNet，一种混合CNN-Transformer编码器-解码器方法，将显著性引导的标记化与细节保持细化相结合。在编码器入口处，显著性感知标记器（SA-Tok）引入预注意力净化过程，在标记化之前增强紧凑的目标类响应并抑制杂波主导的激活，使Transformer能够聚焦于更具信息量的全局关系。在解码过程中，差分与膨胀注意力解码器（DAD）通过级联通道-空间注意力引导的差分和膨胀卷积保留目标细节，抑制杂波诱导的激活并在重建过程中保持结构信息，从而减少误报。为支持现实世界的生态评估，我们构建了BSIRST，一个面向鸟类的红外数据集，包含在湿地和湖泊环境中收集的1,000张像素级标注图像，具有多样化的姿态、尺度、遮挡和高密度场景。该数据集公开可用：https://github.com/panpan99/STDRNet。在NUAA-SIRST、NUDT-SIRST和BSIRST上的实验表明，检测精度和结构恢复有所提高，在杂波红外场景中实现了灵敏度、精确度和鲁棒性之间更好的平衡。

articles.title_en: Non-classical photon statistics in frequency-modulated double quantum dot cavity systems
articles.title_cn: 频率调制双量子点腔系统中的非经典光子统计
articles.abstract_en: The quantum dynamics of a double quantum dot two-level system, coupled to a leaking microwave resonator mode, is theoretically investigated. The double quantum dot is driven by applying a continuous field giving rise to time-dependent modulations of its energy separation between the ground levels of each dot, forming the qubit. Therefore, the cavity resonances occur when the difference between the resonator and the qubit frequencies equals the multiple of the modulation frequency, respectively. In the strong Coulomb interaction limit and the weak couplings of the combined system, i.e. the qubit and the single-mode cavity, to corresponding electronic, phononic or photonic reservoirs, we have demonstrated that the output cavity electromagnetic field is formed of a single-photon flux obeying the sub-Poissonian quantum photon statistics. This was proved via Fano’s factor behaviour or by comparing the resonator’s second- and third-order photon correlation functions, respectively. The phonon, the cavity mode dephasing or the environmental temperatures influence on the quantum properties of the photons are also discussed.
articles.abstract_cn: 理论上研究了与泄漏微波谐振腔模式耦合的双量子点两能级系统的量子动力学。双量子点通过施加连续场驱动，引起其每个量子点基态能级间能量分离的时间依赖性调制，从而形成量子比特。因此，当谐振腔与量子比特频率之差分别等于调制频率的整数倍时，出现腔共振。在强库仑相互作用极限以及组合系统（即量子比特和单模腔）与相应电子、声子或光子库的弱耦合条件下，我们证明了输出腔电磁场由服从亚泊松量子光子统计的单光子通量组成。这通过Fano因子行为或分别比较谐振腔的二阶和三阶光子关联函数得以证明。还讨论了声子、腔模退相或环境温度对光子量子性质的影响。

articles.title_en: Giant jumping of a layered quasicrystal mosaic
articles.title_cn: 层状准晶马赛克的巨跳效应
articles.abstract_en: Copyright © 2026. Published by Elsevier B.V. Recently, quasicrystals composed of twisted atomic lattices have attracted attention due to their unusual properties. Here we investigate the effect of giant jumping of a quasicrystal mosaic (GJQCM) at small layer shifts relative to each other. Two-dimensional layers with a hexagonal lattice are considered. For such objects with weakly bonded layers, a method for determining the GJQCM involves shifting the center of the quasicrystal mosaic to a selected site located far from the center — at a distance of tens of lattice parameters — which is achieved via a special lattice shift of tenths of this parameter. Examples of this effect are demonstrated for quasicrystals composed of graphene and MoS 2 layers, as well as for the recently created bilayered photonic crystal and the studied phononic quasicrystal. This effect should manifest itself in layered quasicrystals at both the nano- and macroscales. It cannot occur in traditional solid-state quasicrystals.
articles.abstract_cn: 版权所有 © 2026。由Elsevier B.V.出版。近年来，由扭曲原子晶格组成的准晶因其不寻常的性质而受到关注。在此，我们研究了在层间相对小位移时准晶马赛克巨跳（GJQCM）效应。考虑具有六角晶格的二维层。对于这类弱键合层的物体，确定GJQCM的方法涉及将准晶马赛克中心移动到远离中心——距离为数十个晶格参数——的选定位置，这是通过该参数十分之一的特殊晶格位移实现的。我们展示了由石墨烯和MoS 2层组成的准晶，以及最近创建的双层光子晶体和研究的声子准晶中这一效应的例子。这种效应应在纳米和宏观尺度的层状准晶中显现。它不可能发生在传统固态准晶中。

articles.title_en: Can ChatGPT forecast stock price movements? Return predictability and large language models
articles.title_cn: ChatGPT能否预测股价变动？收益可预测性与大语言模型
articles.abstract_en: We document the capability of large language models (LLMs) like ChatGPT to predict stock market reactions from news headlines without direct financial training. Using post-knowledge-cutoff headlines, GPT-4 captures initial market responses, achieving approximately 90% portfolio-day hit rates for the non-tradable initial reaction. GPT-4 scores also significantly predict the subsequent drift, especially for small stocks and negative news. Forecasting ability generally increases with model size, suggesting that financial reasoning is an emerging capacity of complex LLMs. Strategy returns decline as LLM adoption rises, consistent with improved price efficiency. To rationalize these findings, we develop a theoretical model that incorporates LLM technology, information-processing capacity constraints, underreaction, and limits to arbitrage.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们记录了大语言模型（LLMs）如ChatGPT在无需直接金融训练的情况下，从新闻标题预测股票市场反应的能力。使用知识截止日期后的标题，GPT-4捕捉了初始市场反应，对于不可交易的初始反应实现了约90%的投资组合日命中率。GPT-4的评分也显著预测了随后的漂移，尤其是对于小盘股和负面新闻。预测能力通常随模型规模增大而增强，这表明金融推理是复杂大语言模型的一种新兴能力。随着大语言模型采用的增加，策略回报下降，这与价格效率提高一致。为了合理化这些发现，我们开发了一个理论模型，该模型结合了大语言模型技术、信息处理能力约束、反应不足和套利限制。

articles.title_en: MoSSMA: A robust framework for range-spread target detection under chaff jamming
articles.title_cn: MoSSMA：箔条干扰下距离扩展目标检测的稳健框架
articles.abstract_en: Range-spread target (RST) detection under chaff jamming remains a challenging problem for modern radar systems. Conventional approaches often rely on parametric assumptions that inadequately model the stochastic nature of chaff, or require extensive labeled data. This paper presents a robust framework, termed morphological segmentation and joint subspace-morphology analysis (MoSSMA), for RST discrimination in severe chaff environments. A gradient-weighted adaptive thresholding (GWAT) scheme is designed for region of interest (ROI) segmentation, embedding local gradients into a variance-based criterion to emphasize structurally coherent signatures in the range-Doppler (R-D) plane. Subsequently, a 5-dimensional physics-informed feature representation is constructed by jointly exploiting subspace structures and morphological characteristics, comprehensively capturing the low-rank behavior of rigid RSTs versus the diffuse, heavy-tailed properties of chaff. To explicitly evaluate inherent discriminability without relying on over-parameterized networks, these features are fed into a standard support vector machine (SVM). Evaluated via a rigorous 5-fold cross-validation strategy, the model establishes a robust, interpretable decision boundary. Extensive evaluations on measured Ku-band radar data demonstrate that MoSSMA achieves reliable target detection, negligible false alarms, and strictly guarantees real-time execution feasibility.
articles.abstract_cn: 在箔条干扰下进行距离扩展目标（RST）检测对现代雷达系统而言仍是一个具有挑战性的问题。传统方法往往依赖于参数化假设，这些假设无法充分模拟箔条的随机特性，或者需要大量标记数据。本文提出了一种稳健框架，称为形态分割与联合子空间-形态分析（MoSSMA），用于在严重箔条环境中进行RST判别。设计了一种梯度加权自适应阈值（GWAT）方案用于感兴趣区域（ROI）分割，将局部梯度嵌入基于方差的准则中，以强调距离-多普勒（R-D）平面中结构连贯的签名。随后，通过联合利用子空间结构和形态特征，构建了一个5维物理信息特征表示，全面捕捉刚性RST的低秩行为与箔条的扩散、重尾特性。为了在不依赖过参数化网络的情况下显式评估固有可判别性，这些特征被输入到标准支持向量机（SVM）中。通过严格的5折交叉验证策略进行评估，该模型建立了稳健、可解释的决策边界。对实测Ku波段雷达数据的广泛评估表明，MoSSMA实现了可靠的目标检测、可忽略的虚警，并严格保证了实时执行的可行性。

articles.title_en: SDA-DETR: Selective direction-aware DETR for small-object defect detection in transmission lines
articles.title_cn: SDA-DETR：用于输电线路小目标缺陷检测的选择性方向感知DETR
articles.abstract_en: Reliable operation of transmission lines is critical for ensuring stable power delivery. However, their components often suffer from defects caused by complex environmental conditions, while existing detection models struggle with weak feature representation and loss of directional cues due to the small, slender, and cluttered nature of targets in inspection images. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a Selective Direction-Aware DETR (SDA-DETR) for small-object defect detection. The model employs a newly designed Selective Enhancement Mixed Block (SEMB) and a Direction-Adaptive Cross-Scale Feature Fusion Module (DACFM) to strengthen feature preservation and enhance geometric perception. A Mona-based recalibration mechanism is incorporated into the Transformer encoder to restore fine-grained discriminative features, while a Focaler-SIoU loss with angular constraints is introduced to improve localization accuracy. Experimental results demonstrate that SDA-DETR attains an mAP50 of 87.6%, reduces parameters by 12.6%, and outperforms the baseline across all major metrics. Validation on multiple defect datasets further confirms its robustness and high accuracy in transmission line defect detection.
articles.abstract_cn: 输电线路的可靠运行对于确保稳定的电力输送至关重要。然而，其组件常常因复杂的环境条件而出现缺陷，而现有的检测模型在处理巡检图像中目标的小尺寸、细长和杂乱特性时，面临特征表示弱和方向线索丢失的问题。为解决这些挑战，本文提出了一种用于小目标缺陷检测的选择性方向感知DETR（SDA-DETR）。该模型采用新设计的选择性增强混合块（SEMB）和方向自适应跨尺度特征融合模块（DACFM），以加强特征保留并增强几何感知。在Transformer编码器中引入了基于Mona的重新校准机制，以恢复细粒度的判别特征，同时引入了带有角度约束的Focaler-SIoU损失，以提高定位精度。实验结果表明，SDA-DETR达到了mAP50的87.6%，参数减少了12.6%，并在所有主要指标上优于基线。在多个缺陷数据集上的验证进一步证实了其在输电线路缺陷检测中的鲁棒性和高精度。

articles.title_en: Multi-scale physics-aware time-frequency representation network for acoustic fault diagnosis of belt conveyors
articles.title_cn: 多尺度物理感知时频表示网络用于带式输送机声学故障诊断
