articles.abstract_en: As belt conveyors are the core equipment for port bulk material transportation, their safe and stable operation is crucial to industrial production. However, accurately capturing early fault features in harsh field environments remains a significant challenge. To address the challenges of “signal masking” caused by severe background noise and time-frequency scale conflicts among heterogeneous faults under practical operating conditions, a Selective Kernel Adaptive Chirplet Time-Frequency Convolutional network (SK-ACTFC) is proposed. This network is based on physics-aware adaptive chirplets and multi-scale selective kernels. Operating as a physics-aware front end, a learnable chirplet layer is utilized to optimize parameters, including center frequency, bandwidth, and chirp rate, in an end-to-end manner. Consequently, the time-frequency manifolds of non-stationary fault signals under low signal-to-noise ratios are adaptively tracked to achieve the robust separation of signal and noise. By integrating a selective kernel (SK) attention mechanism to construct a multi-scale dynamic perception architecture, the optimal receptive field is adaptively reconstructed based on signal characteristics. This effectively optimizes the time-frequency resolution trade-off governed by the uncertainty principle. Simultaneously, an orthogonality regularization loss is introduced into the optimization objective to prevent filter mode collapse and maximize feature space coverage. Evaluations on real experimental data demonstrate that a diagnostic accuracy superior to mainstream time-frequency conversion models is sustained at an extreme signal-to-noise ratio of -6 dB. Visualizations further confirm the capability of the model to robustly separate physically interpretable fault features from intense noise, thereby providing a robust and interpretable new solution for industrial acoustic monitoring.
articles.abstract_cn: 作为港口散货运输的核心设备，带式输送机的安全稳定运行对工业生产至关重要。然而，在恶劣的现场环境中准确捕捉早期故障特征仍然是一个重大挑战。为解决实际工况下严重背景噪声引起的“信号掩蔽”以及异质故障间时频尺度冲突的挑战，提出了一种基于物理感知自适应线性调频小波和多尺度选择性核的选择性核自适应线性调频小波时频卷积网络（SK-ACTFC）。作为物理感知前端，利用可学习的线性调频小波层以端到端方式优化参数，包括中心频率、带宽和调频斜率。因此，在低信噪比下非平稳故障信号的时频流形被自适应跟踪，以实现信号与噪声的稳健分离。通过集成选择性核（SK）注意力机制构建多尺度动态感知架构，根据信号特征自适应重构最优感受野，有效优化由不确定性原理支配的时频分辨率权衡。同时，在优化目标中引入正交正则化损失，以防止滤波器模式崩溃并最大化特征空间覆盖。在真实实验数据上的评估表明，在极端信噪比-6 dB下，诊断精度优于主流时频转换模型。可视化进一步证实了该模型能够从强烈噪声中稳健分离出物理可解释的故障特征，从而为工业声学监测提供了一种稳健且可解释的新解决方案。

articles.title_en: Spatially correlated multichannel joint sparse Bayesian learning for short pilot-aided underwater acoustic communications
articles.title_cn: 用于短导频水声通信的空间相关多通道联合稀疏贝叶斯学习
articles.abstract_en: Underwater acoustic (UWA) receivers usually rely on long pilot sequences to obtain accurate channel state information for equalization. However, long pilot sequences suffer from reduced spectral efficiency and limited data rates. This paper describes a multichannel joint sparse Bayesian learning algorithm for single-input/multiple-output UWA systems. The proposed method uses a multiple measurement vector model and exploits the spatial correlation among channels to reduce the pilot overhead. Within the Bayesian framework, mean-field variational inference is used to estimate the channel posteriors, while expectation-maximization is applied to recover unknown data symbols. The proposed algorithm decouples the spatially correlated multiple measurement vector model, further reducing the computational complexity. Simulations and field experiments verify that the proposed method is effective for single-input/multiple-output UWA communications, achieving superior bit error rate performance in short-pilot scenarios compared with existing methods.
articles.abstract_cn: 水声接收机通常依赖长导频序列来获取精确的信道状态信息以进行均衡。然而，长导频序列会降低频谱效率和限制数据速率。本文描述了一种用于单输入/多输出水声系统的多通道联合稀疏贝叶斯学习算法。所提出的方法采用多测量向量模型，并利用信道间的空间相关性来减少导频开销。在贝叶斯框架内，使用均值场变分推断来估计信道后验，而期望最大化则用于恢复未知数据符号。所提出的算法解耦了空间相关的多测量向量模型，进一步降低了计算复杂度。仿真和现场实验验证了所提方法在单输入/多输出水声通信中的有效性，在短导频场景下相比现有方法实现了更优的误码率性能。

articles.title_en: Bound states and electronic transitions in bilayer graphene with a Gaussian ripple
articles.title_cn: 具有高斯波纹的双层石墨烯中的束缚态与电子跃迁
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the influence of geometry on the electronic states of an electron confined to a graphene surface that is flat on average but exhibits a Gaussian deformation. Using the method developed by da Costa, we derive a Schrödinger-type equation that effectively describes the dynamics of an electron with position-dependent mass M(r). We show that M(r) depends explicitly on the geometric parameters of the deformation and is closely related to the Gaussian curvature associated with the surface metric. Bound states are found in the absence of orbital angular momentum for several geometric configurations, and their number is shown to depend sensitively on the curvature of the deformation. No bound states are observed for nonzero orbital angular momentum. We also analyze the effects of the geometric deformation on electronic transitions in the terahertz regime. Under appropriate conditions, the resulting two-level system may provide a platform for qubit encoding.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了几何形状对限制在平均平坦但具有高斯变形的石墨烯表面上的电子态的影响。利用da Costa发展的方法，我们推导出一个薛定谔型方程，该方程有效描述了具有位置依赖质量M(r)的电子的动力学。我们表明，M(r)明确依赖于变形的几何参数，并与表面度量相关的高斯曲率密切相关。在无轨道角动量的情况下，对于几种几何构型发现了束缚态，并且其数量被证明对变形的曲率敏感。对于非零轨道角动量，未观察到束缚态。我们还分析了太赫兹波段中几何变形对电子跃迁的影响。在适当条件下，所得的两能级系统可能为量子比特编码提供平台。

articles.title_en: Enhanced gas sensing of CO, H<ce:inf loc=post>2</ce:inf>S, NH<ce:inf loc=post>3</ce:inf> and NO on vacancy-defective and Al/Cu/Fe-doped phosphorene: A DFT investigation
articles.title_cn: 空位缺陷和 Al/Cu/Fe 掺杂磷烯上 CO、H<ce:inf loc=post>2</ce:inf>S、NH<ce:inf loc=post>3</ce:inf> 和 NO 的增强气体传感：DFT 研究
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. This study explored the adsorption properties of black phosphorene (BP) and its defects, as well as metal (Al, Cu, Fe) doping systems, for CO, H 2 S, NH 3 , and NO gases using density functional theory (DFT). The results reveal that physisorption governs all four gas/BP systems. A single phosphorus vacancy enhances gas adsorption, with NO/BP V shifting to chemisorption. Doping Al, Cu, and Fe into the vacancy further increases the adsorption energies. Among the investigated systems, BP V -Cu exhibits the best balance between electrical response and recovery behavior, making it a promising reusable gas-sensing material, whereas BP V -Al and BP V -Fe provide stronger adsorption but suffer from prolonged recovery due to their stronger gas-surface interactions. This work establishes a theoretical basis for the design of phosphorene-based gas sensors.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. 这项研究利用密度泛函理论 (DFT) 探讨了黑磷烯 (BP) 及其缺陷以及金属（Al、Cu、Fe）掺杂体系对 CO、H 2 S、NH 3 和 NO 气体的吸附特性。结果表明，物理吸附控制着所有四种气体/BP 系统。单个磷空位增强了气体吸附，NO/BP V 转变为化学吸附。在空位中掺杂 Al、Cu 和 Fe 进一步增加了吸附能。在所研究的系统中，BP V -Cu在电响应和恢复行为之间表现出最佳平衡，使其成为一种有前途的可重复使用的气敏材料，而BP V -Al和BP V -Fe提供更强的吸附作用，但由于其更强的气体-表面相互作用而导致恢复时间延长。该工作为磷烯基气体传感器的设计奠定了理论基础。

articles.title_en: Aerobic oxidation of ethers with ferric nitrate nonahydrate/phosphorus pentoxide via mechanochemical reaction
articles.title_cn: 机械化学反应下九水合硝酸铁/五氧化二磷对醚的好氧氧化
articles.abstract_en: A simple aerobic oxidation of ethers using a combination of ferric nitrate nonahydrate and phosphorus pentoxide under high-speed ball-milling was developed. The expected products were afforded in excellent yields. Major advantages of this procedure include clean, effective, the use of cheap and readily available reagents and broad functional group compatibility.
articles.abstract_cn: 开发了一种在高速球磨条件下，使用九水合硝酸铁和五氧化二磷组合对醚进行简单好氧氧化的方法。预期产物以优异的产率获得。该方法的主要优点包括清洁、高效、使用廉价易得的试剂以及广泛的官能团兼容性。

articles.title_en: Lewis acid-enabled Thia-Cloke-Wilson type rearrangement of donor-acceptor cyclopropanes with Lawesson's reagent
articles.title_cn: 路易斯酸促进的供体-受体环丙烷与劳森试剂的硫杂Cloke-Wilson型重排反应
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd. A Cu(OTf) 2 -enabled thia-Cloke-Wilson rearrangement reactions between spirocyclic donor-acceptor cyclopropanes derived from indolin-2-ones and Lawesson's reagent has been developed, affording the indole-annulated dihydrothiophenes in moderate to good yields. In addition, the protocol can be applied to the thia-Cloke-Wilson rearrangement of cyclopropyl ketones.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd. 本研究开发了一种Cu(OTf) 2 促进的硫杂Cloke-Wilson重排反应，涉及由吲哚啉2-酮衍生的螺环供体-受体环丙烷与劳森试剂，以中等至良好的产率得到吲哚并二氢噻吩。此外，该方案还可应用于环丙基酮的硫杂Cloke-Wilson重排反应。

articles.title_en: Rational array aided semantic communication for improved semantic spectral efficiency
articles.title_cn: 理性阵列辅助的语义通信以提升语义频谱效率
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Inc. Semantic communication has emerged as a paradigm–shifting framework for future wireless networks, transcending the classic Shannon paradigm by prioritizing the delivery of meaning rather than symbol accuracy. While recent advances leverage deep learning and joint source–channel coding for end–to–end semantic transmission, the fundamental role of physical–layer antenna design remains underexplored. In this work, we introduce novel rational (non–integer) array configuration for semantic communication systems, rigorously extending the theory and practice of rational arrays originally developed for classical communication theory to the semantic domain. We develop a mathematically grounded framework that defines semantic spectral efficiency as task–weighted relevant information conveyed through a non–linear semantic decoder, distinguishing it from raw channel capacity, and we quantify how rational arrays reduce spatial correlation, improve channel eigenvalue conditioning, and lower the task–weighted semantic distortion of the channel. Our extensive simulations demonstrate that, for any given symbol length, rational arrays achieve higher semantic spectral efficiency and semantic similarity compared to traditional designs. These gains are validated to be consistent across diverse channel conditions as well as across multiple SNR regimes. This work positions rational array–aided semantic communication as a cost–effective, scalable enabler for next–generation 6 G networks, with implications for intelligent, task–oriented, and resource–constrained wireless applications.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Inc. 语义通信已成为未来无线网络的范式转变框架，通过优先传递意义而非符号准确性，超越了经典香农范式。尽管近期进展利用深度学习和联合源信道编码实现端到端语义传输，物理层天线设计的基本作用仍未得到充分探索。在本工作中，我们为语义通信系统引入了新颖的理性（非整数）阵列配置，严格地将最初为经典通信理论开发的理性阵列理论与实践扩展到语义领域。我们开发了一个数学基础框架，将语义频谱效率定义为通过非线性语义解码器传递的任务加权相关信息，区别于原始信道容量，并量化了理性阵列如何降低空间相关性、改善信道特征值条件以及降低信道的任务加权语义失真。我们的广泛模拟表明，对于任何给定的符号长度，理性阵列相比传统设计实现了更高的语义频谱效率和语义相似性。这些增益被验证在不同信道条件以及多个信噪比区间内保持一致。本工作将理性阵列辅助的语义通信定位为下一代6 G网络的成本效益高、可扩展的推动者，对智能、任务导向和资源受限的无线应用具有重要意义。

articles.title_en: LA-OctResNet: A model based on improved octave residual and multi-modal attention collaboration
articles.title_cn: LA-OctResNet：一种基于改进八度残差与多模态注意力协作的模型
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Inc. Hyperspectral images (HSI) contain rich spectral and spatial information, which have significant application value in fine classification tasks. However, existing models rely on a large number of finely annotated samples, have weak generalization ability to spectral variability and mixed pixel scenes, resulting in a sharp drop in classification accuracy of weak texture regions, and are difficult to balance computational complexity and accuracy. To address these issue, this paper proposes a HSI classification model LA-OctResNet that synergizes an improved Octave residual network with multi-modal attention mechanism. First, hybrid-scale 3-D convolutions and Ghost modules extract spectral and spatial features separately, and a spectral-attention pooling layer performs adaptive weighting along the spectral dimension. Subsequently, a learnable adaptive Octave convolution (LA-OctConv) is designed for multi-modal residuals, achieving hierarchical representation of high- and low-frequency spatial features through a dynamic learnable parameter alpha. An Enhanced Coordinate Attention module and a dynamic self-attention mechanism are further constructed, followed by an adaptive feature fusion module that precisely integrates spectral and spatial multi-frequency features. Experimental results on public hyperspectral datasets demonstrate that the proposed model outperforms existing methods in relevant metrics, which provides a novel and effective solution for HSI classification.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Inc. 高光谱图像（HSI）包含丰富的光谱和空间信息，在精细分类任务中具有重要的应用价值。然而，现有模型依赖大量精细标注样本，对光谱变异和混合像元场景的泛化能力较弱，导致弱纹理区域分类精度急剧下降，且难以平衡计算复杂度和精度。为解决这些问题，本文提出了一种将改进的八度残差网络与多模态注意力机制协同的HSI分类模型LA-OctResNet。首先，混合尺度3-D卷积和Ghost模块分别提取光谱和空间特征，光谱注意力池化层沿光谱维度进行自适应加权。随后，设计了一种可学习的自适应八度卷积（LA-OctConv）用于多模态残差，通过动态可学习参数alpha实现高、低频空间特征的层次化表示。进一步构建了增强坐标注意力模块和动态自注意力机制，随后通过自适应特征融合模块精确整合光谱和空间多频特征。在公开高光谱数据集上的实验结果表明，所提模型在相关指标上优于现有方法，为HSI分类提供了一种新颖且有效的解决方案。

articles.title_en: Valproate vs levetiracetam in juvenile myoclonic epilepsy: systematic review and meta-analysis
articles.title_cn: 丙戊酸与左乙拉西坦治疗青少年肌阵挛性癫痫：系统评价与荟萃分析
articles.abstract_en: Introduction Juvenile myoclonic epilepsy (JME) is a genetic generalized epilepsy syndrome with onset typically in adolescence and a chronic course requiring long-term antiseizure medications (ASMs). Valproate (VPA) is the most effective treatment for seizure control in JME but use is limited by metabolic, cognitive, and teratogenic adverse effects (AEs). Levetiracetam (LEV) is an alternative ASM when VPA is contraindicated or not tolerated. Comparisons of the efficacy and long-term tolerability of VPA and LEV remain limited. Methods We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis using PRISMA guidelines and the Cochrane Handbook. We searched PubMed, Embase, and the Cochrane Library from inception through January 2026 for studies in JME patients comparing LEV and VPA, and included randomized controlled trials and comparative observational studies with ≥ 6 months of follow-up. Primary outcomes were seizure remission and ASM failure or treatment discontinuation. Secondary outcomes included, memory impairment, weight gain or obesity, dizziness, and overall AEs. Risk ratios (RRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were pooled using random-effects models. Heterogeneity was assessed using the I2 statistic. Results Seven studies encompassing 1,009 patients were included. VPA was associated with higher pooled seizure remission rates compared with LEV (344 of 574 vs. 169 of 390; RR 1.44, 95% CI 1.27–1.63); however, substantial heterogeneity (I2 = 88.4%) limits confidence in this finding. VPA was associated with a lower risk of drug failure or treatment discontinuation (RR 0.68, 95% CI 0.54–0.86), with no heterogeneity (I2 = 0.0%). VPA was also associated with a higher risk of memory impairment (RR 5.37, 95% CI 2.05–14.04; I2 = 74.5%) and weight gain or obesity (RR 6.40, 95% CI 3.64–11.26; I2 = 35.9%). No significant differences were observed between treatments regarding dizziness (RR 0.91, 95% CI 0.61–1.37; I2 = 21.2%). Sensitivity analyses confirmed the robustness of the pooled estimates. Conclusion VPA was associated with higher seizure remission rates and lower treatment discontinuation compared with LEV; however, these findings must be interpreted with caution given the substantial heterogeneity, the predominance of observational studies, and the serious risk of bias identified in most included studies VPA also demonstrated lower rates of treatment discontinuation, despite a higher burden of cognitive impairment and weight gain. No relevant differences were observed regarding dizziness. Large-scale randomized trials with standardized outcome definitions and longer follow-up are needed to define the comparative risk–benefit profiles of LEV and VPA in JME.
articles.abstract_cn: 引言 青少年肌阵挛性癫痫（JME）是一种遗传性全面性癫痫综合征，通常在青春期起病，病程慢性，需要长期使用抗癫痫发作药物（ASMs）。丙戊酸（VPA）是控制JME发作最有效的治疗药物，但其使用受到代谢、认知和致畸不良反应（AEs）的限制。当VPA禁忌或不耐受时，左乙拉西坦（LEV）是替代的ASM。VPA和LEV的疗效及长期耐受性比较研究仍然有限。方法 我们按照PRISMA指南和Cochrane手册进行了系统评价和荟萃分析。我们检索了PubMed、Embase和Cochrane图书馆，时间从建库至2026年一月，纳入比较LEV和VPA在JME患者中的研究，包括随机对照试验和随访≥6个月的比较观察性研究。主要结局为癫痫发作缓解和ASM失败或治疗中断。次要结局包括记忆障碍、体重增加或肥胖、头晕和总体AEs。使用随机效应模型合并风险比（RRs）及其95%置信区间（CIs）。异质性通过I2统计量评估。结果 共纳入七项研究，涵盖1,009例患者。与LEV相比，VPA的合并癫痫发作缓解率更高（574例中的344例 vs. 390例中的169例；RR 1.44，95% CI 1.27-1.63）；然而，显著的异质性（I2 = 88.4%）限制了对这一结果的信心。VPA与较低的药物失败或治疗中断风险相关（RR 0.68，95% CI 0.54-0.86），无异质性（I2 = 0.0%）。VPA还与较高的记忆障碍风险（RR 5.37，95% CI 2.05-14.04；I2 = 74.5%）和体重增加或肥胖风险（RR 6.40，95% CI 3.64-11.26；I2 = 35.9%）相关。在头晕方面，两种治疗之间未观察到显著差异（RR 0.91，95% CI 0.61-1.37；I2 = 21.2%）。敏感性分析确认了合并估计值的稳健性。结论 与LEV相比，VPA与较高的癫痫发作缓解率和较低的治疗中断率相关；然而，鉴于显著的异质性、观察性研究占主导以及大多数纳入研究中存在的严重偏倚风险，这些结果必须谨慎解读。尽管认知障碍和体重增加的负担较高，VPA也显示出较低的治疗中断率。在头晕方面未观察到相关差异。需要采用标准化结局定义和更长随访期的大规模随机试验来确定LEV和VPA在JME中的比较风险-获益特征。

articles.title_en: Infertility treatment in women with epilepsy: A systematic review
articles.title_cn: 癫痫女性不孕症治疗：一项系统综述
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Background: The impact of assisted reproductive technologies (ART) on seizure control in women with epilepsy remains incompletely understood. Methods: A systematic review was conducted according to PRISMA guidelines. EMBASE, MEDLINE, CINAHL, Scopus, and the Cochrane Library were searched from inception to March 2025. Eligible studies included observational studies and case-based reports involving women undergoing infertility treatment. Results: A total of 1216 publications were identified, of which four studies met the inclusion criteria, including case reports, a case series, and a cohort study. These studies included 16 women aged 25–46 years undergoing infertility treatment, all but one of whom had epilepsy. Interventions involved in vitro fertilization (IVF), ovulation induction, and hormonal therapies. Patients were treated with a range of antiseizure medications (ASMs), including carbamazepine, clobazam, lamotrigine, levetiracetam, oxcarbazepine, valproate, and zonisamide, either as monotherapy or in combination. Seizure frequency was generally stable, with most patients maintaining baseline seizure control. Seizure exacerbations were uncommon and primarily associated with hormonal therapy and reduced ASM levels, particularly reduced lamotrigine levels. Reported events included breakthrough seizures in the setting of decreased lamotrigine concentrations, seizure clusters associated with follitropin beta, and a new-onset seizure following dehydroepiandrosterone exposure. Across studies, multiple ART attempts resulted in live births with different ASM regimens, as well as in patients not receiving ASMs. Conclusion: Available evidence suggests that ART is feasible in women with epilepsy, with most patients maintaining stable seizure control. Hormonal therapy may affect ASM pharmacokinetics and seizure threshold, thereby warranting close monitoring. Larger prospective studies are needed to better define ASM-specific effects and optimize care.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 背景：辅助生殖技术（ART）对癫痫女性发作控制的影响尚未完全明了。方法：根据PRISMA指南进行系统综述。检索EMBASE、MEDLINE、CINAHL、Scopus和Cochrane图书馆，检索时间从建库至三月 2025。纳入标准包括涉及接受不孕症治疗女性的观察性研究和病例报告。结果：共识别出1216篇文献，其中四项研究符合纳入标准，包括病例报告、病例系列和队列研究。这些研究共纳入16名年龄在25-46岁接受不孕症治疗的女性，除一人外均患有癫痫。干预措施包括体外受精（IVF）、促排卵和激素治疗。患者接受多种抗癫痫药物（ASMs）治疗，包括卡马西平、氯巴占、拉莫三嗪、左乙拉西坦、奥卡西平、丙戊酸和唑尼沙胺，单药或联合用药。发作频率总体稳定，大多数患者维持基线发作控制。发作加重不常见，主要与激素治疗和ASM水平降低相关，尤其是拉莫三嗪水平降低。报告的事件包括拉莫三嗪浓度降低背景下的突破性发作、与促卵泡激素β相关的丛集性发作，以及脱氢表雄酮暴露后的新发发作。在各研究中，多次ART尝试在不同ASM方案下以及未接受ASM的患者中均实现了活产。结论：现有证据表明，ART在癫痫女性中是可行的，大多数患者维持稳定的发作控制。激素治疗可能影响ASM药代动力学和发作阈值，因此需要密切监测。需要更大规模的前瞻性研究以更好地明确ASM特异性效应并优化护理。

articles.title_en: Therapeutic coma in status epilepticus: Determinants of treatment intensity and its impact on outcomes
articles.title_cn: 癫痫持续状态中的治疗性昏迷：治疗强度的决定因素及其对结局的影响
articles.abstract_en: AimTo investigate the determinants of physicians’ therapeutic decision-making in status epilepticus (SE), with a focus on factors influencing the choice between therapeutic coma (TC) and less aggressive antiseizure medication (ASM) approaches, and to assess the impact of treatment intensity on clinical outcomes. Principal ResultsIn this prospective multicenter study including 145 adult SE cases, refractory SE (RSE) occurred in 55%. TC was used in 47% of RSE patients and was preferentially applied to individuals with acute or potentially fatal etiologies, higher severity (STESS score), and intensive care unit admission at SE onset. Conversely, vascular and tumor-related SE were more often managed conservatively with multiple ASMs. Although TC-treated patients showed worse functional outcomes and higher mortality, these differences were not significant after adjustment for confounders, indicating that baseline disease severity largely accounted for outcome disparities. Etiology was the main factor influencing decisions to withdraw TC in RSE, whereas comorbidities and premorbid functional status guided decisions to withhold aggressive treatment. Semiology emerged as the primary determinant of treatment intensity, with less aggressive approaches involving multiple ASMs — still proving effective in a substantial proportion of cases — being reserved for patients with clinical presentations considered less harmful. EEG correlates were seldom cited as influential in treatment decisions and, when reported, were almost exclusively associated with decisions to withdraw therapy. ConclusionsTreatment decisions in RSE are primarily driven by etiology, semiology, and premorbid functional status, rather than electrographic findings. TC is reserved for the most severe cases, and outcome differences between treatment strategies reflect underlying disease severity rather than treatment-related harm. Conservative ASM escalation remains effective in a substantial proportion of RSE patients.
articles.abstract_cn: 目的：探讨医生在癫痫持续状态（SE）中治疗决策的决定因素，重点关注影响选择治疗性昏迷（TC）与较不积极的抗癫痫药物（ASM）方法的因素，并评估治疗强度对临床结局的影响。主要结果：在这项包括145例成人SE病例的前瞻性多中心研究中，难治性SE（RSE）发生率为55%。TC用于47%的RSE患者，并优先应用于具有急性或可能致命病因、较高严重程度（STESS评分）以及SE发作时入住重症监护室的患者。相反，血管性和肿瘤相关性SE更常采用多种ASM进行保守管理。尽管接受TC治疗的患者表现出较差的功能结局和较高的死亡率，但在调整混杂因素后这些差异不显著，表明基线疾病严重程度在很大程度上解释了结局差异。病因是决定RSE中撤除TC的主要因素，而合并症和病前功能状态指导了拒绝积极治疗的决定。症状学成为治疗强度的主要决定因素，较不积极的方法涉及多种ASM——在相当比例病例中仍证明有效——保留给临床表现被认为危害较小的患者。脑电图相关性很少被引用为影响治疗决策的因素，当被报告时，几乎完全与撤除治疗的决定相关。结论：RSE中的治疗决策主要由病因、症状学和病前功能状态驱动，而非电图发现。TC保留给最严重的病例，治疗策略之间的结局差异反映了潜在疾病严重程度而非治疗相关伤害。保守的ASM升级在相当比例的RSE患者中仍然有效。

articles.title_en: Comprehensive interface trap engineering of junctionless T-shaped nanosheet FETs for digital, analog, RF, and circuit applications
articles.title_cn: 用于数字、模拟、射频和电路应用的无结 T 形纳米片 FET 的综合界面陷阱工程
articles.abstract_en: In this work, a detailed investigation is carried out to assess the impact of interface trap states on digital, analog, and RF characteristics of a Junctionless (JL) T-shaped Nanosheet FET. The concentration of donor and acceptor trap states is varied from 2 × 1012 cm−2 to 8 × 1012 cm−2. The results reveal that acceptor traps predominantly deteriorate the channel inversion capability, leading to reduced on-state current (ION), enhanced subthreshold characteristics, and lower output conductance. In contrast, donor traps act as electron-supplying centers, elevating both the ION and off-state currents (IOFF) while degrading subthreshold swing (SS) and short-channel immunity. The influence of trap polarity becomes prominent in analog and RF figures of merit, where donor-induced conduction enhancement causes higher gate capacitance, reduced transconductance efficiency, and elevated output conductance. Meanwhile, acceptor traps exhibit a peak behavior in both transconductance (gm) and CGG due to the progressive filling of negatively charged states with increasing gate bias. The donor traps at 8 × 1012 cm−2 exhibit minimal intrinsic delay of ∼0.8 ps. The impact of interface traps on Common Source (CS) amplifier analysis revealed the superiority of higher acceptor trap concentrations in improving the amplification (∼5.99) capability of analog circuit performance.
articles.abstract_cn: 在这项工作中，进行了详细的研究，以评估界面陷阱状态对无结 (JL) T 形纳米片 FET 的数字、模拟和射频特性的影响。供体和受体陷阱态的浓度从 2 × 1012 cm−2 到 8 × 1012 cm−2 变化。结果表明，受主陷阱主要恶化沟道反转能力，导致通态电流（ION）减少、亚阈值特性增强和输出电导降低。相比之下，施主陷阱充当电子供应中心，提高 ION 和断态电流 (IOFF)，同时降低亚阈值摆幅 (SS) 和短沟道抗扰度。陷阱极性的影响在模拟和射频品质因数中变得突出，其中施主引起的传导增强导致更高的栅极电容、降低的跨导效率和升高的输出电导。同时，由于随着栅极偏压的增加，带负电的状态逐渐填充，受主陷阱在跨导 (gm) 和 CGG 中都表现出峰值行为。 8 × 1012 cm−2 处的供体陷阱表现出 ∼0.8 ps 的最小固有延迟。界面陷阱对共源（CS）放大器分析的影响揭示了较高的受主陷阱浓度在提高模拟电路性能的放大（∼5.99）能力方面的优越性。

articles.title_en: Joint transmit and receive pattern selection for reconfigurable intelligent surface-aided aerial security
articles.title_cn: 可重构智能地面辅助空中安全的联合发射和接收模式选择
articles.abstract_en: In this paper we investigate the physical layer security in aerial communication with reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-aided joint transmit-receive pattern selection (JTRPS), where the base station and the unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) are equipped with reconfigurable antennas (RAs), in the presence of an aerial eavesdropper. In this setup, RIS is used to adjust its reflecting elements to enhance the end-to-end signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of legitimate communication. To quantify the overall secrecy performance of the proposed communication model, we derived closed-form transmission secrecy outage probability (TSOP) and capacity-based secrecy outage probability (SOP) expressions to comprehensively evaluate aerial security. Our analyses show that the presence of RIS improves the outage probability, and JTRPS boosts the impact of RIS by adding spatial diversity with mirror activation patterns (MAPs) of RA. The efficiency of the proposed scenario and the correctness of the resulting secrecy performance expressions are confirmed with simulations.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们研究了可重构智能表面（RIS）辅助联合发射-接收模式选择（JTRPS）空中通信的物理层安全性，其中基站和无人机（UAV）配备了可重构天线（RA），并且存在空中窃听者。在此设置中，RIS 用于调整其反射元件，以增强合法通信的端到端信噪比 (SNR)。为了量化所提出的通信模型的整体保密性能，我们推导了封闭式传输保密中断概率（TSOP）和基于容量的保密中断概率（SOP）表达式，以综合评估空中安全。我们的分析表明，RIS 的存在提高了中断概率，而 JTRPS 通过使用 RA 的镜像激活模式 (MAP) 添加空间多样性来增强 RIS 的影响。通过模拟证实了所提出场景的效率和由此产生的保密性能表达式的正确性。

articles.title_en: Lightweight LPI radar signal modulation recognition based on feature compensation attention
articles.title_cn: 基于特征补偿注意的轻量级LPI雷达信号调制识别
articles.abstract_en: Low probability of intercept (LPI) radar plays a crucial role in modern radar systems, and the demand for reconnaissance equipment targeting LPI radars is increasing. However, most existing algorithms neglect the issue of model lightweight design, which significantly restricts their applicability in real-world deployment scenarios. To address the challenge of large model size in LPI radar automatic modulation recognition (AMR) algorithms, this paper proposes a lightweight feature compensation attention convolutional network (LFCAN). The proposed LFCAN comprises two key components: a feature compensation attention module and a lightweight convolutional module. The feature compensation attention module is specifically designed to enhance the extraction of fine-grained features, catering to the unique characteristics of LPI radar AMR. Meanwhile, the lightweight convolutional module incorporates feature fusion, depthwise convolutions, pointwise convolutions, and residual connections to effectively reduce redundant parameters while preserving model performance. Experimental results on a publicly available dataset demonstrate that the proposed LFCAN outperforms mainstream LPI radar AMR methods, achieving superior recognition accuracy with significantly reduced model complexity.
articles.abstract_cn: 低截获概率（LPI）雷达在现代雷达系统中扮演着至关重要的角色，针对LPI雷达的侦察设备需求日益增加。然而，现有的大多数算法忽视了模型轻量化设计的问题，这严重限制了它们在实际部署场景中的适用性。为了解决LPI雷达自动调制识别（AMR）算法中模型规模大的挑战，本文提出了一种轻量级特征补偿注意卷积网络（LFCAN）。所提出的LFCAN包含两个关键组件：特征补偿注意模块和轻量级卷积模块。特征补偿注意模块专门设计用于增强细粒度特征的提取，以适应LPI雷达AMR的独特特性。同时，轻量级卷积模块结合了特征融合、深度卷积、逐点卷积和残差连接，以有效减少冗余参数同时保持模型性能。在公开数据集上的实验结果表明，所提出的LFCAN优于主流的LPI雷达AMR方法，在显著降低模型复杂度的同时实现了更高的识别精度。

articles.title_en: Interference-protected long-range spin–valley gates in carbon-nanotube double quantum dots
articles.title_cn: 碳纳米管双量子点中抗干扰的长程自旋-谷门
articles.abstract_en: Long-range gates are important for scalable semiconductor spin platforms. They give a way to connect qubits that do not sit next to each other. The difficulty is that the same electrical response that makes this connection possible can also increase relaxation and leakage. In this work, we use a projected effective model to show how this tradeoff can be softened in carbon-nanotube double quantum dots. The key point is to use spin–orbit coupling in two related but different ways. First, spin–orbit coupling converts a floating-gate charge interaction into an effective logical spin–valley interaction. Second, it creates phonon-assisted relaxation pathways whose phases can cancel each other. We start from a microscopic dot-valley-spin Hamiltonian. We then project the charge-dipole operator and the electron–phonon operators into the same logical subspace. This common projection gives the long-range entangling tensor, the relaxation and dephasing linewidths, and the leakage rates from one set of eigenstates. Within the parameter set studied here, we find finite regions in magnetic-field and detuning space where the projected entangling scale remains appreciable while the total phonon-induced loss is suppressed. A leakage-aware two-qubit master-equation simulation then connects this operating point to gate performance. In this model, the protected point gives lower gate infidelity and slower Bell-state error accumulation than representative lossy and weak-transduction controls. A phase-resolved comparison with an incoherent rate model shows that the improvement comes from amplitude-level phonon-path interference. It is not simply a consequence of turning down the floating-gate coupling. The resulting operating principle is a finite-coupling, low-loss spin–valley gate regime in which useful electrical transduction and phonon protection coexist.
articles.abstract_cn: 长程门对于可扩展的半导体自旋平台至关重要。它们提供了一种连接不相邻量子比特的方式。难点在于，使这种连接成为可能的相同电响应也可能增加弛豫和泄漏。在这项工作中，我们使用一个投影有效模型来展示如何在碳纳米管双量子点中缓和这种权衡。关键点是以两种相关但不同的方式利用自旋-轨道耦合。首先，自旋-轨道耦合将浮栅电荷相互作用转换为有效的逻辑自旋-谷相互作用。其次，它产生了声子辅助的弛豫路径，这些路径的相位可以相互抵消。我们从微观的点-谷-自旋哈密顿量出发。然后，我们将电荷偶极子算符和电子-声子算符投影到相同的逻辑子空间。这种共同投影给出了长程纠缠张量、弛豫和退相干线宽以及从一组本征态出发的泄漏率。在我们研究的参数集内，我们发现在磁场和失谐空间中存在有限区域，其中投影的纠缠尺度保持可观，而总的声子诱导损耗被抑制。一个考虑泄漏的双量子比特主方程模拟随后将这个工作点与门性能联系起来。在这个模型中，与代表性的有损和弱转换控制相比，保护点给出了更低的门保真度误差和更慢的贝尔态误差积累。与不相干速率模型的相位分辨比较表明，改进来自于幅度级声子路径干涉。这不仅仅是降低浮栅耦合的结果。由此产生的工作原则是一个有限耦合、低损耗的自旋-谷门机制，其中有用的电转换和声子保护共存。

articles.title_en: Temporal lobe epilepsy and depression: a dysfunctional lobe overshadows a sclerotic hippocampus
articles.title_cn: 颞叶癫痫与抑郁：功能失调的脑叶掩盖了硬化性海马
articles.abstract_en: Depression is one of the most frequent psychiatric comorbidities in drug-resistant patients with epilepsy, reaching up to 60% of them. Studies indicate that the pathophysiology of depression and epilepsy have a lot in common, especially the temporal lobe epilepsy (TLE). Since hippocampal sclerosis (HS) is a frequent histopathology finding in patients with TLE, the purpose of this study was to investigate if there is a frequency relation between depression and the different types of HS. 119 patients with TLE, with and without HS, were selected (HS1 = 40, HS2 = 40, NHS = 39) and their medical records were analyzed. Depression was seen in 44 of them, without difference between HS types nor NHS (HS1 = 20, HS2 = 12, NHS = 12, p = 0.1). However, women were 3 times more likely to have depression (p = 0.004). Patients without HS were younger at seizure onset than those with HS2 (p = 0.02). The HS2 group had more cases of initial precipitating injury than NHS (p < 0.001) but were similar to HS1 patients. Our study shows that presence of depression in drug-resistant patients with mesial temporal lobe epilepsy is linked to hippocampal disfunction rather than neuronal density in the hippocampus.
articles.abstract_cn: 抑郁是耐药性癫痫患者中最常见的精神共病之一，发生率高达60%。研究表明，抑郁和癫痫的病理生理学有许多共同之处，尤其是颞叶癫痫（TLE）。由于海马硬化（HS）是TLE患者中常见的组织病理学发现，本研究旨在探讨抑郁与不同类型HS之间是否存在频率关系。选取了119例伴有或不伴有HS的TLE患者（HS1 = 40，HS2 = 40，NHS = 39），并分析其医疗记录。其中44例患者出现抑郁，但HS类型之间或与NHS之间无差异（HS1 = 20，HS2 = 12，NHS = 12，p = 0.1）。然而，女性患抑郁的可能性是男性的3倍（p = 0.004）。无HS的患者癫痫发作起始年龄比HS2患者更年轻（p = 0.02）。HS2组初始诱发损伤的病例多于NHS组（p < 0.001），但与HS1患者相似。我们的研究表明，耐药性内侧颞叶癫痫患者中抑郁的存在与海马功能障碍相关，而非海马神经元密度。

articles.title_en: Caregiver burden and care context in families with Dravet syndrome − a nationwide study in the Czech Republic
articles.title_cn: Dravet综合征家庭中的照护者负担与照护背景——捷克共和国全国性研究
articles.abstract_en: Dravet syndrome (DS) is a rare developmental and epileptic encephalopathy characterized by early-onset, drug-resistant seizures and significant long-term neurodevelopmental impairment. This cross-sectional observational study aimed to assess demographic characteristics and caregiving burden among individuals with DS and their informal caregivers in the Czech Republic, and to contribute to estimating disease prevalence and informing the need for national monitoring systems. Data were collected via a questionnaire distributed to informal caregivers (n = 44) between March and May 2025, incorporating the Caregiver Burden Scale and sociodemographic items. With a mean age of 41.5 years, mothers made up the majority of caregivers (93.2%), and they typically reported lower employment engagement. Approximately 34.9% of carers reported mental or psychiatric conditions. Patients (mean age 9.5 years) required extensive assistance across multiple domains of daily functioning. Caregiving burden was substantial, with stress reported in most domains, particularly medication management, supervision, transportation, and household-related activities. Limited access to respite care services was common, primarily due to insufficient availability and financial constraints. The findings highlight the high multidimensional burden associated with DS, affecting caregivers. The absence of systematic national data collection complicates epidemiological assessment and healthcare planning. Establishing a national registry and improving access to support services are essential for optimizing care and reducing caregiver burden. These results provide important baseline data for future research and policy development.
articles.abstract_cn: Dravet综合征（DS）是一种罕见的发育性和癫痫性脑病，其特征为早发性、耐药性癫痫发作和显著的长期神经发育障碍。本横断面观察性研究旨在评估捷克共和国DS患者及其非正式照护者的人口统计学特征和照护负担，并有助于估计疾病患病率及为建立国家监测系统提供信息。数据通过一项在2025年三月至五月期间向非正式照护者（n = 44）发放的问卷收集，问卷包含照护者负担量表和社会人口学项目。照护者平均年龄为41.5岁，其中母亲占大多数（93.2%），且她们通常报告较低的就业参与度。约34.9%的照护者报告存在精神或心理疾病。患者（平均年龄9.5岁）在日常功能的多个领域需要广泛协助。照护负担显著，多数领域报告存在压力，尤其是药物管理、监督、交通和家务相关活动。喘息照护服务的可及性普遍有限，主要由于服务供应不足和经济限制。研究结果凸显了与DS相关的高多维负担对照护者的影响。缺乏系统的国家数据收集使流行病学评估和医疗规划复杂化。建立国家登记册和改善支持服务的可及性对于优化护理和减轻照护者负担至关重要。这些结果为未来研究和政策制定提供了重要的基线数据。

articles.title_en: Epilepsy of infancy with migrating focal seizures: A scoping review of clinical features, diagnostic testing including genetics, long-term outcomes, mortality, and current and emerging therapeutic strategies
articles.title_cn: 婴儿期迁移性局灶性癫痫发作：临床特征、包括遗传学在内的诊断检测、长期结局、死亡率及当前和新兴治疗策略的范围综述
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 The Author(s) Background: Epilepsy of infancy with migrating focal seizures (EIMFS) is among the most severe developmental and epileptic encephalopathies (DEEs), marked by intractable multifocal seizures migrating across both hemispheres, profound developmental arrest, and high early mortality. Advances in next-generation sequencing have revealed a heterogeneous genetic architecture dominated by KCNT1 gain-of-function variants across more than 30 implicated genes, creating opportunities for precision therapeutics. Objective: To systematically map published evidence on the clinical, electrophysiological, neuroimaging, genetic, and therapeutic landscape of EIMFS, and to delineate critical knowledge gaps and future research priorities. Methods: A scoping review was conducted following the Arksey and O'Malley framework, searching PubMed, Ovid MEDLINE, Embase, Cochrane Library/CENTRAL, and ClinicalTrials.gov. Results: Of 643 articles screened, 89 met inclusion criteria. Beyond confirmation of the canonical electroclinical phenotype, several gaps emerged: neonatal versus post-neonatal onset stratification by genetic etiology remains largely uncharacterized; genotype-specific EEG biomarkers are lacking except for a single small KCNT1 study; and the clinical significance of atypical EEG features—including burst suppression and hypsarrhythmia—is undefined. Neuroimaging literature documents progressive cerebral atrophy and myelination abnormalities without quantitative volumetry, diffusion tractography markers, or attribution to seizure burden, medication effects, or underlying etiology. Genetic diagnostic yield was 70–80%, with KCNT1 accounting for 30–50% of solved cases; however, genotype-outcome stratification is limited. Seizures were broadly refractory; potassium bromide, ketogenic diet, cannabidiol, and quinidine (in KCNT1-confirmed cases) showed partial efficacy. Emerging precision approaches include sodium channel blockers for SCN2A gain-of-function variants, novel small molecules, fluoxetine, antisense oligonucleotides, and divalent siRNA targeting KCNT1. Systemic-to-pulmonary collateral circulation causing severe cardiopulmonary complications was reported across multiple cases, yet no consensus screening protocol exists. Conclusions: EIMFS remains one of the most refractory epilepsy syndromes of infancy. Precision genetic diagnosis is essential to guide targeted therapy. International collaborative registries, standardized outcome measures, genotype-stratified biomarker studies, and rapid point-of-care genomic testing are urgently needed to advance evidence-based care for this highly vulnerable population.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 作者。背景：婴儿期迁移性局灶性癫痫发作（EIMFS）是最严重的发育性和癫痫性脑病（DEEs）之一，其特征为难治性多灶性癫痫发作在两侧半球迁移、严重发育停滞和早期高死亡率。下一代测序的进展揭示了以KCNT1功能获得性变异为主的异质性遗传结构，涉及超过30个相关基因，为精准治疗创造了机会。目的：系统性地绘制关于EIMFS的临床、电生理、神经影像、遗传和治疗领域的已发表证据，并界定关键知识空白和未来研究优先事项。方法：按照Arksey和O'Malley框架进行范围综述，检索PubMed、Ovid MEDLINE、Embase、Cochrane Library/CENTRAL和ClinicalTrials.gov。结果：在筛选的643篇文章中，89篇符合纳入标准。除了确认典型电临床表型外，出现了几个空白：新生儿期与新生儿后期发病按遗传病因分层在很大程度上仍未明确；除了一项小型KCNT1研究外，缺乏基因型特异性脑电图生物标志物；非典型脑电图特征（包括爆发抑制和高度节律失常）的临床意义尚未确定。神经影像文献记录了进行性脑萎缩和髓鞘形成异常，但没有定量体积测量、弥散纤维束成像标志物，也未归因于癫痫发作负担、药物效应或潜在病因。遗传诊断检出率为70-80%，其中KCNT1占已解决病例的30-50%；然而，基因型-结局分层有限。癫痫发作普遍难治；溴化钾、生酮饮食、大麻二酚和奎尼丁（在KCNT1确诊病例中）显示出部分疗效。新兴的精准方法包括针对SCN2A功能获得性变异的钠通道阻滞剂、新型小分子、氟西汀、反义寡核苷酸和靶向KCNT1的二价siRNA。多个病例报告了导致严重心肺并发症的体肺侧支循环，但尚无共识筛查方案。结论：EIMFS仍然是最难治的婴儿期癫痫综合征之一。精准遗传诊断对于指导靶向治疗至关重要。国际协作注册中心、标准化结局指标、基因型分层生物标志物研究以及快速即时基因检测是推进这一高度脆弱人群循证护理的迫切需求。

articles.title_en: Process-induced local and near-spot electrostatic shifts in thermally oxidized SiO<ce:inf loc=post>2</ce:inf>/Si MOS structures following defocused nanosecond laser microstructuring
articles.title_cn: 散焦纳秒激光微结构化后，热氧化 SiO<ce:inf loc=post>2</ce:inf>/Si MOS 结构中工艺引起的局部和近点静电位移
articles.abstract_en: Pulsed laser microstructuring is widely used in silicon processing, but its influence on the electrostatic state of nearby dielectric–semiconductor interfaces remains insufficiently understood before catastrophic laser-induced damage. Here, we investigate the local and near-spot electrostatic response of thermally oxidized SiO2/Si MOS structures subjected to defocused 1062-nm nanosecond laser irradiation. n-Si(111) samples with a 150-nm thermal oxide layer were irradiated to produce approximately circular laser-modified regions with diameters of 0.9–1.2 mm, and high-frequency capacitance–voltage (CV) measurements were performed using an InGa top contact. The reference-voltage shift was extracted at a fixed normalized capacitance level ( C / C max = 0.45 ) and expressed as a charge-equivalent electrostatic shift metric, rather than as an absolute oxide- or interface-charge density. Repeated evaluations on four independent MOS samples show that the local response evolves non-monotonically within the 0–50 s pre-catastrophic exposure window. At fixed average power and exposure time, the response also depends on the coupled pulse-train condition, including repetition rate, pulse energy, and accumulated pulse number. Near-spot measurements performed 1–2 mm from the irradiated edge indicate a weaker electrostatic perturbation outside the visibly modified region. Together with the observed slip-line/deformation morphology and first-order thermal considerations, these results are consistent with a substrate-mediated contribution to the oxide/interface electrostatic response. These findings provide an experimentally supported phenomenological basis for identifying low-electrostatic-perturbation pre-catastrophic processing windows in laser-assisted silicon microfabrication, while long-term dielectric integrity requires further verification by leakage-current, dielectric-breakdown, recovery, and bias-temperature-stress measurements.
articles.abstract_cn: 脉冲激光微结构广泛应用于硅加工中，但在灾难性激光引起的损伤之前，其对附近介电-半导体界面静电状态的影响仍未得到充分了解。在这里，我们研究了热氧化 SiO2/Si MOS 结构在散焦 ​​1062-nm 纳秒激光照射下的局部和近点静电响应。对具有 150 nm 热氧化层的 n-Si(111) 样品进行辐照，产生直径为 0.9-1.2 mm 的近似圆形激光改性区域，并使用 InGa 顶部接触进行高频电容电压 (CV) 测量。参考电压偏移是在固定的归一化电容水平（C / C max = 0.45）下提取的，并表示为电荷等效静电偏移度量，而不是绝对氧化物或界面电荷密度。对四个独立 MOS 样本的重复评估表明，局部响应在 0-50 s 灾难前暴露窗口内非单调演变。在固定平均功率和曝光时间下，响应还取决于耦合脉冲序列条件，包括重复率、脉冲能量和累积脉冲数。在距离照射边缘 1-2 毫米处进行的近点测量表明，在可见修改区域之外的静电扰动较弱。连同观察到的滑移线/变形形态和一阶热考虑因素，这些结果与基底介导的氧化物/界面静电响应的贡献一致。这些发现为识别激光辅助硅微加工中的低静电扰动灾难前处理窗口提供了实验支持的现象学基础，而长期介电完整性需要通过漏电流、介电击穿、恢复和偏置温度应力测量进行进一步验证。

articles.title_en: From catastrophe to culture: The role of historical disasters in shaping long-term orientation
articles.title_cn: 从灾难到文化：历史灾难在塑造长期导向中的作用
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. Natural disasters expose societies to an external environment that requires forward-looking adaptation. This paper argues that societies with greater historical exposure to natural disasters are more likely to develop long-term-oriented norms that emphasize preparation, saving, and future well-being. We test this hypothesis by linking historical exposure to earthquakes, tsunamis, and volcanic eruptions from 4360 BC to 1980 CE to contemporary long-term orientation. Disaster exposure is proxied by a distance-based measure that aggregates proximity to major catastrophic events over long horizons. Long-term orientation is examined using folklore traditions at the ethnic level and survey-based evidence at the individual and country levels. Across all levels of analysis, we find that greater cumulative disaster exposure is associated with significantly stronger long-term orientation. Evidence from folklore and second-generation migrants suggests that these effects operate through cultural adaptation and intergenerational transmission.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. 自然灾害使社会暴露于需要前瞻性适应的外部环境中。本文认为，历史上遭受更多自然灾害的社会更可能发展出强调准备、储蓄和未来福祉的长期导向规范。我们通过将公元前4360年至公元1980年间地震、海啸和火山喷发的历史暴露与当代长期导向联系起来，检验了这一假设。灾难暴露通过一种基于距离的度量来代理，该度量汇总了长期内接近重大灾难事件的程度。长期导向则通过族群层面的民间传说传统以及个人和国家层面的调查证据来考察。在所有分析层面上，我们发现更大的累积灾难暴露与显著更强的长期导向相关。来自民间传说和第二代移民的证据表明，这些效应通过文化适应和代际传递发挥作用。

articles.title_en: Who drives inequality?
articles.title_cn: 谁在推动不平等？
articles.abstract_en: Which countries drive global inequality? Which states drive US inequality? We characterize the class of inequality measures that can answer these questions, permitting both an additive decomposition by subgroup and a multiplicative decomposition into within- and between-group components. Its central measure is simply the expected ratio of incomes between two randomly selected individuals. We show that global inequality fell since 1990, driven by declining disparities between countries. Inequality is primarily driven by large middle-income countries (India, China) and poor countries (Democratic Republic of Congo, Ethiopia). In the US, rising inequality is explained by widening gaps within states, while between-state inequality remains limited.
articles.abstract_cn: 哪些国家推动了全球不平等？哪些州推动了美国的不平等？我们刻画了一类能够回答这些问题的不平等度量，这类度量既允许按子群进行加性分解，也允许分解为组内和组间成分的乘性分解。其核心度量仅仅是两个随机选择的个体之间收入的期望比率。我们表明，自1990年以来，全球不平等有所下降，这得益于国家间差距的缩小。不平等主要由大型中等收入国家（印度、中国）和贫困国家（刚果民主共和国、埃塞俄比亚）推动。在美国，不平等加剧是由州内差距扩大所解释的，而州间不平等仍然有限。

articles.title_en: Property rights and market frictions: Evidence from the universe of land dispute files in China
articles.title_cn: 产权与市场摩擦：来自中国土地纠纷档案全集的证据
articles.abstract_en: This research demonstrates how securing land property rights can mitigate frictions in rural land rental markets, specifically in the form of landlord-tenant disputes. By combining a comprehensive data set of land rental dispute records, farm-level panel data, and complete agricultural firm registration data, we find that rental disputes decreased following China's land titling reform. We corroborate this finding by distinguishing between property rights-related disputes (e.g., ownership ambiguity, boundary issues, or expropriation) and contractual enforcement disputes (e.g., rent collection). Further analysis reveals that the effect is particularly pronounced in rental agreements between farmers and agricultural firms, especially those involving non-local entities.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究展示了如何通过保障土地产权来缓解农村土地租赁市场中的摩擦，具体表现为地主与租户之间的纠纷。通过结合土地租赁纠纷记录的全面数据集、农户层面面板数据以及完整的农业企业注册数据，我们发现中国的土地确权改革后租赁纠纷有所减少。我们通过区分与产权相关的纠纷（如所有权模糊、边界问题或征收）和合同执行纠纷（如租金收取）来证实这一发现。进一步分析显示，这一效应在农户与农业企业之间的租赁协议中尤为显著，尤其是涉及非本地实体的协议。

articles.title_en: A coarse-grained guided straightforward diffusion model for electric submersible pump data imputation
articles.title_cn: 一种用于电潜泵数据插补的粗粒度引导直接扩散模型
articles.abstract_en: Electric submersible pump systems rely on high-frequency multivariate sensing, yet their operational data frequently suffer from severe missingness and structured gaps, compromising condition monitoring. To address this, we propose a coarse-grained guided straightforward diffusion model specifically designed for ESP data imputation. First, we estimate an initial coarse prior using a global pre-filling module. This prior is then converted into a set of adaptive affine coefficients. These coefficients are subsequently precisely calibrated using a feature-wise linear modulation mechanism to effectively guide the subsequent denoising process. Second, we use a straightforward prediction target instead of noise prediction, so that the training objective is directly aligned with clean-signal reconstruction on missing entries. Third, a DDIM-based accelerated sampling strategy is employed to reduce inference costs while maintaining imputation accuracy under a reduced-step deterministic trajectory. Finally, extensive experiments on the real ESP dataset demonstrated the effectiveness and superiority of our method across various missing patterns.
articles.abstract_cn: 电潜泵系统依赖高频多变量传感，但其运行数据经常遭受严重缺失和结构化空缺，影响状态监测。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种专门用于ESP数据插补的粗粒度引导直接扩散模型。首先，我们使用全局预填充模块估计初始粗先验。该先验随后被转换为一组自适应仿射系数。这些系数随后通过特征级线性调制机制进行精确校准，以有效引导后续去噪过程。其次，我们使用直接预测目标而非噪声预测，使训练目标直接与缺失条目上的干净信号重建对齐。第三，采用基于DDIM的加速采样策略，以减少推理成本，同时在减少步数的确定性轨迹下保持插补精度。最后，在真实ESP数据集上的广泛实验证明了我们方法在各种缺失模式下的有效性和优越性。

articles.title_en: A PSO based spline-kernelled chirp mode decomposition approach
articles.title_cn: 基于粒子群优化的样条核线性调频模式分解方法
articles.abstract_en: In practical operating conditions, vibration responses of rotating machines often exhibit highly non-stationary and complex, and may show sudden frequency changes, which increases the difficulty of accurate signal decomposition. Although adaptive chirp mode decomposition and its variants provide high time–frequency resolution, they depend on initial frequency estimation and have difficulty tracking abrupt instantaneous frequency (IF) variations. To overcome this problem, an improved spline-kernelled chirp mode decomposition (SCMD) framework is proposed to improve the decomposition accuracy of complex multi-component signals. First, exploiting the strong time–frequency concentration of synchrosqueezed chirplet transform (SCT), accurate IF estimation and fitting are achieved. To mitigate the influence of window length on SCT-based IF estimation, an adaptive PSIFO scheme is developed. A fit index R, combining ridge energy concentration and information entropy, is introduced to weight the penalty term and construct the objective function. The optimal observation window is then globally optimized via particle swarm optimization (PSO) to obtain precise IF estimates. Subsequently, an adaptive amplitude filtering strategy based on a demodulation model progressively extracts and reconstructs individual components. Experimental results demonstrate that SCMD achieves superior time–frequency resolution and stronger noise robustness than conventional methods for non-stationary vibration signals.
articles.abstract_cn: 在实际运行条件下，旋转机械的振动响应往往表现出高度非平稳和复杂性，并可能出现频率突变，这增加了精确信号分解的难度。尽管自适应线性调频模式分解及其变体提供了高时频分辨率，但它们依赖于初始频率估计，并且难以跟踪突变的瞬时频率变化。为克服这一问题，提出了一种改进的样条核线性调频模式分解框架，以提高复杂多分量信号的分解精度。首先，利用同步压缩小波变换的强时频集中性，实现精确的瞬时频率估计和拟合。为减轻窗长对基于同步压缩小波变换的瞬时频率估计的影响，开发了一种自适应PSIFO方案。引入一个结合脊能量集中度和信息熵的拟合指数R，用于加权惩罚项并构建目标函数。然后通过粒子群优化全局优化最优观测窗口，以获得精确的瞬时频率估计。随后，基于解调模型的自适应幅度滤波策略逐步提取和重构各个分量。实验结果表明，对于非平稳振动信号，该方法在时频分辨率和噪声鲁棒性方面优于传统方法。

articles.title_en: Depth-assisted spatial-frequency fusion network for camouflaged object detection
articles.title_cn: 深度辅助的空间-频率融合网络用于伪装目标检测
articles.abstract_en: Camouflaged Object Detection (COD) aims to identify objects that are highly blended into their surrounding environment. However, this task poses significant challenges due to the diverse scales of targets, their complex contours, and their extreme similarity to the background in terms of both color and texture. This inherent similarity makes it difficult for RGB-only COD models to effectively distinguish the foreground from the background, often resulting in missed detections, incomplete segmentation, and blurred boundaries. To address this challenge, we propose a Depth-Assisted Spatial-Frequency Fusion Network for COD (DASFF-Net). Specifically, pseudo-depth maps are first generated offline from RGB images using a monocular depth estimation method and then used as auxiliary inputs. A dual-stream encoder is adopted to extract multimodal features from RGB images and the corresponding depth maps. Furthermore, we design a Frequency Domain Perception Enhancement (FDPE) module to achieve cross-modal fusion, which enhances high-frequency details guided by low-frequency information to improve the structural perception of camouflaged objects. Finally, we propose a progressive decoder that accomplishes coarse-to-fine feature optimization through cascaded Context-Aware Fuson Modules (CAFMs). By leveraging multi-scale context aggregation and a dual-path attenion mechanism at each stage, the decoder achieves precise localization and detail refinement of camouflaged objects. Extensive experimental results on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that DASFF-Net significantly outperforms 22 state-of-the-art methods.
articles.abstract_cn: 伪装目标检测（COD）旨在识别与其周围环境高度融合的目标。然而，由于目标尺度多样、轮廓复杂以及与背景在颜色和纹理上极度相似，这一任务面临重大挑战。这种固有的相似性使得仅依赖RGB的COD模型难以有效区分前景和背景，常常导致漏检、分割不完整和边界模糊。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种用于COD的深度辅助空间-频率融合网络（DASFF-Net）。具体而言，首先使用单目深度估计方法从RGB图像离线生成伪深度图，并将其作为辅助输入。采用双流编码器从RGB图像和相应的深度图中提取多模态特征。此外，我们设计了一个频域感知增强（FDPE）模块以实现跨模态融合，该模块在低频信息引导下增强高频细节，以改善伪装目标的结构感知。最后，我们提出了一种渐进式解码器，通过级联的上下文感知融合模块（CAFMs）实现从粗到细的特征优化。通过利用多尺度上下文聚合和每阶段的双路径注意力机制，解码器实现了伪装目标的精确定位和细节细化。在三个基准数据集上的大量实验结果表明，DASFF-Net显著优于22最先进的方法。

articles.title_en: Alexithymia and its relationship with cognition and psychological outcomes in patients with drug-resistant epilepsy
articles.abstract_en: IntroductionDrug-resistant epilepsy (DRE) is associated with substantial cognitive and psychosocial burden. Alexithymia has been proposed as a relevant emotional processing deficit in epilepsy, but data in DRE are limited. This study examines alexithymia and its associations with cognition and psychological outcomes in patients with DRE. MethodsSeventy-five patients with DRE underwent cognitive and psychological assessment. Alexithymia was assessed using the TAS-20 and affective symptoms using the DASS-42. A comprehensive neuropsychological battery was administered and composite scores for attention/processing speed, verbal memory, and executive functions were derived from z-standardized test scores. Associations were examined using correlations and hierarchical multiple regression analyses. ResultsPatients included 29 with frontal lobe epilepsy, 36 with mesial temporal lobe epilepsy, and 10 with genetic generalized epilepsy, with no significant group differences in demographic or most clinical variables. Alexithymia was present in 22.6% of patients and did not differ across epilepsy subgroups. Stress was independently associated with alexithymia, while externally oriented thinking (EOT) was associated with poorer verbal memory and executive functioning; no associations were found between alexithymia and attention/processing speed. Adjusted regression models accounted for 35–36% of the total variance in memory and executive performance, respectively, with EOT emerging as the only alexithymia dimension independently associated with poorer performance. ConclusionAlexithymia in drug-resistant epilepsy is primarily associated with stress and poorer cognitive performance, particularly verbal memory and executive functioning, underscoring the clinical importance of emotional dysregulation.

articles.title_en: Perceived stigma in drug-resistant epilepsy: Association with vagus nerve stimulation and disease burden
articles.title_cn: 耐药性癫痫中的感知病耻感：与迷走神经刺激及疾病负担的关联
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Inc. Background: Stigma is an important psychosocial problem in patients with drug-resistant epilepsy (DRE). Although vagus nerve stimulation (VNS) may improve seizure control, its association with perceived stigma remains unclear. This study evaluated the relationship between VNS and perceived stigma in patients with DRE. Method: In this single-center cross-sectional study, 70 patients with DRE were enrolled, including 35 patients with implanted VNS and 35 without VNS. Perceived stigma was assessed using the Stigma Scale for Epilepsy, and the individual impact of epilepsy was evaluated using the Personal Impact of Epilepsy Scale (PIES). Multivariable regression analysis was performed to identify factors independently associated with perceived stigma. Results: Patients with VNS had significantly higher total stigma scores and higher social isolation, discrimination, insufficiency, and false beliefs subscale scores (all p ≤ 0.003). Moderate-to-high stigmatization was more frequent in the VNS group (p < 0.001). VNS treatment was remained associated with higher stigma scores in multivariable regression analysis. Patients in the VNS group had a younger age at epilepsy onset, longer disease duration, and used a greater number of antiseizure medications (all p ≤ 0.003). Total PIES and seizure effect scores were also higher in patients with VNS (p = 0.039 and p = 0.025, respectively). PIES scores showed significant positive correlations with stigma subscale and total stigma scores. Conclusions: Patients with DRE treated with VNS appear to experience a greater burden of perceived stigma. The persistence of this association after adjustment for demographic and clinical factors suggests that psychosocial aspects of VNS treatment warrant greater attention.
