articles.title_en: In-situ monitoring of bond wires in IGBT modules via maximum turn-on voltage of auxiliary emitter
articles.title_cn: IGBT模块中键合线通过辅助发射极最大开启电压的原位监测
articles.abstract_en: Copyright © 2026. Published by Elsevier Ltd. This paper presents a novel in-situ monitoring approach for assessing bond wire aging in IGBT modules, utilizing the maximum turn-on voltage of auxiliary emitter ( V eE-max ) as an aging-sensitive indicator. Initially, based on the turn-on characteristics of IGBT module and equivalent circuit model, this paper systematically analyzes the physical origin and evolution mechanism of V eE-max in relation to bond wire aging. To facilitate real-time measurement, a dedicated peak monitoring circuit is designed and implemented. Then, the feasibility of the proposed method is verified using a double-pulse test circuit, and the effects of operating conditions such as bus voltage, gate resistance, load current and junction temperature are discussed. Experimental results demonstrate that V eE-max exhibits high sensitivity to bond wire aging, with a measured variation of approximately 1.795 V per wire and is not affected by junction temperature and load current, validating its effectiveness as a condition monitoring parameter.
articles.abstract_cn: 版权所有© 2026。由Elsevier Ltd出版。本文提出了一种新颖的原位监测方法，用于评估IGBT模块中键合线的老化，利用辅助发射极的最大开启电压（V eE-max）作为老化敏感指标。首先，基于IGBT模块的开启特性和等效电路模型，本文系统地分析了V eE-max与键合线老化相关的物理起源和演化机制。为便于实时测量，设计并实现了一个专用的峰值监测电路。然后，使用双脉冲测试电路验证了所提出方法的可行性，并讨论了母线电压、栅极电阻、负载电流和结温等操作条件的影响。实验结果表明，V eE-max对键合线老化表现出高灵敏度，每根线的测量变化约为1.795伏，且不受结温和负载电流的影响，验证了其作为状态监测参数的有效性。

articles.title_en: MSSFuse: Multimodal image fusion with mixed spatial and sequential modeling
articles.title_cn: MSSFuse：混合空间与序列建模的多模态图像融合
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Inc. Infrared and visible image fusion is a key preprocessing technique in the field of infrared technology, integrating complementary multimodal information. However, effectively fusing local texture details with global contextual semantics to generate clear and structurally consistent fused images remains a core challenge. We propose MSSFuse, a novel fusion network featuring two core components: the Residual Channel-Spatial Self-Calibration (RCSSC) module and the State Space Model Enhanced Squeeze-and-Excitation (SSMSE) Block. The RCSSC adopts a dual-branch structure to highlight salient spatial regions and recalibrate channel-wise features, enabling adaptive spatial-channel refinement. The SSMSE Block integrates State Space Models (SSMs) to capture long-range dependencies across channels, enhancing global feature modulation capability. Extensive experiments on MSRS, RoadScene, and TNO datasets demonstrate the superior performance of our method: on RoadScene, it achieves an Entropy of 7.36 and a Standard Deviation of 50.77, outperforming existing approaches significantly. Comparative and ablation studies validate the synergistic effect of the two modules, providing a reliable technical solution for high-quality infrared and visible image fusion.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Inc. 红外与可见光图像融合是红外技术领域中的关键预处理技术，整合互补的多模态信息。然而，有效融合局部纹理细节与全局上下文语义以生成清晰且结构一致的融合图像仍是一个核心挑战。我们提出了MSSFuse，一种新颖的融合网络，包含两个核心组件：残差通道-空间自校准（RCSSC）模块和状态空间模型增强的压缩-激励（SSMSE）块。RCSSC采用双分支结构来突出显著空间区域并重新校准通道特征，实现自适应空间-通道细化。SSMSE块集成状态空间模型（SSMs）以捕获跨通道的长距离依赖，增强全局特征调制能力。在MSRS、RoadScene和TNO数据集上的大量实验证明了我们方法的优越性能：在RoadScene上，它实现了7.36的信息熵和50.77的标准差，显著优于现有方法。对比和消融研究验证了这两个模块的协同效应，为高质量红外与可见光图像融合提供了可靠的技术解决方案。

articles.title_en: MCFAD-YOLO: Multi-scale context-aware feature aggregation for small object detection in remote sensing images
articles.title_cn: MCFAD-YOLO：用于遥感图像小目标检测的多尺度上下文感知特征聚合
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Inc. Small targets in remote sensing images are typically characterized by small scale, dense distribution, and complex backgrounds. During continuous downsampling and multi-scale feature fusion, key information can be easily lost, posing a significant challenge for target detection. To address the limitations of existing methods in small-target feature representation and context modeling, this paper proposes a Multi-scale Context-Aware Feature Aggregation Network (MCFAD-YOLO) for remote sensing small-target detection. This method improves the discriminative feature representation of small targets by leveraging a multi-scale context-aware mechanism and constructing a dual-path feature aggregation structure. It effectively integrates local detailed features with global semantic information during multi-scale feature transfer, thus mitigating feature degradation caused by downsampling and cross-layer fusion. In addition, a fine-grained context fusion detection head is introduced to improve the localization and recognition capabilities of small targets in complex backgrounds and high-density scenes. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed strategy achieves superior detection performance compared to mainstream YOLO series models on the SIMD, VisDrone2019, and RSOD datasets. Compared with the baseline model YOLOv11-S, the proposed method achieves improvements of 2.1%, 3.0%, and 0.4% in mAP 50 , and 1.4%, 2.2%, and 1.1% in mAP 50: 95 on SIMD, VisDrone2019, and RSOD respectively, while maintaining a reasonable model size, validating its effectiveness and practical value in complex aerial photography scenarios. The code will be publicly available at: https://github.com/wbbjjj/MCFAD-yolo-main .
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Inc. 遥感图像中的小目标通常具有尺度小、分布密集和背景复杂的特点。在连续下采样和多尺度特征融合过程中，关键信息容易丢失，给目标检测带来了重大挑战。为了解决现有方法在小目标特征表示和上下文建模方面的局限性，本文提出了一种用于遥感小目标检测的多尺度上下文感知特征聚合网络（MCFAD-YOLO）。该方法通过利用多尺度上下文感知机制并构建双路径特征聚合结构，提高了小目标的判别性特征表示。在多尺度特征传递过程中，有效整合了局部细节特征与全局语义信息，从而减轻了下采样和跨层融合引起的特征退化。此外，引入了一个细粒度上下文融合检测头，以提高复杂背景和高密度场景中小目标的定位和识别能力。实验结果表明，在SIMD、VisDrone2019和RSOD数据集上，所提出的策略相比主流YOLO系列模型取得了更优的检测性能。与基线模型YOLOv11-S相比，所提出的方法在SIMD、VisDrone2019和RSOD上的mAP 50分别提高了2.1%、3.0%和0.4%，在mAP 50:95上分别提高了1.4%、2.2%和1.1%，同时保持了合理的模型大小，验证了其在复杂航拍场景中的有效性和实用价值。代码将在https://github.com/wbbjjj/MCFAD-yolo-main公开提供。

articles.title_en: Covariance-based distributed fusion estimation in multi-sensor networks under two-channel random deception attacks
articles.title_cn: 基于协方差的双通道随机欺骗攻击下多传感器网络分布式融合估计
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Inc. This paper investigates the distributed signal estimation problem in insecure wireless networked multisensor systems, where sensor measurements are subject to stochastic perturbations modeled through random parameter matrices. Network vulnerability is introduced by random deception attacks occurring on two communication channels: from the sensor-measurement outputs to the local estimation processors, and from the local processors to the fusion center. A covariance-based technique is used to design distributed algorithms, requiring no knowledge of the signal evolution model. The proposed architecture proceeds in three stages. First, local least-squares linear estimators are derived at each processor while accounting for stochastic measurement distortions. Second, refined local estimators are constructed by incorporating the effect of second-channel attacks. Third, distributed fusion estimators are computed as a matrix-weighted linear combination of the refined local estimates using the mean squared error as the optimality criterion. A numerical example demonstrates the effectiveness of the resulting framework and quantifies the impact of stochastic uncertainties and random attacks on accuracy. The results show that the proposed method provides exact error covariance characterization, which can be computed offline, significantly reducing the online computational burden compared to existing approaches. This unified framework successfully encompasses common network-induced imperfections, proving its robustness and applicability in resource-constrained, adversarial environments.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Inc. 本文研究了不安全无线网络化多传感器系统中的分布式信号估计问题，其中传感器测量受到通过随机参数矩阵建模的随机扰动的影响。网络脆弱性由发生在两个通信通道上的随机欺骗攻击引入：从传感器测量输出到局部估计处理器，以及从局部处理器到融合中心。采用基于协方差的技术来设计分布式算法，无需知道信号演化模型。所提出的架构分三个阶段进行。首先，在每个处理器处推导局部最小二乘线性估计器，同时考虑随机测量失真。其次，通过纳入第二通道攻击的影响来构建改进的局部估计器。第三，使用均方误差作为最优性准则，将分布式融合估计器计算为改进局部估计的矩阵加权线性组合。数值示例证明了所提出框架的有效性，并量化了随机不确定性和随机攻击对精度的影响。结果表明，所提出的方法提供了精确的误差协方差表征，可以离线计算，与现有方法相比显著降低了在线计算负担。这一统一框架成功涵盖了常见的网络引起的缺陷，证明了其在资源受限、对抗性环境中的鲁棒性和适用性。

articles.title_en: Dual branch dehazing network based on feature compensation
articles.title_cn: 基于特征补偿的双分支去雾网络
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Inc. Current deep learning models often fail to effectively handle complex image dehazing due to insufficient guidance from object information, particularly in distant areas with dense haze. To solve this problem, we propose DBDNet, a brand-new prior-combined model that embeds the Dark Channel Prior (DCP) for feature compensation. To be specific, we embed the DCP method to generate a prior dehazed image as an additional input alongside the hazy input. Then, a dual branch structure based on an end-to-end paradigm is adopted to extract their features simultaneously. Since the extracted features are highly complementary, a Mutual Style Simulation Mechanism (MSSM) is proposed to effectively aggregate them before generating two preliminary dehazing results. Moreover, an efficient Space-adaptive Fusion Module (SFM) is also developed to adaptively fuse results in spatial domains, further combining their advantages. All the supervisions for DBDNet are ground truths (GTs), and it works more like an ensemble-learning approach by incorporating the learning from DCP-dehazed images. Experiments show that DBDNet achieves better generalization and causes less distortion than the state-of-the-art dehazing method for both synthetic and real scenes.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Inc. 当前的深度学习模型往往因缺乏对象信息的充分引导，尤其是在浓雾密集的远距离区域，而无法有效处理复杂的图像去雾问题。为解决此问题，我们提出了DBDNet，一种全新的先验组合模型，嵌入暗通道先验（DCP）进行特征补偿。具体而言，我们嵌入DCP方法生成先验去雾图像，作为除雾霾输入之外的额外输入。然后，采用基于端到端范式的双分支结构同时提取它们的特征。由于提取的特征高度互补，我们提出了一种互风格模拟机制（MSSM），在生成两个初步去雾结果之前有效聚合这些特征。此外，还开发了一种高效的空间自适应融合模块（SFM），在空间域自适应融合结果，进一步结合它们的优势。DBDNet的所有监督均为真实值（GTs），其工作方式更类似于集成学习方法，通过纳入从DCP去雾图像中学习的信息。实验表明，DBDNet在合成和真实场景中均比最先进的去雾方法具有更好的泛化能力，并产生更少的失真。

articles.title_en: Saliency-guided instance segmentation of pole-like objects in dense ground-based point clouds
articles.title_cn: 基于显著性引导的密集地面点云中杆状物体实例分割
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Inc. The existing methods for instance segmentation of pole-like objects (PLOs) are tailored to a specific type of environment. In this paper, we propose a saliency-guided individual PLO segmentation method that leverages geometric features and PLO structure to achieve higher segmentation accuracy across various scene point clouds. First, the ground and building points in the scene are removed after implementing the region growing algorithm on the planar supervoxels. Then, the saliency value of each point is calculated based on the Fast Point Feature Histogram (FPFH) descriptor. The remaining points are classified into high saliency points and low saliency points based on the saliency values. Next, the low saliency points are segmented using the mean-shift algorithm and each cluster is represented by a central point, referred to as a structural node. Shared common nodes are extracted to represent the main structure of an individual PLO based on the construction of shortest paths. Subsequently, a reverse growth connection algorithm is designed to find the skeletal structure of each PLO. Finally, high saliency points above the junction of branches and leaves are assigned to the nearest structural node associated with a specific PLO. Three different types of scene point clouds, covering campus scene, urban scenes and forest scenes, are used to evaluate the proposed method. The experimental results indicate that the proposed method exhibits a strong ability to segment individual PLOs in different environments.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Inc. 现有的杆状物体（PLOs）实例分割方法针对特定类型的环境定制。本文提出了一种显著性引导的单个PLO分割方法，利用几何特征和PLO结构，在各种场景点云中实现更高的分割精度。首先，在平面超体素上实施区域生长算法后，移除场景中的地面和建筑物点。然后，基于快速点特征直方图（FPFH）描述子计算每个点的显著性值。根据显著性值，剩余点被分为高显著性点和低显著性点。接下来，使用均值漂移算法对低显著性点进行分割，每个簇由一个中心点表示，称为结构节点。基于最短路径的构建，提取共享公共节点以表示单个PLO的主要结构。随后，设计了一种反向生长连接算法来找到每个PLO的骨架结构。最后，将分支和叶片交界处上方的高显著性点分配给与特定PLO关联的最近结构节点。使用三种不同类型的场景点云，涵盖校园场景、城市场景和森林场景，来评估所提出的方法。实验结果表明，所提出的方法在不同环境中分割单个PLO表现出强大的能力。

articles.title_en: Edge-guided transformer network for small object detection in UAV imagery
articles.title_cn: 面向无人机影像小目标检测的边缘引导Transformer网络
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Inc. Existing object detection models generally neglect edge information, resulting in the loss of critical details in small object detection under UAV scenarios. To address this issue, this study proposes a novel edge-guided transformer detector that hierarchically incorporates edge cues to progressively enhance small objects. First, to solve the inefficiency of information acquisition, we proposed a Gaussian edge enhancement module (GEEM) that increases the extraction of object edge features, ensuring the effective utilization of edge information. Second, to mitigate the loss of small-object edge information during feature fusion, we propose an information flow path aggregation network (Info-PAN), that bridges deep semantic and shallow detail features through an information flow mechanism. Finally, to alleviate the insufficient information for small targets, we proposed a soft-combination fusion block (SFB) that dynamically integrates multi-scale features and enhances small-object representation. Experimental results on the VisDrone dataset demonstrate that the proposed model outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both mAP50 and mAP50:95. Further ablation studies confirmed the effectiveness of each introduced module in improving the detection performance in UAV scenarios.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Inc. 现有目标检测模型普遍忽略边缘信息，导致在无人机场景下小目标检测中关键细节的丢失。为解决这一问题，本研究提出了一种新颖的边缘引导Transformer检测器，通过分层整合边缘线索逐步增强小目标。首先，为解决信息获取效率低下的问题，我们提出了高斯边缘增强模块（GEEM），增加目标边缘特征的提取，确保边缘信息的有效利用。其次，为缓解特征融合过程中小目标边缘信息的丢失，我们提出了信息流路径聚合网络（Info-PAN），通过信息流机制桥接深层语义特征与浅层细节特征。最后，为缓解小目标信息不足的问题，我们提出了软组合融合块（SFB），动态整合多尺度特征并增强小目标表示。在VisDrone数据集上的实验结果表明，所提模型在mAP50和mAP50:95方面均优于现有最先进方法。进一步的消融研究证实了各引入模块在提升无人机场景检测性能方面的有效性。

articles.title_en: Evaluating diagnostic yield of ambulatory EEG for interictal epileptiform discharges and seizures
articles.title_cn: 评估动态脑电图对发作间期癫痫样放电和癫痫发作的诊断产出
articles.abstract_en: BackgroundAmbulatory EEG (aEEG) can be high yield, accessible, and cost-effective for prolonged outpatient monitoring, but it is unclear how patient and clinical characteristics can be used to select patients for whom aEEG may be diagnostic. To this end, this study aims to identify factors associated with diagnostic yield for interictal epileptiform discharges (IEDs) and seizures. MethodsWe evaluated all ambulatory EEGs from a Comprehensive Epilepsy Center over a 6-month period performed on adults. Using logistic regression and recursive feature elimination (RFE), we evaluated how patient and clinical characteristics were associated with observing IEDs or seizures. ResultsAEEG was performed for 179 patients (average age 45, 58% female). The median aEEG duration was 48 h (range 18.5 to 86 h). Diagnostic yield was 35% for IEDs and 10% for seizures. IED observation was more likely when a prior aEEG was abnormal (Odds Ratio [OR] 3.37, p = 0.039) or with more concurrent antiseizure medications (OR 1.45/medication, p = 0.007). Seizure observation was more likely on 72-hour studies (OR 26, p = 0.003) predominantly within the first 48 h, with higher seizure frequency (OR 1.71 per log seizure/month, p = 0.034), and with IEDs observed in prior epilepsy monitoring unit admission (OR 22, p = 0.004). ConclusionsThis study identified factors associated with diagnostic yield of aEEG for observing IEDs and seizures. At least 48-hours of aEEG was highest yield for seizures, and longer studies may be appropriate for people with lower seizure frequency. IEDs were less dependent on study length and were more associated with pre-aEEG certainty of epilepsy diagnosis.
articles.abstract_cn: 背景动态脑电图（aEEG）对于延长门诊监测可能具有高产出、可及且成本效益高，但尚不清楚如何利用患者和临床特征来选择可能通过aEEG获得诊断的患者。为此，本研究旨在识别与发作间期癫痫样放电（IEDs）和癫痫发作诊断产出相关的因素。方法我们评估了综合癫痫中心在6个月期间对成人进行的所有动态脑电图。使用逻辑回归和递归特征消除（RFE），我们评估了患者和临床特征与观察到IEDs或癫痫发作的关联。结果共有179名患者接受了aEEG（平均年龄45岁，58%为女性）。aEEG的中位持续时间为48小时（范围18.5至86小时）。IEDs的诊断产出为35%，癫痫发作为10%。当既往aEEG异常（比值比[OR] 3.37，p = 0.039）或同时使用更多抗癫痫药物（OR 1.45/药物，p = 0.007）时，观察到IEDs的可能性更大。在72小时的研究中观察到癫痫发作的可能性更大（OR 26，p = 0.003），主要在前48小时内，且癫痫发作频率较高（OR 1.71每对数发作/月，p = 0.034），以及在既往癫痫监测单元入院中观察到IEDs（OR 22，p = 0.004）。结论本研究识别了与aEEG观察IEDs和癫痫发作诊断产出相关的因素。至少48小时的aEEG对癫痫发作产出最高，对于癫痫发作频率较低的人群，更长的研究可能是合适的。IEDs对研究长度的依赖性较小，更多与aEEG前癫痫诊断的确定性相关。

articles.title_en: Money and gender: Proxy respondents and the mismeasurement of income in surveys
articles.title_cn: 金钱与性别：调查中的代理受访者与收入测量误差
articles.abstract_en: When sampled individuals are not found at home, many surveys rely on a proxy respondent: another knowledgeable household member. We study the effect of proxy reporting on the measurement of labor income in Mexico. For identification, we use the panel structure of the Mexican labor force survey and compare workers’ reported earnings when they report them themselves to their reported earnings when another household member does the reporting. We find that male workers’ monthly earnings are 7.2% lower when reported by a proxy, whereas female workers’ earnings are only 1.8% lower. We provide evidence that this gender gap reflects both compositional effects, linked to men’s higher earnings, and household informational asymmetries, partly driven by men’s greater propensity to hide income from other household members. Finally, we study the implications of using proxy respondents and find that it can lead to an underestimation of the gender wage gap by 25%.
articles.abstract_cn: 当抽样个体不在家时，许多调查依赖代理受访者：另一位知情的家庭成员。我们研究了代理报告对墨西哥劳动收入测量的影响。为了识别，我们利用墨西哥劳动力调查的面板结构，比较工人在自己报告收入与另一家庭成员报告其收入时的报告收入。我们发现，男性工人的月收入在代理报告时低7.2%，而女性工人的收入仅低1.8%。我们提供的证据表明，这种性别差距反映了与男性较高收入相关的构成效应，以及家庭信息不对称，部分由男性更倾向于向其他家庭成员隐瞒收入所驱动。最后，我们研究了使用代理受访者的影响，发现这可能导致性别工资差距被低估25%。

articles.title_en: Short versus long-run demand elasticities in asset pricing
articles.title_cn: 资产定价中的短期与长期需求弹性
articles.abstract_en: This paper quantifies how investors’ portfolio demand responds to price changes at long horizons versus short horizons. Using investor trades – changes in portfolios – at different horizons, I first present reduced-form evidence that elasticities increase significantly over time. I then propose a dynamic demand system via a parsimonious partial-adjustment model that recovers the full term structure of elasticities while mitigating long-horizon identification challenges. The estimates imply that price impacts are three times larger at quarterly horizons than in the long-run equilibrium. The model produces a novel, stock-level measure of long-term reversal that avoids the noise of long-horizon return regressions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文量化了投资者在不同时间跨度（长期与短期）下投资组合需求对价格变化的响应。利用不同时间跨度下的投资者交易——即投资组合的变化——我首先提供了简化形式的证据，表明弹性随时间显著增加。随后，我通过一个简约的部分调整模型提出了一个动态需求系统，该模型能够恢复弹性的完整期限结构，同时缓解长期识别挑战。估计结果表明，在季度时间跨度上的价格影响是长期均衡中的三倍。该模型产生了一种新颖的、股票层面的长期反转度量，避免了长期收益回归中的噪声问题。

articles.title_en: Hybrid configuration for mm-Wave MIMO-OFDM joint Radar–Communication system for automotive applications
articles.title_cn: 用于汽车应用的毫米波MIMO-OFDM联合雷达通信系统的混合配置
articles.abstract_en: Joint radar–communication (JRC) is a key enabler for next-generation automotive safety, allowing vehicles to share millimeter-wave (mmWave) spectrum and hardware to simultaneously support sensing and vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) communication. This paper proposes a novel hybrid mmWave JRC architecture in which a primary JRC vehicle performs monostatic sensing while reliably communicating with a secondary JRC vehicle that also operates as a passive bistatic node. A single unified orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) frame is reused for both functions, with subcarrier-wise frequency-division multiplexing (FDM) across transmit antennas to preserve waveform orthogonality. At the primary platform, a multi-input multi-output (MIMO) front-end with a transmit uniform linear array (ULA) and a sparse receive ULA is jointly exploited to synthesize a virtual aperture. For sensing, frequency-domain channel responses are stacked into a virtual data cube to obtain range-Doppler (RD) signatures via Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) processing, followed by high-resolution angle-of-arrival (AoA) estimation. The secondary JRC vehicle forms an analogous bistatic cube from its channel estimates to generate bistatic RD and range–angle (RA) responses. By combining monostatic and bistatic measurements, the proposed design improves observability and enables sensing from the secondary-vehicle perspective. Simulations demonstrate multi-target sensing up to 200 m while maintaining communication performance with bit error rate (BER) on the order of 10−4, supporting the practicality of the proposed automotive JRC approach.
articles.abstract_cn: 联合雷达通信（JRC）是下一代汽车安全的关键使能技术，允许车辆共享毫米波（mmWave）频谱和硬件，以同时支持感知和车对车（V2V）通信。本文提出了一种新颖的混合毫米波JRC架构，其中主JRC车辆执行单站感知，同时与也作为无源双基地节点运行的次JRC车辆可靠通信。一个统一的OFDM帧被复用于两种功能，通过跨发射天线的子载波级频分复用（FDM）来保持波形正交性。在主平台上，具有发射均匀线性阵列（ULA）和稀疏接收ULA的多输入多输出（MIMO）前端被联合利用以合成虚拟孔径。对于感知，频域信道响应被堆叠成虚拟数据立方体，通过快速傅里叶变换（FFT）处理获得距离-多普勒（RD）特征，随后进行高分辨率到达角（AoA）估计。次JRC车辆从其信道估计中形成类似的双基地立方体，以生成双基地RD和距离-角度（RA）响应。通过结合单站和双基地测量，所提出的设计提高了可观测性，并能够从次车辆视角进行感知。仿真展示了在保持通信性能（误码率（BER）在10−4量级）的同时，实现高达200米的多目标感知，支持了所提出的汽车JRC方法的实用性。

articles.title_en: CHT-YOLO: Drone-based infrared small object detection via dynamic sparse perception and task-decoupled alignment
articles.title_cn: CHT-YOLO：基于动态稀疏感知与任务解耦对齐的无人机红外小目标检测
articles.abstract_en: The rapid proliferation of unmanned aerial vehicle technology has expanded its applications across military, transportation, and agricultural sectors. However, infrared small-target detection—a critical UAV function—is challenged by small target size, low signal-to-noise ratio, weak thermal signatures, and complex background interference. To mitigate these issues, this paper proposes CHT-YOLO, a novel lightweight detection algorithm based on the YOLOv11 framework. This algorithm incorporates the concept of partial convolution to design a multi-scale feature extraction module (CSP-PMSFA), enhancing multi-scale feature extraction capability while reducing computational cost. It deeply integrates coordinate attention with dynamic upsampling into the path aggregation network to improve the preservation of spatial details for small targets. Based on the Task-Aligned One-stage Detection (TOOD) head, deformable convolution and a scale-adaptive layer are introduced to improve the localization accuracy of deformed small targets. Furthermore, a non-monotonic focusing loss function (WIoU) is adopted to further enhance detection accuracy and convergence efficiency. Experimental results on the UAV-ISTD dataset demonstrate significant improvements: CHT-YOLO achieves a 3.7% higher mAP@0.5, reduces parameters by 0.2 M and GFlops by 1.4 G compared to YOLOv11n, while maintaining a high inference speed of 255.8 FPS for real-time applications. On the HIT-UAV dataset, it achieves an mAP@0.5 of 82.9%, outperforming several mainstream detectors, and maintains low parameter counts and computational costs, confirming its strong generalization capability. The code repository is available at: https://github.com/yixixi12/CHT-YOLO.git.
articles.abstract_cn: 无人机技术的快速普及已将其应用扩展到军事、交通和农业等领域。然而，红外小目标检测——这一无人机关键功能——面临着目标尺寸小、信噪比低、热特征弱以及复杂背景干扰等挑战。为解决这些问题，本文提出CHT-YOLO，一种基于YOLOv11框架的新型轻量级检测算法。该算法引入部分卷积的概念，设计了一个多尺度特征提取模块（CSP-PMSFA），在降低计算成本的同时增强多尺度特征提取能力。它将坐标注意力与动态上采样深度融合到路径聚合网络中，以改善小目标空间细节的保留。基于任务对齐单阶段检测（TOOD）头部，引入可变形卷积和尺度自适应层，以提高变形小目标的定位精度。此外，采用非单调聚焦损失函数（WIoU）以进一步提升检测精度和收敛效率。在UAV-ISTD数据集上的实验结果表明了显著改进：与YOLOv11n相比，CHT-YOLO的mAP@0.5提高了3.7%，参数减少了0.2 M，GFlops减少了1.4 G，同时保持了255.8 FPS的高推理速度，适用于实时应用。在HIT-UAV数据集上，其mAP@0.5达到82.9%，优于多种主流检测器，并保持较低的参数数量和计算成本，证实了其强大的泛化能力。代码仓库可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/yixixi12/CHT-YOLO.git。

articles.title_en: Time-varying feature mode decomposition method for compound fault feature extraction of rolling bearings under speed-varying condition
articles.title_cn: 时变特征模态分解方法用于变速条件下滚动轴承复合故障特征提取
articles.abstract_en: The separation of multiple fault features from vibration signals under time-varying rotational speed conditions remains challenging. Feature mode decomposition (FMD) is effective for isolating single fault components in compound-fault signals by exploiting intrinsic fault-signal characteristics. However, conventional FMD methods usually rely on objective functions that assume periodically spaced fault impulses. This assumption limits their applicability when the rotational speed varies. To address this limitation, this article proposes a novel time-varying feature mode decomposition (TVFMD) method. TVFMD employs the angle-time cyclic harmonic-to-noise ratio (ATCHNR) as the objective function, which guides the iterative update of the adaptive filter to enhance the potential angular periodic fault impulse components in vibration signals under time-varying rotational speed conditions. Furthermore, the angle-time cyclic correlation function (ATCCF) is used to adaptively estimate the fault characteristic order under time-varying rotational speed conditions, without requiring this order to be specified in advance. Moreover, a dual-domain mode screening strategy based on time-domain correlation and spectral similarity is implemented to effectively suppress mode aliasing and redundant interference. Simulation and experimental results under the tested compound-fault conditions with time-varying rotational speeds demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms conventional FMD methods in fault-feature separation.
articles.abstract_cn: 在时变转速条件下，从振动信号中分离多个故障特征仍然具有挑战性。特征模态分解（FMD）通过利用内在故障信号特征，在复合故障信号中隔离单一故障分量方面是有效的。然而，传统的FMD方法通常依赖于假设故障脉冲周期性间隔的目标函数。当转速变化时，这一假设限制了其适用性。为解决这一局限性，本文提出了一种新颖的时变特征模态分解（TVFMD）方法。TVFMD采用角-时间循环谐波噪声比（ATCHNR）作为目标函数，该函数指导自适应滤波器的迭代更新，以增强时变转速条件下振动信号中潜在的角度周期性故障脉冲分量。此外，利用角-时间循环相关函数（ATCCF）自适应估计时变转速条件下的故障特征阶次，无需预先指定该阶次。而且，实施了一种基于时域相关性和频谱相似性的双域模态筛选策略，以有效抑制模态混叠和冗余干扰。在测试的时变转速复合故障条件下的仿真和实验结果表明，所提方法在故障特征分离方面优于传统FMD方法。

articles.title_en: Altered EEG microstate dynamics reflect depressive symptoms in temporal lobe epilepsy
articles.title_cn: 颞叶癫痫中脑电微状态动态改变反映抑郁症状
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 The Authors Background: Depressive symptoms are a common and disabling comorbidity in temporal lobe epilepsy (TLE), yet the neural mechanisms linking seizure networks to affective symptoms remain unclear. Although limbic network dysfunction has been implicated in both epilepsy and depressive disorders, it is unknown whether the time-varying dynamics of large-scale electrophysiological brain states reflect depressive symptom severity in TLE. In this study, we examined whether EEG microstate dynamics capture network alterations associated with depressive symptoms in individuals with unilateral TLE. Methods: We analyzed resting-state, visually normal scalp EEG from 26 individuals with unilateral TLE. EEG microstates were identified by clustering global field power peaks into four canonical classes, with electrode positions mirrored to align the ictal hemisphere across subjects. Microstate dwell time, fractional occupancy, global transition entropy, and Markov transition probabilities were quantified and related to Beck Depression Inventory-II (BDI) scores. Results: Individuals with high depressive symptoms (BDI ≥ 13; N = 12) exhibited longer mean dwell time in the ictal hemisphere-aligned microstate compared with individuals with low depressive symptom burden (BDI < 13; N = 14). Across subjects, dwell time in this microstate correlated with depressive symptom severity (r = 0.57, p = 0.002). TLE individuals with higher depressive symptoms exhibited reduced global transition entropy (p = 0.02), which also correlated with depressive symptom severity (r = -0.54, p = 0.004), indicating decreased flexibility of microstate transitions. Despite similar fractional occupancy of this state between groups, individuals with higher depressive symptoms were less likely to transition into the ictal hemisphere-aligned microstate from non-ictal or posterior configurations. Once engaged, however, the ictal-aligned microstate showed increased persistence, indicating prolonged stabilization of this network configuration. Conclusion: Higher depressive symptom burden in unilateral TLE is associated with increased temporal rigidity of the ictal hemisphere-aligned brain microstate, reflecting impaired disengagement of epileptogenic network configurations. These findings suggest that depressive symptoms in TLE may be associated with epilepsy-related disruptions in large-scale neural dynamics.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 作者 背景：抑郁症状是颞叶癫痫（TLE）中常见且致残的合并症，但连接癫痫网络与情感症状的神经机制仍不清楚。尽管边缘系统网络功能障碍已被认为与癫痫和抑郁障碍均有关，但大规模电生理脑状态的时间动态变化是否反映TLE中的抑郁症状严重程度尚属未知。在本研究中，我们检验了脑电微状态动态是否能捕捉与单侧TLE个体抑郁症状相关的网络改变。方法：我们分析了来自26名单侧TLE个体的静息态、视觉正常的头皮脑电。通过将全局场强峰值聚类为四个典型类别来识别脑电微状态，并镜像电极位置以对齐各受试者的发作侧半球。量化了微状态停留时间、部分占用率、全局转移熵和马尔可夫转移概率，并将其与贝克抑郁量表第二版（BDI）评分相关联。结果：高抑郁症状个体（BDI ≥ 13；N = 12）在发作侧半球对齐的微状态中表现出更长的平均停留时间，与低抑郁症状负担个体（BDI < 13；N = 14）相比。在所有受试者中，该微状态的停留时间与抑郁症状严重程度相关（r = 0.57，p = 0.002）。抑郁症状较高的TLE个体表现出较低的全局转移熵（p = 0.02），这也与抑郁症状严重程度相关（r = -0.54，p = 0.004），表明微状态转移的灵活性降低。尽管两组间该状态的部分占用率相似，但抑郁症状较高的个体从非发作侧或后部构型转入发作侧半球对齐微状态的可能性较低。然而，一旦进入，发作侧对齐的微状态表现出增加的持续性，表明该网络构型的延长稳定。结论：单侧TLE中较高的抑郁症状负担与发作侧半球对齐脑微状态的时间刚性增加相关，反映出发作源性网络构型脱离受损。这些发现表明，TLE中的抑郁症状可能与癫痫相关的大规模神经动力学中断有关。

articles.title_en: Molecular dynamics study on the mechanical properties of the Si-Al bonding interface layer in IGBT modules
articles.title_cn: IGBT模块中硅铝键合界面层力学性能的分子动力学研究
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd. The aluminum-silicon (Si-Al) interface mechanical property is of decisive importance to the thermal endurance and operation lifetime of insulated gate bipolar transistor (IGBT) modules, since the primary mechanism for interfacial mechanical degradation is silicon segregation at grain boundaries. The molecular dynamics (MD) simulations on quantifying the impact from the Si segregation on the interface fracture behavior of the Si-Al interfacial under uniaxial compression. The higher Si segregation critical strain energy release rate ( G c ) and fracture toughness ( K c ) by 20–35%, suggesting complex tradeoff between stiffness and toughness. When there is pre-existing crack, the maximum tensile stress (σ max) decreased by 25%, which shows much weakened load carrying capability. The interfacial mechanical characteristics are sensitive to the thickness of Si layer in the non-monotonic way and an optimal value can be found within the range of 30–33 Å. The above results give atomic-scale understanding of Si-Al interface degradation physics and serve as reference for materials design of more reliable IGBT devices.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd. 铝硅（Si-Al）界面力学性能对绝缘栅双极晶体管（IGBT）模块的耐热性和工作寿命具有决定性意义，因为界面力学退化的主要机制是晶界处的硅偏析。通过分子动力学（MD）模拟，量化了硅偏析对单轴压缩下Si-Al界面断裂行为的影响。较高的硅偏析临界应变能释放率（G c）和断裂韧性（K c）提高了20-35%，表明刚度与韧性之间存在复杂的权衡关系。当存在预裂纹时，最大拉伸应力（σ max）降低了25%，显示出承载能力显著减弱。界面力学特性对硅层厚度以非单调方式敏感，在30-33 Å范围内可找到最优值。上述结果为Si-Al界面退化物理提供了原子尺度的理解，并为更可靠的IGBT器件材料设计提供了参考。

articles.title_en: Fault diagnosis method driven by output characteristics of PV module based on system identification
articles.title_cn: 基于系统辨识的光伏组件输出特性驱动故障诊断方法
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd. The key innovation of this study lies in constructing a multi-mode output characteristic model for photovoltaic modules based on dynamic parameter identification, which breaks through the limitations of traditional modeling methods that depend on predefined empirical assumptions. By integrating time-domain response feature extraction with nonlinear system identification theory, the model achieves high-precision dynamic characterization of current-voltage relationships under complex operating conditions. Furthermore, a hierarchical fault classification framework is developed, which employs the maximum relevance minimum redundancy (mRMR) algorithm for discriminative feature selection from the identified state-space parameters. These selected features are then processed by an optimized NRBO-SVM algorithm to distinguish four critical operational states: normal operation, partial shading effects, material aging-induced degradation, and bypass circuit short-circuit faults. Experimental validation demonstrates robust generalization, with classification accuracy reaching 98.7% on simulated datasets and 95.5% on real-world operational data, surpassing the performance of conventional threshold-based diagnostic methods under comparable conditions.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd. 本研究的核心创新在于构建基于动态参数辨识的光伏组件多模式输出特性模型，突破了传统建模方法依赖预定义经验假设的局限性。通过将时域响应特征提取与非线性系统辨识理论相结合，该模型在复杂运行条件下实现了电流-电压关系的高精度动态表征。此外，开发了一种分层故障分类框架，采用最大相关最小冗余（mRMR）算法从辨识出的状态空间参数中进行判别性特征选择。随后，这些选定的特征通过优化的NRBO-SVM算法进行处理，以区分四种关键运行状态：正常运行、局部遮荫效应、材料老化引起的退化以及旁路电路短路故障。实验验证表明，该模型具有稳健的泛化能力，在模拟数据集上的分类准确率达到98.7%，在实际运行数据上达到95.5%，在可比条件下优于传统的基于阈值的诊断方法。

articles.title_en: Delamination behavior of back end of line in flip-chip chip scale package by notched four point bending test and finite element analysis
articles.title_cn: 倒装芯片芯片尺寸封装中后端布线层通过缺口四点弯曲试验和有限元分析的分层行为
articles.abstract_en: With the rapid development of flip-chip chip scale packaging (FCCSP) technology toward miniaturization and high integration, the thermo-mechanical stress induced by the coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE) mismatch and stiffness difference, especially the stiff Cu-pillar structure poses significant challenges to the reliability of the back-end-of-line (BEOL) layer incorporating fragile Low-k dielectrics. This study investigates delamination risks in BEOL layer during reflow process which introduces the critical thermal loading among all of the packaging processes. In case of experimental studies, the critical strain energy release rate (ERR) at Cu/Low-k interfaces in BEOL was determined by notched four-point bending test (FPB), and the mechanical properties of the dielectric material at different locations in the BEOL layer were determined by nanoindentation method. The stress distribution and delamination risks in the BEOL layer were analyzed using a multi-level sub-model approach numerically. The delamination risk between different layers in BEOL, and the fracture risk of the Low-k layers and the oxide layers were evaluated. Based on the optimization method of single-factor analysis, parametric studies among the thickness of die, CTE of the substrate and polyimide opening were proved to have significant effects on BEOL stress. Optimized design parameters effectively reduced delamination risks by reducing ERR of 64%. This study provided an optimization algorithm from experimental results of mechanical behavior to numerical modeling of BEOL structure, in order to improve the delamination performance of high density electronics package.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着倒装芯片芯片尺寸封装（FCCSP）技术向小型化和高集成度快速发展，由热膨胀系数（CTE）失配和刚度差异引起的热机械应力，特别是刚性Cu柱结构，对包含脆弱Low-k介电材料的后端布线层（BEOL）的可靠性构成了重大挑战。本研究调查了回流过程中BEOL层的分层风险，回流过程在所有封装工艺中引入了关键的热载荷。在实验研究方面，通过缺口四点弯曲试验（FPB）确定了BEOL中Cu/Low-k界面的临界应变能释放率（ERR），并通过纳米压痕方法确定了BEOL层中不同位置介电材料的力学性能。采用多级子模型方法数值分析了BEOL层中的应力分布和分层风险。评估了BEOL中不同层之间的分层风险，以及Low-k层和氧化物层的断裂风险。基于单因素分析的优化方法，参数研究表明芯片厚度、基板CTE和聚酰亚胺开口对BEOL应力有显著影响。优化设计参数通过将ERR降低64%有效减少了分层风险。本研究提供了一种从力学行为实验结果到BEOL结构数值建模的优化算法，以提高高密度电子封装的分层性能。

articles.title_en: Private equity for pension plans? Evaluating private equity performance from an investor’s perspective
articles.title_cn: 养老金计划的私募股权？从投资者视角评估私募股权表现
articles.abstract_en: We evaluate private equity (PE) performance using investor-specific stochastic discount factors, and examine whether public pension plans could benefit from changing their allocation to PE. Plans invest in PE funds with higher than average risk-adjusted performance. This is mainly due to access to successful managers, not superior selection skill. Decomposing returns into risk-compensation and “alpha”, we find that some plans obtain higher PE returns by taking more risk without earning higher, and in some cases earning lower, risk-adjusted returns, broadly consistent with agency problems within plans.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用投资者特定的随机贴现因子评估私募股权（PE）表现，并考察公共养老金计划是否可以通过改变其对PE的配置而受益。计划投资的PE基金具有高于平均风险调整后表现。这主要归因于接触成功经理人，而非卓越的选择技能。将回报分解为风险补偿和“阿尔法”，我们发现一些计划通过承担更多风险获得更高的PE回报，但并未获得更高的风险调整后回报，在某些情况下甚至获得更低的风险调整后回报，这与计划内部的代理问题大体一致。

articles.title_en: A novel statistical filtering framework for extracting fault-induced characteristics from bearing noisy vibration signal
articles.title_cn: 一种新颖的统计滤波框架，用于从轴承噪声振动信号中提取故障诱发特征
articles.abstract_en: Bearing fault vibration signal features are often submerged by strong background noise, resulting in inaccurate feature extraction and poor fault diagnosis effectiveness. To address this issue, we propose a curvature-sensitive Otsu (CSO) statistical filtering (CSO-SF) method to enhance the fault signal and bearing fault diagnosis. The method first constructs a multi-dimensional frequency feature matrix to represent the characteristics of fault signals and reference signals, then extracts the principal component from the matrix to evaluate the difference between fault signals and reference signals. The difference as an index used for statistical filtering can significantly highlight the fault frequency. The designed adaptive thresholding criterion serving as an index can precisely match the optimal geometric separation point to choose the fault signal frequency band. The CSO-SF filtered signal can effectively enhance the fault signal feature, and its envelope spectrum can detect the bearing fault characteristic frequency. The feasibility and the superiority of the presented method are verified by the simulation data, public dataset, experimental platform data, and comparison experiments. The results show that the proposed method can effectively enhance the fault signal and diagnose bearing faults.
articles.abstract_cn: 轴承故障振动信号特征常被强背景噪声淹没，导致特征提取不准确和故障诊断效果不佳。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种曲率敏感Otsu（CSO）统计滤波（CSO-SF）方法，以增强故障信号和轴承故障诊断。该方法首先构建多维频率特征矩阵来表示故障信号和参考信号的特征，然后从矩阵中提取主成分以评估故障信号与参考信号之间的差异。该差异作为统计滤波的指标，能显著突出故障频率。所设计的自适应阈值准则作为指标，能精确匹配最优几何分离点以选择故障信号频带。CSO-SF滤波信号能有效增强故障信号特征，其包络谱能检测轴承故障特征频率。通过仿真数据、公开数据集、实验平台数据和对比实验验证了所提方法的可行性和优越性。结果表明，所提方法能有效增强故障信号并诊断轴承故障。

articles.title_en: Wavelet-based two-stage network for restoring infrared images degraded by blind pixels
articles.title_cn: 基于小波的两阶段网络用于恢复由盲像素退化的红外图像
articles.abstract_en: Blind-pixel degradation in infrared focal-plane arrays causes sparse but severe local corruption, making it difficult to restore missing structures without sacrificing high-frequency thermal details. Existing learning-based methods often lose information because corrupted pixels contain no valid measurements, whereas interpolation- and filtering-based methods tend to over-smooth edges and suppress fine textures. To address this problem, we propose WBTSN, a Wavelet-Based Two-Stage Network for infrared blind-pixel compensation. In Stage I, a wavelet-driven residual multi-scale architecture performs reversible sub-band decomposition for structure-preserving coarse reconstruction. A hybrid attention module further improves feature fusion around corrupted regions and helps retain spatial details that are easily weakened in conventional restoration pipelines. In Stage II, a residual correction network guided by adversarial learning recovers high-frequency components lost after the first-stage reconstruction, thereby reducing over-smoothing and improving local texture fidelity. Extensive experiments show that WBTSN achieves competitive blind-pixel compensation performance, reaching 43.78 dB PSNR and the highest global SSIM of 0.9896 in the trained-from-scratch setting. The results demonstrate that WBTSN provides an effective structure-preserving restoration solution for infrared images degraded by blind pixels. The source code will be made publicly available upon acceptance at https://github.com/Richard-153/WBTSN.
articles.abstract_cn: 红外焦平面阵列中的盲像素退化会导致稀疏但严重的局部损坏，使得在不牺牲高频热细节的情况下恢复缺失结构变得困难。现有的基于学习的方法常常因为损坏像素不包含有效测量值而丢失信息，而基于插值和滤波的方法则倾向于过度平滑边缘并抑制精细纹理。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了WBTSN，一种基于小波的两阶段网络用于红外盲像素补偿。在第一阶段，小波驱动的残差多尺度架构执行可逆子带分解，以实现保持结构的粗略重建。混合注意力模块进一步改善了损坏区域周围的特征融合，并有助于保留在传统恢复流程中容易减弱的空间细节。在第二阶段，由对抗性学习引导的残差校正网络恢复第一阶段重建后丢失的高频分量，从而减少过度平滑并提高局部纹理保真度。大量实验表明，WBTSN在从零开始训练的设置中达到了具有竞争力的盲像素补偿性能，PSNR达到43.78 dB，全局SSIM最高为0.9896。结果表明，WBTSN为受盲像素退化的红外图像提供了一种有效的保持结构的恢复解决方案。源代码将在接受后公开于https://github.com/Richard-153/WBTSN。

articles.title_en: Robust image hashing scheme with deep and color features for content authentication in social network
articles.title_cn: 基于深度与颜色特征的鲁棒图像哈希方案用于社交网络内容认证
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes a secure image hashing framework for reliable content authentication, particularly designed to address the challenges posed by Online Social Network (OSN) environments. A dual-branch feature extraction strategy is introduced, which effectively combines saliency-guided color features with PCANet-based deep texture features. The color branch employs visual attention mechanisms to extract discriminative color statistics from foreground regions, while the deep texture branch leverages an unsupervised PCA network (PCANet) model trained on an OSN-specific dataset to capture robust structural patterns. Subsequently, a novel 3D Cubic Standard Coupled Map hyperchaotic system is proposed to encrypt the combined features, ensuring security against transmission attacks. Extensive experiments on two public benchmarks and a newly constructed OSN dataset demonstrate that the proposed algorithm achieves superior robustness against content-preserving manipulations, high discriminability for different images, and enhanced resilience to OSN-type distortions compared to state-of-the-art methods.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种安全的图像哈希框架，用于可靠的内容认证，特别针对在线社交网络（OSN）环境带来的挑战而设计。引入了一种双分支特征提取策略，有效结合了显著性引导的颜色特征与基于PCANet的深度纹理特征。颜色分支采用视觉注意机制从前景区域提取判别性颜色统计信息，而深度纹理分支利用在OSN特定数据集上训练的无监督PCA网络（PCANet）模型来捕获鲁棒的结构模式。随后，提出了一种新颖的3D三次标准耦合映射超混沌系统，用于加密组合特征，确保对传输攻击的安全性。在两个公共基准数据集和一个新构建的OSN数据集上的大量实验表明，与最先进的方法相比，所提出的算法在抵抗内容保持操作方面具有优越的鲁棒性，对不同图像具有高判别性，并对OSN型失真具有增强的韧性。

articles.title_en: First-episode psychosis and mood disorder onset in individuals with epilepsy
articles.title_cn: 癫痫患者首发精神病与心境障碍的发生
articles.abstract_en: BackgroundPsychiatric disorders represent a major burden for patients with epilepsy (PwE). This study examined how demographic, epilepsy-related, and clinical risk factors contribute to the onset of mood and psychotic disorders in epilepsy. MethodsIn this retrospective cohort, we intersected a hospital structured database with results from direct text mining in all available documentation from each patient to include PwE without prior psychiatric history. Logistic regression evaluated age, sex, epilepsy type, treatment resistance, histories of status epilepticus and febrile seizures, neurological and neurodevelopmental comorbidities as risk factors of psychotic and mood disorders. A five-fold cross-validated logistic regressor tested their predictive performance. Pairwise comparisons examined psychiatric outcomes across monotherapy treatments. ResultsWe screened 4269 individuals ; 1709 were excluded for lack of an established epilepsy diagnosis or anti-epileptic medication ; 696 already had a psychiatric history at the time of first antiseizure medication. In 1864 PwE without prior psychiatric history, psychiatric disorders occurred in 25% of cases (15.8% mood, 2.9% psychosis, 3.4% mood and psychosis). Risks for mood disorders included female sex, focal epilepsy, drug resistance, a history of febrile seizures, neurological comorbidities, and neurodevelopmental disorders. Risk factors for psychotic disorders included drug resistance, a history of febrile seizures and neurodevelopmental disorders. Supervised analyses significantly predicted outcomes for mood disorders (AUC = 0.70, p < 0.001) and psychosis (AUC = 0.61, p < 0.001). Pairwise treatment comparisons found no significant differences. DiscussionIdentification of these risk factors to psychosis and mood disorder onset provides clinicians with red flags that will facilitate timely psychiatric referral and intervention, as well as integrated care between neurologists and psychiatrists.
articles.abstract_cn: 背景：精神疾病对癫痫患者（PwE）构成重大负担。本研究探讨了人口统计学、癫痫相关及临床风险因素如何影响癫痫患者心境障碍和精神病性障碍的发生。方法：在这项回顾性队列研究中，我们将医院结构化数据库与每位患者所有可用文档的直接文本挖掘结果相交集，纳入无既往精神病史的癫痫患者。逻辑回归评估了年龄、性别、癫痫类型、治疗抵抗、癫痫持续状态和热性惊厥病史、神经及神经发育合并症作为精神病和心境障碍的风险因素。采用五折交叉验证的逻辑回归模型测试其预测性能。配对比较检验了单药治疗之间的精神结局。结果：我们筛选了4269名个体；1709名因缺乏明确的癫痫诊断或抗癫痫药物而被排除；696名在首次抗癫痫药物使用时已有精神病史。在1864名无既往精神病史的癫痫患者中，精神疾病发生率为25%（心境障碍15.8%，精神病2.9%，心境障碍合并精神病3.4%）。心境障碍的风险因素包括女性、局灶性癫痫、药物抵抗、热性惊厥病史、神经合并症和神经发育障碍。精神病的风险因素包括药物抵抗、热性惊厥病史和神经发育障碍。监督分析显著预测了心境障碍（AUC = 0.70，p < 0.001）和精神病（AUC = 0.61，p < 0.001）的结局。配对治疗比较未发现显著差异。讨论：识别这些精神病和心境障碍发生的风险因素为临床医生提供了警示信号，有助于及时的精神科转诊和干预，以及神经科医生和精神科医生之间的综合护理。

articles.title_en: Regulating intense fear: Does cognitive reappraisal attenuate physiological and subjective fear responses in an immersive VR environment?
articles.title_cn: 调节强烈恐惧：认知重评能否在沉浸式虚拟现实环境中减弱生理和主观恐惧反应？
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 The Authors. Published by Elsevier Inc. This is an open access article under the CC BY-NC license. http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/ Emotional experience and the regulation thereof are typically studied using picture inventories or short films to induce and modify affective states. These approaches, however, lack ecological validity due to their passive and receptive nature. Recent innovations in virtual reality and mobile neurophysiological technologies have enabled researchers to study the behavioral and neural correlates of more ecologically valid emotional responses. In this preregistered study, 58 healthy participants were randomly assigned to either use cognitive reappraisal (intervention) or to immerse themselves in their senses and surroundings (control) while walking across a wooden plank suspended 80 stories above the ground in virtual reality. We measured subjective fear ratings, salivary alpha amylase and cortisol levels, as well as frontal brain asymmetries, captured using mobile electroencephalography (EEG). Across both conditions, we found decisive evidence of increased subjective fear and salivary alpha amylase, a marker of sympathetic activation. However, we found no increase in cortisol levels following the task suggesting that subjective fear alone is not sufficient to trigger a cortisol response. In contrast to our hypotheses, the reappraisal group did not show any difference compared to the control group for neither emotional, endocrine nor neural measures. On the one hand, our findings may suggest that reappraisal might not be a suitable strategy to regulate realistic and intensely frightening situations. On the other hand, further analyses also indicated that the control group may have also regulated their emotions due to increased mindfulness of their inner states and their environment. Future studies are needed to confirm these observations and ascertain the efficacy of cognitive reappraisal on fear in realistic settings.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 作者。由Elsevier Inc.出版。这是一篇根据CC BY-NC许可的开放获取文章。http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/ 情绪体验及其调节通常通过图片库或短片来诱导和改变情感状态进行研究。然而，这些方法由于被动和接受性的特点，缺乏生态效度。虚拟现实和移动神经生理学技术的最新创新使研究人员能够研究更具生态效度的情绪反应的行为和神经关联。在这项预注册研究中，58名健康参与者被随机分配至使用认知重评（干预组）或沉浸于感官和环境中（对照组），同时在虚拟现实中行走在悬于地面80层楼高的木板上。我们测量了主观恐惧评分、唾液α-淀粉酶和皮质醇水平，以及使用移动脑电图（EEG）捕获的额叶脑不对称性。在两种条件下，我们发现了主观恐惧和唾液α-淀粉酶（交感神经激活的标志）增加的决定性证据。然而，任务后皮质醇水平没有增加，表明仅主观恐惧不足以触发皮质醇反应。与我们的假设相反，重评组在情绪、内分泌或神经测量方面与对照组相比没有显示出任何差异。一方面，我们的发现可能表明重评可能不是调节现实且强烈恐惧情境的合适策略。另一方面，进一步分析也表明，对照组可能由于对其内在状态和环境的正念增强而调节了情绪。未来研究需要确认这些观察结果，并确定认知重评在现实环境中对恐惧的有效性。

articles.title_en: Trapping influence on threshold voltage drift in GaN HEMTs based on the transient current method
articles.title_cn: 基于瞬态电流法的GaN HEMTs中陷阱对阈值电压漂移的影响
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd. To elucidate the time- and position-dependent behavior of threshold voltage drift caused by charge trapping in GaN high-electron-mobility transistors (HEMTs), we perform an in-depth experimental analysis of the different traps and their influence on threshold voltage drift behavior. First, the transient drain current is obtained under different electrical stresses to characterize the various types of traps present in devices. As a result, three trapping mechanisms and time-constant spectra are determined for three different traps. Second, the effects of the different traps on the threshold voltage are studied by capturing or releasing the charges from traps with different time constants. Finally, according to the activation energy of the different traps, the main cause of the threshold voltage (V TH ) drift is determined to be the effect of traps located on the AlGaN surface near the gate electrode. Within a 100 s, the interface traps capture electrons, leading to positive threshold voltage drift. After a long rest time, the V TH can be recovered.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd. 为阐明GaN高电子迁移率晶体管（HEMTs）中由电荷陷阱引起的阈值电压漂移的时间和位置依赖性行为，我们对不同陷阱及其对阈值电压漂移行为的影响进行了深入的实验分析。首先，在不同电应力下获取瞬态漏极电流，以表征器件中存在的各类陷阱。结果确定了三种陷阱机制和三种不同陷阱的时间常数谱。其次，通过捕获或释放具有不同时间常数的陷阱中的电荷，研究了不同陷阱对阈值电压的影响。最后，根据不同陷阱的激活能，确定阈值电压（V TH）漂移的主要原因是位于栅电极附近AlGaN表面的陷阱效应。在100秒内，界面陷阱捕获电子，导致阈值电压正向漂移。经过长时间休息后，V TH可以恢复。

articles.title_en: Monitoring and delivering: Evidence from dropout rates in Brazil
articles.title_cn: 监督与执行：来自巴西辍学率的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides evidence that audits can be an effective instrument for improving public services, depending on institutional and sectoral conditions. Leveraging randomized audits of municipal funds in Brazil, I show that audits led to better outcomes for public school students, but were not as effective in improving the provision of other public services. Using a difference-in-differences strategy, I show causal evidence that the audits led to a decrease in dropout rates in municipal elementary and middle schools by 0.41 percentage points (17%), and that this effect persisted for more than eight years. These estimates correspond to approximately one-third of the decrease in dropout rates resulting from the early years of Bolsa Família, a conditional cash transfer program partially designed to minimize student abandonment. The audits were most effective in municipalities where high levels of corruption were uncovered, and whose residents relied heavily on conditional cash transfers.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供的证据表明，审计可以成为改善公共服务的有效工具，但效果取决于制度与部门条件。利用巴西市政资金的随机审计，我展示了审计改善了公立学校学生的成果，但在改善其他公共服务供给方面效果不佳。采用双重差分策略，我提供了因果证据，表明审计使市政小学和初中的辍学率下降了0.41个百分点（17%），且这一效应持续了超过八年。这些估计大约相当于早期“家庭补助金”计划（一项部分旨在减少学生辍学的有条件现金转移项目）所带来辍学率下降的三分之一。审计在腐败程度被揭露较高的城市以及居民高度依赖有条件现金转移的城市中效果最为显著。

articles.title_en: The youth dividend: Political impacts of demographic transitions
articles.title_cn: 青年红利：人口转变的政治影响
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 The Authors This paper revisits the political economy of transitions to democracy. We extend a canonical rational choice model of democratization by introducing demographic structure, arguing that it shapes the material incentives for political mobilization. Younger cohorts benefit from democratic change over a longer horizon and face lower costs of participation, as they are less economically and socially integrated. As a result, increases in the youth share—such as during the demographic transition—can create a “window of opportunity” for democratization by strengthening the threat of political unrest faced by autocratic elites. We test this prediction using country-year panel data with detailed information on population age structure. Fixed-effects regressions reveal a robust positive relationship between the youth share and the likelihood of democratic improvement. This effect is strongest for the youngest cohorts, in particular individuals aged 15–19. To address concerns about endogeneity, we implement an instrumental variable strategy based on lagged fertility, including variation from neighboring countries. The IV estimates are consistent with the baseline results and are interpreted with appropriate caution. We also show that the effect of the youth share is amplified during economic downturns, highlighting a complementarity between demographic and macroeconomic forces.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 作者们 本文重新审视了民主转型的政治经济学。我们通过引入人口结构扩展了一个经典的民主化理性选择模型，认为人口结构塑造了政治动员的物质激励。较年轻的群体在更长的时间跨度内受益于民主变革，并且由于经济和社会融入程度较低，其参与成本也较低。因此，青年人口比例的增加——例如在人口转变期间——可以通过加强专制精英所面临的政治动荡威胁，为民主化创造“机会之窗”。我们使用包含详细人口年龄结构的国家-年份面板数据来检验这一预测。固定效应回归显示，青年人口比例与民主改善的可能性之间存在稳健的正相关关系。这种效应在最年轻的群体中最为显著，尤其是年龄在15-19岁的个体。为了解决内生性问题，我们实施了基于滞后生育率的工具变量策略，包括来自邻国的变异。IV估计结果与基线结果一致，并应谨慎解读。我们还表明，青年人口比例的影响在经济衰退期间会被放大，突显了人口与宏观经济力量之间的互补性。

articles.title_en: The Green Revolution and individualism: Evidence from Indonesia
articles.title_cn: 绿色革命与个人主义：来自印度尼西亚的证据
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 The Authors This paper studies the effects of the Green Revolution, one of the largest development projects in the late 20th Century, on individualism. We use a difference-in-differences approach to investigate how rapid technological and organizational changes in traditional agriculture reshaped cultural norms in Indonesia, where Green Revolution rollout was largely driven by centralized government interventions. Regions with greater exposure to Green Revolution policies experienced significant and persistent increases in individualism (as measured by a higher prevalence of infrequent names) decades after the end of the program. Results are not driven by pre-trends and hold across a battery of robustness checks. We further document suggestive, correlational evidence of a persistent fall in community funding for public goods, a key measure of collective action. Our findings suggest that technical change can lead to rapid and persistent changes in culture.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 作者。本文研究了绿色革命（20世纪末最大的发展项目之一）对个人主义的影响。我们采用双重差分方法，考察传统农业中快速的技术和组织变革如何重塑印度尼西亚的文化规范，其中绿色革命的推广主要由中央政府干预驱动。受绿色革命政策影响较大的地区，在项目结束数十年后，个人主义显著且持续增加（以不常见名字的较高流行度衡量）。结果并非由预趋势驱动，并在多种稳健性检验中保持一致。我们进一步记录了公共物品社区资金持续下降的提示性、相关性证据，这是集体行动的一个关键衡量指标。我们的发现表明，技术变革可以导致文化快速且持久的变化。

articles.title_en: Suing the leviathan: The effect of trans-regional jurisdiction reform on corporate investment
articles.title_cn: 起诉利维坦：跨区域司法管辖改革对企业投资的影响
articles.abstract_en: We study how the Trans-Regional Jurisdiction reform (TRJ) affects corporate investment. The reform moves administrative lawsuits to courts outside the defendant government's home jurisdiction, which limits local government influence over the courts. We use a stacked difference-in-differences design that draws on the staggered rollout of the reform across cities. We find that the reform raises corporate investment by about 28.7 percent of the sample mean. Complementary evidence shows that the reform improves court outcomes for firms, has stronger effects where pre-reform trust in local institutions is higher, and is associated with lower institutional transaction costs and financing constraints. The effect is larger for firms with more irreversible investment, lower state ownership, and better access to finance. The reform also leads firms to acquire more land and take on more risk, although part of the higher investment appears as overinvestment. These results show how a focused judicial reform can change firm behavior where legal institutions are weak.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了跨区域司法管辖改革（TRJ）如何影响企业投资。该改革将行政诉讼案件移至被告政府所在辖区之外的法院审理，从而限制了地方政府对法院的影响。我们采用堆叠双重差分设计，利用改革在各城市的交错推行。我们发现，改革使企业投资相对于样本均值提高了约28.7%。补充证据表明，改革改善了企业的法院结果，在改革前对地方机构信任度较高的地区效果更强，并且与较低的机构交易成本和融资约束相关。对于投资不可逆性更高、国有持股比例更低以及融资渠道更好的企业，效果更大。改革还导致企业获得更多土地并承担更多风险，尽管部分增加的投资表现为过度投资。这些结果表明，在法律制度薄弱的环境中，一项有针对性的司法改革可以改变企业行为。

articles.title_en: Strategic communication among banks
articles.title_cn: 银行间的战略沟通
articles.abstract_en: How do bank networks facilitate information flows that shape market outcomes? Using international banks’ advisory activities in corporate takeovers as their source of private information, we show in supervisory data that banks with closer ties to the target, but not the acquirer, advisor trade profitably in the target’s stock prior to the deal announcement. This trading behavior is associated with a higher premium paid without compromising deal success. As connected banks’ incentives are aligned only with target shareholders’ interests, which are represented by the target advisor, our evidence suggests that economic incentives determine which banks share information and with whom.
articles.abstract_cn: 银行网络如何促进信息流动，从而影响市场结果？利用国际银行在企业并购中的咨询活动作为其私人信息来源，我们在监管数据中显示，与目标方（而非收购方）顾问关系更紧密的银行，在交易公告前会在目标股票上进行盈利性交易。这种交易行为与支付更高的溢价相关，且不影响交易成功。由于关联银行的激励仅与目标股东的利益一致，而目标股东的利益由目标顾问代表，我们的证据表明，经济激励决定了哪些银行分享信息以及与谁分享。

articles.title_en: Capacity and outage analysis of SIMO relay systems with adaptive strategies and diversity under Nakagami-<ce:italic>m</ce:italic> fading
articles.title_cn: Nakagami-m衰落信道下具有自适应策略和分集的SIMO中继系统的容量与中断分析
articles.abstract_en: This paper analyzes the ergodic capacity and outage performance of a single-input multiple-output (SIMO) dual-hop decode-and-forward (DF) relay system with hop-asymmetric Nakagami-m fading and co-channel interference (CCI) on the first hop. Three adaptive transmission schemes (adaptive transmission policies—optimal power and rate adaptation (OPRA), optimal rate with constant power (ORCP), and truncated channel inversion with fixed rate (TIFR)) are considered with maximal-ratio combining (MRC) and selection combining (SC) at the destination. Closed-form and semi-closed-form (finite-sum) expressions, together with accurate Gauss–Laguerre-based evaluations, are derived for the end-to-end capacity and outage probability, capturing the effects of fading asymmetry, diversity order, and interference. Numerical results indicate that OPRA provides higher ergodic capacity than ORCP and TIFR at moderate-to-high SNR, while ORCP yields lower outage than TIFR at low-to-moderate target rates. In interference-limited regimes with increasing user activity, TIFR provides the lowest outage among the three schemes at low fixed rates.We further derive an inverse-CDF-based active-user admission bound and a high-reliability bottleneck-dominance indicator, which indicate when relay-side admission/scheduling becomes the dominant reliability lever relative to further increasing the destination-antenna number.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文分析了在第一跳具有跳不对称Nakagami-m衰落和同信道干扰（CCI）的单输入多输出（SIMO）双跳译码转发（DF）中继系统的遍历容量和中断性能。考虑了三种自适应传输方案（自适应传输策略——最优功率和速率自适应（OPRA）、恒定功率最优速率（ORCP）和截断信道反转固定速率（TIFR）），并在目的地采用最大比合并（MRC）和选择合并（SC）。推导了端到端容量和中断概率的闭式及半闭式（有限和）表达式，以及基于高斯-拉盖尔（Gauss-Laguerre）的精确评估，捕捉了衰落不对称性、分集阶数和干扰的影响。数值结果表明，在中高信噪比下，OPRA提供的遍历容量高于ORCP和TIFR，而在低至中等目标速率下，ORCP的中断概率低于TIFR。在干扰受限且用户活动增加的情况下，TIFR在低固定速率下提供了三种方案中最低的中断概率。我们进一步推导了基于逆CDF的活跃用户接纳界和高可靠性瓶颈主导指标，这些指标表明中继侧接纳/调度何时相对于进一步增加目的地天线数量成为主导的可靠性杠杆。

articles.title_en: Variational Bayesian algorithms for independent vector analysis with flexible source models
articles.title_cn: 基于变分贝叶斯的独立向量分析算法及其灵活源模型
articles.abstract_en: Fully Bayesian independent vector analysis algorithms derived using variational Bayes are proposed for guided source separation, providing control over the type, amount and influence of prior information. Speaker-dependent modelling is enabled by expressive Gaussian mixture models and hidden Markov models, with explicit noise modelling and an arbitrary number of sensors enabling joint separation and noise reduction in environments with dominant sources of interest contaminated by background interference. Maximum likelihood counterparts for the algorithms are also provided. Compared to state-of-the-art baselines, the proposed algorithms achieve stronger suppression of noise and interference, including background interference and other sources of interest. These gains may partially be attributed to enhanced source and noise modelling, and more principled integration of prior information. The framework additionally demonstrated speaker-dependent voice activity detection and closed-set multi-speaker recognition via Bayesian model comparison.
articles.abstract_cn: 提出了利用变分贝叶斯推导的全贝叶斯独立向量分析算法，用于引导源分离，能够控制先验信息的类型、数量及其影响。通过表达力强的高斯混合模型和隐马尔可夫模型实现说话人依赖建模，并包含显式噪声建模及任意数量的传感器，从而在存在主导兴趣源且受背景干扰污染的环境中实现联合分离和降噪。同时提供了这些算法的最大似然对应版本。与最先进的基线方法相比，所提算法在抑制噪声和干扰（包括背景干扰及其他兴趣源）方面表现更强。这些增益部分归因于增强的源和噪声建模，以及更合理的先验信息整合。该框架还通过贝叶斯模型比较展示了说话人依赖的语音活动检测和闭集多说话人识别能力。

articles.title_en: A 5D memristive hyperchaos-driven image encryption scheme with 5-DOF manipulator kinematics
articles.title_cn: 一种具有5自由度机械臂运动学的5D忆阻超混沌图像加密方案
articles.abstract_en: Secure transmission of high-value visual data requires image ciphers that can reduce strong spatial redundancy while maintaining high plaintext and key sensitivity. This paper proposes a five-dimensional memristive hyperchaos-driven image encryption scheme with a five-degree-of-freedom manipulator-kinematics-inspired geometric mapping. As a main technical component, a new flux-controlled five-dimensional memristive hyperchaotic system is constructed, and an offline metaheuristic parameter-search algorithm is used to locate parameter regions with three positive Lyapunov exponents. To introduce a structured nonlinear mapping before permutation and diffusion, the five state variables of the hyperchaotic source are assigned to the five joint variables of a serial manipulator. The resulting forward-kinematic position and pose sequences provide trajectory-based permutation indices and pose-modulated diffusion keys. The encryption pipeline further combines plaintext-dependent hash modulation, reversible color transformation, and double-round cipher-block chaining diffusion. Experimental results on representative color images show that the proposed scheme produces cipher images with near-uniform histograms, low adjacent-pixel correlation, high plaintext sensitivity, and lossless decryption under normal transmission. In this formulation, the manipulator module serves as a deterministic robot-kinematics-inspired nonlinear transform for the virtual encryption pipeline.
articles.abstract_cn: 高价值视觉数据的安全传输需要能够减少强空间冗余同时保持高明文和密钥敏感性的图像密码。本文提出了一种五维忆阻超混沌驱动的图像加密方案，该方案采用受五自由度机械臂运动学启发的几何映射。作为主要技术组成部分，构建了一个新的磁通控制五维忆阻超混沌系统，并使用离线元启发式参数搜索算法来定位具有三个正Lyapunov指数的参数区域。为了在置换和扩散之前引入结构化非线性映射，将超混沌源的五个状态变量分配给串联机械臂的五个关节变量。由此产生的前向运动学位置和姿态序列提供了基于轨迹的置换索引和姿态调制的扩散密钥。加密流程进一步结合了明文相关的哈希调制、可逆颜色变换和双轮密码块链接扩散。在代表性彩色图像上的实验结果表明，所提出的方案产生的密文图像具有接近均匀的直方图、低相邻像素相关性、高明文敏感性和正常传输下的无损解密。在此公式中，机械臂模块作为虚拟加密流程的确定性机器人运动学启发的非线性变换。

articles.title_en: Age-related factors for transition from pediatric to adult care in patients with childhood-onset epilepsy in Japan: A single-center mixed-methods study
articles.title_cn: 日本儿童期发病癫痫患者从儿科向成人医疗过渡的年龄相关因素：一项单中心混合方法研究
articles.abstract_en: BackgroundEpilepsy is a chronic neurological disorder; approximately 40 % of patients continue to experience seizures from childhood into adulthood. Transition from pediatric to adult care is a critical process that involves medical transfer and supports patient autonomy. However, Japan lacks standardized transition programs, and transition timing and processes vary widely. This study examined age-related differences in transition-related factors at a single epilepsy center in Japan. MethodsThis retrospective mixed-methods study included 55 patients with childhood-onset epilepsy (18–49 years, 32 female patients) who underwent inpatient evaluation at a specialized adult epilepsy monitoring unit. All patients received continuous care from pediatric to adult services. Participants were categorized by age at transition: ≤15 years (G1, n = 11), 16–17 years (G2, n = 6), 18–21 years (G3, n = 24), and ≥ 22 years (G4, n = 14). Electronic medical records were analyzed quantitatively and qualitatively to identify medical, psychological, and social transition-related factors. ResultsThe mean age at transition was 19.4 years (standard deviation = 4.7). The delayed-transition group (G4) tended to have higher seizure frequency and a higher proportion of patients living in areas with fewer epileptologists. However, quantitative analysis showed no significant group differences. Qualitative analysis indicated that planned transitions were uncommon and that psychiatric and psychosocial issues were often overlooked. ConclusionThese findings highlight the need for continuous biopsychosocial assessment, structured information sharing between pediatric and adult services, early psychological intervention, and attention to regional disparities in epilepsy care.
articles.abstract_cn: 背景癫痫是一种慢性神经系统疾病；大约40%的患者从儿童期到成年期持续经历癫痫发作。从儿科向成人医疗的过渡是一个关键过程，涉及医疗转移和支持患者自主权。然而，日本缺乏标准化的过渡项目，过渡时间和过程差异很大。本研究在日本一家癫痫中心考察了过渡相关因素的年龄相关差异。方法这项回顾性混合方法研究包括55名儿童期发病的癫痫患者（18-49岁，32名女性患者），他们在专门的成人癫痫监测单元接受了住院评估。所有患者从儿科到成人服务均接受了持续护理。参与者按过渡年龄分组：≤15岁（G1，n = 11），16-17岁（G2，n = 6），18-21岁（G3，n = 24），以及≥22岁（G4，n = 14）。对电子病历进行了定量和定性分析，以识别医疗、心理和社会过渡相关因素。结果过渡的平均年龄为19.4岁（标准差 = 4.7）。延迟过渡组（G4）倾向于有更高的癫痫发作频率和更高比例的患者居住在癫痫专科医生较少的地区。然而，定量分析显示组间无显著差异。定性分析表明，计划性过渡并不常见，精神和心理社会问题往往被忽视。结论这些发现强调了对持续的生物心理社会评估、儿科和成人服务之间的结构化信息共享、早期心理干预以及对癫痫护理区域差异的关注的需求。
